words.enDefinition: a US fund fee for distribution and sometimes shareholder services

examples.en: The sample share class paid a 12b-1 fee from fund assets for distribution and services.
examples.zh: 样本份额类别从基金资产中支付「美国基金分销服务费」，用于分销和持有人服务。

examples.en: We searched the US prospectus fee table for the line showing the annual 12b-1 fee.
examples.zh: 我们在美国招募说明书的费用表里找到了列示年度「美国基金分销服务费」的一行。

words.enDefinition: a family of day-count methods that use a 30-day month and 360-day year, with different end-date rules

examples.en: The note uses a 30/360 day-count convention to calculate interest for the first period.
examples.zh: 这只票据采用「按月30天年360天计息」的惯例计算首期利息。

examples.en: Our tutor compared versions of the 30/360 day-count convention to show why month-end dates mattered.
examples.zh: 导师比较了不同版本的「按月30天年360天计息」惯例，说明为什么月末日期重要。

words.zhGloss: 美国 SEC 三十日收益率
words.enDefinition: an annualised measure of net investment income over a 30-day period, calculated using a standard US SEC formula
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国 SEC 三十日收益率

examples.en: The sample bond fund offered a 30-day SEC yield alongside figures for its actual distributions.
examples.zh: 样本债券基金在实际分配数据旁列出了「美国 SEC 三十日收益率」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the 30-day SEC yield could differ from the fund's recent payments.
examples.zh: 导师问，「美国 SEC 三十日收益率」为什么可能与基金近期的分配金额不同。

words.enDefinition: Flexibility to stop a project and avoid continuing exposure or costs

examples.en: The case included an abandonment option if demand turned out much lower.
examples.zh: 案例考虑了需求远低于预期时的「放弃项目选择权」。

examples.en: Our diagram showed where the abandonment option entered the sequence of decisions.
examples.zh: 图上显示「放弃项目选择权」出现在决策顺序的哪个位置。

collocations: a project with an abandonment option

words.enDefinition: to choose not to cast a vote for or against

examples.en: The fictional shareholder chose to abstain from voting on a proposal involving the new director.
examples.zh: 虚构股东选择在涉及新董事的提案表决中「弃权」。

examples.en: Our class discussed what it meant to abstain from voting in the sample tally.
examples.zh: 我们班讨论了在样本票数统计中「弃权」意味着什么。

collocations: abstain from voting on a proposal

words.enDefinition: a provision allowing an unpaid balance to become due earlier when specified conditions are met

examples.en: The agreement's acceleration clause described when the lender could demand the remaining amount before maturity.
examples.zh: 协议的「加速到期条款」说明了贷款方何时能在期限届满前要求还清余额。

examples.en: We identified the acceleration clause during a classroom exercise on the consequences of a default.
examples.zh: 课堂练习讨论违约后果时，我们找出了「加速到期条款」。

words.enDefinition: A payment status in some systems indicating that the settlement being reported has completed.

examples.en: The Fedwire example showed Accepted Settlement Completed on a message reporting completion of the interbank step.
examples.zh: Fedwire 示例用「已受理且结算完成」报文状态说明银行间环节已完成。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished Accepted Settlement Completed from confirmation of credit to a customer's own account.
examples.zh: 老师区分了「已受理且结算完成」和客户账户入账确认。

collocations: a message marked Accepted Settlement Completed
read Accepted Settlement Completed in the record

words.enDefinition: The currency in which an account balance is stated and ordinarily maintained.

examples.en: The mock statement showed the account denomination above the balances for all the recorded entries.
examples.zh: 模拟账单在所有记录余额的上方列出了「账户记账币种」。

examples.en: We identified the account denomination before reading about how the incoming payment had been converted.
examples.zh: 阅读有关入账款项如何兑换的说明之前，我们先找出了「账户记账币种」。

words.enDefinition: A report mistake attributing an account to the wrong person

examples.en: An account ownership error put a relative's store card on the applicant's sample report.
examples.zh: 「账户归属错误」让亲属的商店信用卡出现在申请人的报告样本上。

examples.en: Our group found an account ownership error after reading the names on two statements.
examples.zh: 我们组看过两份账单上的姓名后，发现了一处「账户归属错误」。

words.enDefinition: A short note on a credit report explaining something about an account

examples.en: The account remark said the fictional account was closed at the customer's request.
examples.zh: 「账户备注」写明，该虚构账户是应客户要求关闭的。

examples.en: An account remark explained why one balance had been recorded separately on the report.
examples.zh: 一条「账户备注」解释了报告里为什么把一笔余额单独列出。

words.enDefinition: A report field showing how a person is responsible for an account

examples.en: The account responsibility field showed that two people were liable for the balance.
examples.zh: 「账户还款责任」一栏显示，有两个人对这笔余额负有偿还责任。

examples.en: We compared account responsibility for a joint loan with that for an individual account.
examples.zh: 我们比较了联名贷款和个人账户的「账户还款责任」。

words.enDefinition: A credit inquiry by a company reviewing a customer's existing account

examples.en: An account review inquiry appeared next to the provider of the fictional customer's store card.
examples.zh: 虚构客户的商店信用卡发卡方旁边有一条「现有账户审查查询」。

examples.en: The account review inquiry in our worksheet related to a card the applicant already held.
examples.zh: 练习题里的「现有账户审查查询」涉及申请人已经持有的一张卡。

collocations: an account review inquiry from a lender

words.enDefinition: A short identifier showing the category of financial account being reported

examples.en: The legend explained the account type code next to the sample borrower's car loan.
examples.zh: 图例解释了借款人样例中车贷旁边的「账户类型代码」。

examples.en: The lender corrected the account type code after noticing that the loan was misclassified.
examples.zh: 贷款机构注意到贷款分类有误后，修正了「账户类型代码」。

words.enDefinition: fund units that keep income invested within the fund

examples.en: The UK sample's accumulation units retained investment income within the fund instead of paying it out.
examples.zh: 这个英国样本的「累积型基金份额」把投资收益留在基金内，不对外支付。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the distribution column was empty for the accumulation units in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么练习中「累积型基金份额」的分配栏是空的。

words.enDefinition: fund costs indirectly incurred through investments in other funds

examples.en: The sample fee table showed acquired fund fees and expenses below the fund's own operating expenses.
examples.zh: 样本费用表在基金自身运作费用的下方列出了「所投资基金的费用」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why acquired fund fees and expenses appeared when the fund held other funds.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么当基金持有别的基金时，会出现「所投资基金的费用」。

collocations: disclose acquired fund fees and expenses
include acquired fund fees and expenses
a line for acquired fund fees and expenses

words.enDefinition: a UK student loan account document confirming which repayment plan or plans the borrower is on

examples.en: The payroll officer asked for an active plan type letter to verify the borrower's repayment category.
examples.zh: 工资核算人员要求出示「当前还款方案证明信」，以核对借款人的还款类别。

examples.en: The borrower downloaded the active plan type letter after noticing two plans listed in the account.
examples.zh: 借款人看到账户里列了两个方案后，下载了「当前还款方案证明信」。

collocations: download an active plan type letter
show your active plan type letter
check the active plan type letter

words.enDefinition: the extent to which portfolio weights differ from benchmark weights

examples.en: Our example showed higher active share when several holding weights differed sharply from the benchmark.
examples.zh: 我们的示例中，有几项持仓权重明显不同于基准时，「主动份额」较高。

examples.en: The tutor asked why active share and tracking error could give different impressions of the same portfolio.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「主动份额」和跟踪误差对同一投资组合给出的印象可能不一样。

collocations: a portfolio with high active share

words.enDefinition: the portfolio weight minus the corresponding benchmark weight

examples.en: The active weight was positive because the portfolio held more of the sector than the benchmark.
examples.zh: 「主动权重」为正，是因为投资组合在该行业的权重高于基准。

examples.en: Our group calculated active weight for each sector before interpreting the hypothetical fund's allocations.
examples.zh: 我们小组先计算各行业的「主动权重」，再解读假设基金的配置。

words.enDefinition: a family of day-count methods using actual calendar days, with the year fraction defined by the particular version

examples.en: The terms named an actual/actual convention for calculating the interest accruing between the two dates.
examples.zh: 条款规定用「实际天数计息惯例」计算这两个日期之间应计的利息。

examples.en: The tutor asked which version of actual/actual the worksheet used before we compared our answers.
examples.zh: 导师让我们先看练习表用的是哪种「实际天数计息惯例」，再比较答案。

words.enDefinition: A source of income other than an applicant's main earnings

examples.en: The fictional borrower listed weekend tutoring as an additional income source on the form.
examples.zh: 虚构借款人在表上把周末辅导填为一项「其他收入来源」。

examples.en: Our exercise asked which documents supported the additional income source mentioned in the application.
examples.zh: 练习问，哪些文件可以证明申请中提到的「其他收入来源」？

collocations: documentation for an additional income source

words.enDefinition: A field giving extra explanatory text about another entry, such as the reason for a status or return.

examples.en: The additional information field gave an explanation that was missing from the abbreviated return description.
examples.zh: 「补充信息字段」给出了一项说明，简短的退回描述中没写到。

examples.en: The class compared the additional information field with the code shown on the same report.
examples.zh: 同学们把「补充信息字段」和同一份报文显示的代码作了比较。

collocations: a comment in the additional information field

words.enDefinition: A UK lender's explanation helping a borrower understand an agreement before signing

examples.en: The handout asked what an adequate explanation would cover before the decision.
examples.zh: 讲义问，作决定前的「充分签前说明」应涵盖哪些内容。

examples.en: Our tutor read an adequate explanation alongside the sample UK credit agreement.
examples.zh: 导师把一份「充分的签前说明」和英国信贷协议样本放在一起读。

words.enDefinition: Project value without debt plus present value of financing effects

examples.en: The adjusted present value calculation valued the project before adding the financing effects.
examples.zh: 「调整现值」的计算先估算项目自身价值，再加入融资影响。

examples.en: Our worksheet used adjusted present value when the planned debt balance changed over time.
examples.zh: 计划债务余额随时间变化时，练习表用到了「调整现值」。

words.enDefinition: a vote intended to convey views without binding the decision maker

examples.en: The fictional company held an advisory vote to learn shareholders' views on the proposed policy.
examples.zh: 虚构公司举行「咨询性表决」，了解股东对拟议政策的意见。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the advisory vote mattered even though its result was not binding.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「咨询性表决」的结果即使没有约束力也有意义。

words.zhGloss: 规定必须采取行动的条款
words.enDefinition: a covenant requiring a borrower or issuer to take specified actions
acceptedZhAnswers: 规定必须采取行动的条款

examples.en: The affirmative covenant required the example issuer to send financial statements to the trustee regularly.
examples.zh: 「规定必须采取行动的条款」要求示例发行人定期向受托人发送财务报表。

examples.en: The tutor used an affirmative covenant to illustrate an obligation to do something under the agreement.
examples.zh: 导师用一项「规定必须采取行动的条款」说明，协议里可以约定必须做某件事。

collocations: an affirmative covenant to provide reports

words.enDefinition: A review of whether repayments fit a person's overall financial situation

examples.en: The mock lender included rent and food costs in its affordability assessment.
examples.zh: 模拟案例中的贷款机构在「还款负担能力评估」中计入了房租和饮食开销。

examples.en: We compared two examples of an affordability assessment with different monthly expenses.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两份每月开销不同的「还款负担能力评估」样例。

words.enDefinition: The risk that repayments will cause the borrower financial difficulty

examples.en: The exercise showed how irregular earnings could create affordability risk for the applicant.
examples.zh: 练习展示了收入不规律如何给申请人带来「还款负担过重的风险」。

examples.en: We discussed affordability risk separately from the chance the lender would lose money.
examples.zh: 我们单独讨论了「还款负担过重的风险」，也讨论了贷款机构亏钱的可能性。

words.enDefinition: Cash recovered from selling an asset after related taxes are accounted for

examples.en: We included after-tax salvage value in the last column of the project worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在项目练习表的最后一栏计入了「税后残值收入」。

examples.en: The class calculated after-tax salvage value after estimating what the used equipment would sell for.
examples.zh: 全班先估算旧设备卖多少钱，再计算「税后残值收入」。

collocations: include after-tax salvage value at closure

words.enDefinition: Time elapsed since the earliest account on a report was opened

examples.en: The dashboard listed age of oldest account separately from the average across all of the accounts.
examples.zh: 界面将「最早账户的开立年限」和所有账户的平均开立年限分开列出。

examples.en: We found age of oldest account in the section headed Account History on the sample page.
examples.zh: 我们在样例页的账户历史一栏找到了「最早账户的开立年限」。

collocations: check the age of oldest account
calculate the age of oldest account

words.enDefinition: a transaction executed by a broker on behalf of a client

examples.en: The sample showed an agency trade for which the broker charged a stated commission.
examples.zh: 样本显示一笔「券商代理交易」，券商为此收取了列明的佣金。

examples.en: We distinguished the agency trade from another sample in which the firm used its own shares.
examples.zh: 我们把「券商代理交易」和另一份使用券商自身持股的样本区分开。

collocations: the commission on an agency trade

words.enDefinition: A share of common costs assigned to a product or activity

examples.en: The allocated overhead appeared on the cost sheet even though total rent stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 尽管房租总额没变，成本表上仍列出了「分摊的间接费用」。

examples.en: Our group checked whether the allocated overhead represented any new cash spending.
examples.zh: 我们组核对了「分摊的间接费用」是否对应新增现金支出。

collocations: include allocated overhead in a cost sheet
exclude allocated overhead from cash flows

words.enDefinition: Information outside traditional credit records used to assess an applicant

examples.en: The lecture used rent payments as an example of alternative credit data in underwriting.
examples.zh: 课上把租金付款记录作为信贷审核中「替代性信用数据」的例子。

examples.en: We discussed which alternative credit data appeared in the example lender's application review.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了示例贷款机构审查申请时用到了哪些「替代性信用数据」。

collocations: a source of alternative credit data

words.zhGloss: 澳洲更正后税额核定通知
words.enDefinition: An ATO notice providing a revised assessment after tax figures change
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲更正后税额核定通知

examples.en: The amended notice of assessment showed a changed balance after the new information was considered.
examples.zh: 考虑新信息后，「澳洲更正后税额核定通知」列出了变更后的余额。

examples.en: We checked the date on the amended notice of assessment against the fictional amendment request.
examples.zh: 我们用虚构的更正申请核对了「澳洲更正后税额核定通知」的日期。

collocations: receive an amended notice of assessment
review an amended notice of assessment
changes shown on an amended notice of assessment

words.zhGloss: 美国机会教育税额抵免
words.enDefinition: A US federal education credit for eligible early undergraduate study expenses
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国机会教育税额抵免

examples.en: Our seminar compared the American Opportunity Tax Credit with another credit available for education costs.
examples.zh: 研讨课比较了「美国机会教育税额抵免」与另一项教育支出抵免。

examples.en: The IRS worksheet included a hypothetical American Opportunity Tax Credit calculation for an undergraduate student.
examples.zh: 美国国税局的练习表包含一个本科生「美国机会教育税额抵免」的假设计算案例。

collocations: an American Opportunity Tax Credit example
eligibility for the American Opportunity Tax Credit
illustrate the American Opportunity Tax Credit

words.enDefinition: a bond that repays principal in installments over its life rather than all at maturity

examples.en: The amortizing bond reduced its outstanding principal with each scheduled payment in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「分期偿还本金债券」每笔预定付款后都会减少未偿本金。

examples.en: Our tutor compared an amortizing bond with one that repaid principal on the final date.
examples.zh: 导师把「分期偿还本金债券」和在最后一天才偿还本金的债券作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the net amount of credit provided to the borrower or on their behalf, as defined for US Truth-in-Lending disclosure

examples.en: The amount financed was lower than the amount borrowed because a charge was withheld.
examples.zh: 由于有一笔费用从借款中扣除，「净融资额」低于借款总额。

examples.en: We located the amount financed beneath the purchase details on the fictional disclosure.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构披露表的购买明细下找到了「净融资额」。

collocations: an itemization of the amount financed

words.enDefinition: the percentage set for a given year's indexation of an amount such as eligible HELP debt

examples.en: The guide used a sample annual indexation rate to show how part of the balance changed.
examples.zh: 指南用了一个模拟的「年度指数调整率」来展示部分余额怎样变化。

examples.en: The adviser compared the annual indexation rate with the figure shown for the previous year.
examples.zh: 顾问把「年度指数调整率」与上一年显示的数字作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a company meeting held once a year for shareholder business

examples.en: At the sample annual meeting of shareholders, investors voted on several directors and one proposal.
examples.zh: 在样本「年度股东大会」上，投资者就数名董事人选和一项提案投票。

examples.en: We checked which business belonged on the agenda for the annual meeting of shareholders.
examples.zh: 我们核对了哪些事项应纳入「年度股东大会」的议程。

collocations: hold an annual meeting of shareholders
attend the annual meeting of shareholders
agenda for the annual meeting of shareholders

words.enDefinition: recurring expenses paid each year from a fund's assets

examples.en: The table listed annual operating expenses separately from fees charged directly to the sample shareholder.
examples.zh: 表格把「年度运作费用」和直接向样本持有人收取的费用分开列出。

examples.en: We checked which items counted toward annual operating expenses in the fictional fund's prospectus.
examples.zh: 我们查阅了虚构基金的招募说明书，确认哪些项目计入「年度运作费用」。

collocations: annual operating expenses of a fund

words.enDefinition: a report to fund investors covering a full financial year

examples.en: The annual shareholder report compared the sample fund's performance with its index over the full year.
examples.zh: 「年度持有人报告」将样本基金与指数的全年表现作了对比。

examples.en: We found the year's actual fund expenses in the annual shareholder report used in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂用的「年度持有人报告」中找到了该年基金的实际费用。

collocations: expenses in the annual shareholder report

words.enDefinition: The exchange rate actually used to convert an amount in a particular transaction.

examples.en: The receipt showed the applied exchange rate beside the amount converted in the completed transaction.
examples.zh: 回执在已完成交易的兑换金额旁列出了「实际采用的汇率」。

examples.en: We compared the applied exchange rate with an earlier estimate included in the example disclosure.
examples.zh: 我们把「实际采用的汇率」与示例披露文件中较早给出的估算作了比较。

collocations: compare the applied exchange rate with the earlier quote

words.zhGloss: 报价方卖出基准货币的汇率
words.enDefinition: The quoted rate at which the quoting institution is willing to sell the base currency.
acceptedZhAnswers: 报价方卖出基准货币的汇率

examples.en: The worksheet compared the ask exchange rate with the rate shown for the institution's purchase.
examples.zh: 练习表把「报价方卖出基准货币的汇率」与机构买入的汇率作了比较。

examples.en: We identified the ask exchange rate when the example described the provider selling the base currency.
examples.zh: 例子讲到服务商卖出基准货币时，我们找出了「报价方卖出基准货币的汇率」。

collocations: compare the ask exchange rate with the bid rate

words.enDefinition: Income included in Australian tax calculations before allowable deductions are subtracted

examples.en: The comparison started with assessable income and showed deductions on a separate line.
examples.zh: 对照示例先列「计入税额核定的收入」，再另列一行扣除额。

examples.en: The case study grouped Australian wages and interest under assessable income.
examples.zh: 案例把澳大利亚工资和利息归入「计入税额核定的收入」。

collocations: include an amount in assessable income

words.enDefinition: The Australian tax office's online services for viewing and managing tax records

examples.en: The training video used ATO online services to show where an income record might appear.
examples.zh: 培训视频用「澳洲税务局在线服务」演示可能在哪里查看收入记录。

examples.en: We saw the opening page for ATO online services during the workshop.
examples.zh: 工作坊里，我们看到了「澳洲税务局在线服务」的首页。

collocations: view a record through ATO online services
information shown in ATO online services

words.enDefinition: an auction offering more of a security that was previously issued

examples.en: The auction reopening offered more of the same note without changing its original maturity date.
examples.zh: 「同一证券追加拍卖」提供了同一只票据的更多份额，原到期日保持原样。

examples.en: Our class compared an auction reopening with the first auction of a new Treasury security.
examples.zh: 我们班把「同一证券追加拍卖」与一只新国债的首场拍卖作了比较。

words.enDefinition: an eligible institution with an agreement allowing it to create or redeem large blocks of ETF shares directly with the fund

examples.en: The authorized participant in our case exchanged a basket of securities for one block of ETF shares.
examples.zh: 案例中的「ETF 授权参与机构」以一篮子证券换取一整批 ETF 份额。

examples.en: We checked which role the authorized participant played in the exercise's diagram of ETF trading.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「ETF 授权参与机构」在练习所附 ETF 交易流程图中所起的作用。

collocations: an agreement with an authorized participant

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of shares a company is permitted to issue

examples.en: The case showed authorized shares in a separate column from shares already issued.
examples.zh: 案例将「授权发行股份」和已经发行的股份分栏列示。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the authorized shares figure exceeded the issued amount on the company's table.
examples.zh: 导师问，公司表中的「授权发行股份」数量为什么超过已发行数量。

words.enDefinition: A card account appearing for someone permitted to use another person's card

examples.en: The authorized user account in the sample report belonged to another person in the household.
examples.zh: 样例报告里的「授权使用人账户记录」来自同住另一人的账户。

examples.en: Our lecturer asked how an authorized user account differed from a loan held jointly.
examples.zh: 老师问「授权使用人账户记录」和联名贷款在责任上有什么不同。

collocations: an authorized user account on a credit report

words.enDefinition: A lending decision produced by a computer applying preset rules or models

examples.en: The worksheet asked which data fed into the automated credit decision in the example.
examples.zh: 练习题问，示例用了哪些数据作出「自动化授信决定」？

examples.en: A sample automated credit decision appeared immediately after the fictional form was submitted.
examples.zh: 虚构表单一提交，就显示了一项示例「自动化授信决定」。

words.enDefinition: A payment tied to making a facility available to agreed standards

examples.en: The availability payment fell in the example after one facility became unavailable.
examples.zh: 本例中，一处设施无法使用后，「按可用性支付的款项」减少了。

examples.en: The contract linked the availability payment to opening hours and service standards.
examples.zh: 合同把「按可用性支付的款项」与开放时间和服务标准挂钩。

words.enDefinition: the amount of Australian HELP funding a student can still borrow under their applicable loan limit

examples.en: We compared the available HELP balance with the tuition listed for the next year of study.
examples.zh: 我们把「HELP 剩余可借额度」与下一学年列出的学费作了比较。

examples.en: The adviser explained why the available HELP balance was different from the debt already owed.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么「HELP 剩余可借额度」和已经欠下的债务不同。

words.enDefinition: the constant compounded yearly rate equivalent to total return over a period

examples.en: The sample table reported average annual total return over one, five, and ten years.
examples.zh: 样本表报告了一年、五年和十年的「年化总回报率」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the average annual total return differed from the sum of yearly figures.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「年化总回报率」与逐年数据的总和不同。

collocations: a fund's average annual total return

words.enDefinition: Indirect operating costs that disappear if an activity stops or changes

examples.en: The case counted the temporary cleaning contract as avoidable overhead for the studio.
examples.zh: 案例把这间工作室的临时清洁合同计作「可避免的间接费用」。

examples.en: We included avoidable overhead when comparing whether to keep the extra facility open.
examples.zh: 我们比较是否继续开放额外场地时，计入了「可避免的间接费用」。

collocations: exclude unavoidable costs from avoidable overhead

words.enDefinition: a Student Finance England payment status indicating that the course provider's confirmation of registration has not yet been received

examples.en: The example account showed Awaiting confirmation while the service waited to hear from the university.
examples.zh: 示例账户显示「正在等待确认」，资助机构还在等学校回复。

examples.en: Our trainer asked what Awaiting confirmation meant in the payment status column of the worksheet.
examples.zh: 培训老师问，练习表发放状态栏里的「正在等待确认」是什么意思。

collocations: check why it says Awaiting confirmation

words.enDefinition: US withholding applied to certain reportable payments under specified conditions

examples.en: The fictional bank notice described backup withholding in a section about interest.
examples.zh: 虚构银行的通知在利息一栏说明了「美国后备预扣税」。

examples.en: The worksheet classified backup withholding separately from tax already withheld from wages.
examples.zh: 练习表把「美国后备预扣税」和已从工资里预扣的税款分开归类。

words.zhGloss: 英国自行申报应补差额
words.enDefinition: Remaining Self Assessment tax owed after earlier payments on account
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国自行申报应补差额

examples.en: The example balancing payment remained after the previous advances had been subtracted.
examples.zh: 扣除先前预缴金额后，示例中仍有「英国自行申报应补差额」。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed out the balancing payment on the fictional Self Assessment statement.
examples.zh: 导师指出了虚构的自行申报报表上「应补差额」的位置。

collocations: a balancing payment for a tax year

words.enDefinition: The reference date to which future cash flows are discounted

examples.en: The base date in our model was the day the investment was approved.
examples.zh: 我们模型的「折现基准日期」是投资获批的那天。

examples.en: We checked the base date before comparing values from the two schedules.
examples.zh: 比较两份表的数值前，我们核对了「折现基准日期」。

collocations: discount cash flows to the base date

words.enDefinition: a US Treasury security used as a reference when quoting or comparing another bond's yield

examples.en: The offering sheet named a benchmark Treasury used to calculate the spread on the new bond.
examples.zh: 发行说明指定了一只「作为基准的美国国债」，用于计算新债的利差。

examples.en: We compared the yield on the benchmark Treasury with the new bond's yield in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上对比了「作为基准的美国国债」和这只新债券的收益率。

words.enDefinition: the proportion of a benchmark assigned to an investment or category

examples.en: The benchmark weight of the sector was lower than its share of the sample portfolio.
examples.zh: 该行业的「基准权重」低于它在样本投资组合中所占的比例。

examples.en: We checked each benchmark weight before calculating the differences shown in the comparison table.
examples.zh: 我们先核对每项「基准权重」，再计算比较表中的差值。

words.enDefinition: a person who enjoys ownership benefits despite another name appearing on the register

examples.en: The sample listed a nominee in the register while the customer remained the beneficial owner.
examples.zh: 样本在名册中登记了代名人，而客户仍是「受益所有人」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which voting document the beneficial owner received from the broker in the case.
examples.zh: 导师问，案例中「受益所有人」从券商收到的是哪种表决文件。

words.enDefinition: an offering where an intermediary seeks buyers without committing to buy unsold shares

examples.en: The fictional best-efforts offering did not require the participating broker to purchase shares left unsold.
examples.zh: 该虚构的「尽力代销发行」不要求参与券商购买未售出的股份。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what the sample's best-efforts offering agreement said about unsold shares.
examples.zh: 导师问，样本的「尽力代销发行」协议如何规定未售出的股份。

words.zhGloss: 报价方买入基准货币的汇率
words.enDefinition: The quoted rate at which the quoting institution is willing to buy the base currency.
acceptedZhAnswers: 报价方买入基准货币的汇率

examples.en: The mock table listed a bid exchange rate for the institution buying the base currency.
examples.zh: 模拟表格列出了「报价方买入基准货币的汇率」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whose perspective was represented by the bid exchange rate in the example.
examples.zh: 老师问，示例中的「报价方买入基准货币的汇率」是从哪一方的视角写的。

collocations: compare the bid exchange rate with the ask rate

words.enDefinition: the ratio of the amount bid for in a debt auction to the amount awarded, under the auction's definitions

examples.en: The bid-to-cover ratio rose as the amount bid increased and the amount awarded stayed roughly the same.
examples.zh: 投标额增加而获配额大致保持稳定，「投标额与获配额之比」随之上升。

examples.en: The tutor showed where to find the bid-to-cover ratio on the sample Treasury auction result.
examples.zh: 导师指给我们看，国债拍卖结果样本里哪里能查到「投标额与获配额之比」。

words.enDefinition: a bond whose quoted or issue price is equal to its face value

examples.en: The first example showed a bond at par before introducing a bond priced above face value.
examples.zh: 第一个例子先展示「按面值计价的债券」，随后才引入价格高于面值的债券。

examples.en: Our tutor used a bond at par to explain why price and face value sometimes match.
examples.zh: 导师用「按面值计价的债券」说明价格和面值为什么有时相同。

words.enDefinition: curvature in the relationship between bond price and yield, affecting the accuracy of a duration-only estimate

examples.en: We added a bond convexity term to improve the price estimate for the larger yield change.
examples.zh: 针对较大的收益率变化，我们加了一项「债券凸性」因素来改进价格估计。

examples.en: Our tutor used the curve to show why bond convexity mattered more for substantial yield changes.
examples.zh: 导师用这条曲线说明，为什么收益率变化较大时「债券凸性」更重要。

words.enDefinition: a promise or restriction in the bond documents requiring or limiting particular actions by an issuer

examples.en: One bond covenant required the company to provide specified reports after the end of each year.
examples.zh: 有一项「债券契约约定」要求公司在每年年末后提供指定报告。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which bond covenant applied to the proposed sale in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 导师问，虚构案例中的拟议出售适用哪一项「债券契约约定」。

words.enDefinition: a document defining bond terms and the duties of the appointed trustee, especially in UK and other trust-based issues

examples.en: We read the bond trust deed to see when the trustee could act for holders.
examples.zh: 我们读了「债券信托契约」，看受托人何时可以代表持有人行事。

examples.en: The bond trust deed described how holders would be notified of any change in terms.
examples.zh: 「债券信托契约」说明了更改条款时如何通知持有人。

collocations: duties under a bond trust deed
terms of a bond trust deed

words.enDefinition: an entity appointed to act for bondholders under the bond documents, with duties defined in those documents

examples.en: The sample indenture described when the bond trustee could send a notice on behalf of holders.
examples.zh: 示例契约说明，「债券受托人」可以在什么情况下代表持有人发通知。

examples.en: We checked the bond trustee information before reading the section about meetings and votes.
examples.zh: 我们先核对了「债券受托人」的信息，再读会议和投票章节。

words.enDefinition: a person or institution that holds a bond and has rights under its terms

examples.en: Each bondholder received a notice explaining the new date of the meeting in the case.
examples.zh: 案例中，每位「债券持有人」都收到了一份说明会议新日期的通知。

examples.en: I played a bondholder during our simulation and asked who was responsible for sending notices.
examples.zh: 模拟时我扮演「债券持有人」，询问谁负责发送通知。

words.enDefinition: a security recorded electronically in accounts without delivery of a physical certificate

examples.en: The guide explained how a book-entry security appeared on a statement from the securities account.
examples.zh: 指南解释了「簿记式证券」怎样显示在证券账户对账单上。

examples.en: We compared the record for a book-entry security with an image of an old certificate.
examples.zh: 我们把「簿记式证券」的记录与一张旧式实物凭证的图片作了比较。

words.zhGloss: 以簿记形式持有的股份
words.enDefinition: shares recorded electronically on an issuer's or intermediary's books instead of being represented by paper certificates
acceptedZhAnswers: 以簿记形式持有的股份

examples.en: The sample account listed book-entry shares as electronic entries on the company's ownership records.
examples.zh: 样本账户将「以簿记形式持有的股份」列为公司持股记录上的电子条目。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the record of book-entry shares with a sample paper share certificate.
examples.zh: 导师把「以簿记形式持有的股份」的记录与一张纸质股票样本作了比较。

words.enDefinition: collecting indications of demand to help price and allocate an issue

examples.en: The class reviewed bookbuilding through a case about how an indicative price range changed.
examples.zh: 同学们通过一个初步价格区间变化的案例学习了「簿记建档」。

examples.en: The tutor described bookbuilding before asking why the final offering price differed from the estimates.
examples.zh: 导师介绍了「簿记建档」，随后问最终发行价为什么和估计值不同。

words.enDefinition: the firm managing the record of orders or interest in an offering

examples.en: The sample bookrunner coordinated the collection of orders for the fictional company's share offer.
examples.zh: 样本中的「簿记管理人」协调收集虚构公司股票发售的订单。

examples.en: We found the bookrunner named beside the offering details in the mock prospectus.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟招募说明书的发行细节旁找到了「簿记管理人」的名称。

words.zhGloss: 英国基本税率计税代码
words.enDefinition: A UK PAYE code applying the basic rate to that job's pay
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国基本税率计税代码

examples.en: The example second job had a BR tax code on its payroll notice.
examples.zh: 示例中的第二份工作在薪税通知上标了「英国基本税率计税代码」。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed to the BR tax code before showing the deduction line.
examples.zh: 导师先指出「英国基本税率计税代码」，再展示预扣税那一行。

collocations: a payslip with a BR tax code
be on a BR tax code

words.enDefinition: the inflation rate implied by comparing nominal and inflation-linked bond yields at similar maturities

examples.en: We estimated the break-even inflation rate from two government securities with matching maturities in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中我们用两只期限匹配的政府债券估算「盈亏平衡通胀率」。

examples.en: The tutor noted that the break-even inflation rate could reflect factors besides expected changes in prices.
examples.zh: 导师指出，「盈亏平衡通胀率」还可能受到物价预期变化以外的因素影响。

words.enDefinition: a reduced sales charge once an eligible investment amount is reached

examples.en: The case used a breakpoint discount to show why purchase size affected the stated sales charge.
examples.zh: 案例通过「达额销售费折扣」说明，为什么申购金额会影响所列销售费。

examples.en: We read the sample prospectus to find the purchase amounts associated with each breakpoint discount.
examples.zh: 我们阅读样本招募说明书，找出了每档「达额销售费折扣」对应的申购金额。

words.enDefinition: an index designed to represent a broad securities market

examples.en: The US sample showed a broad-based securities market index beside the fund's average annual returns.
examples.zh: 美国样本在基金年化回报率旁列出一项「宽基证券市场指数」。

examples.en: Students compared the narrow sector index with the broad-based securities market index in the exercise.
examples.zh: 学生把练习中的窄行业指数与「宽基证券市场指数」作了比较。

collocations: compare returns with a broad-based securities market index
use a broad-based securities market index
report a broad-based securities market index

words.enDefinition: the role in which a broker acts in a trade

examples.en: The classroom confirmation listed broker capacity separately from the price and the quantity of shares.
examples.zh: 课堂使用的确认单把「券商在交易中的身份」与股价和成交数量分开列出。

examples.en: We found the broker capacity field and checked whether the firm acted for its own account.
examples.zh: 我们找到「券商在交易中的身份」栏，核对该机构是否为自己交易。

words.enDefinition: Information stating charges a borrower may owe to a credit intermediary

examples.en: The workshop compared a broker fee disclosure with the interest section of the loan paperwork.
examples.zh: 工作坊把「信贷经纪费披露」和贷款材料中的利息一栏作了比较。

examples.en: Case notes showed the broker fee disclosure separately from the dealer's product quote.
examples.zh: 案例材料把「信贷经纪费披露」和经销商的商品报价分开列出。

collocations: terms in the broker fee disclosure

words.enDefinition: a non-vote where a broker lacks both client instructions and voting discretion

examples.en: The sample report recorded a broker non-vote on the proposal requesting a change to share rights.
examples.zh: 样本报告在请求变更股份权利的提案上记录了一项「券商未代投票」。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished a broker non-vote from a shareholder's decision to abstain in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师在练习中区分了「券商未代投票」和股东决定弃权。

collocations: a broker non-vote on a proposal

words.enDefinition: a periodic record of a brokerage account's holdings and activity

examples.en: The sample brokerage statement listed three share holdings and two transactions during the month.
examples.zh: 样本「券商账户对账单」列出了三项股份持仓和当月的两笔交易。

examples.en: Our tutor used the brokerage statement to explain how the account's closing balance was reported.
examples.zh: 导师用「券商账户对账单」解释了账户如何列报期末余额。

words.enDefinition: a bond whose principal is repaid in a single payment at maturity

examples.en: The cash-flow schedule for the bullet bond showed all principal due on the final date.
examples.zh: 「到期一次还本债券」的现金流表显示，全部本金在最后一天到期。

examples.en: We compared the bullet bond with a bond that repaid principal in several scheduled amounts.
examples.zh: 我们把「到期一次还本债券」与分几期偿还本金的债券作了比较。

words.zhGloss: 支付报文业务规则校验
words.enDefinition: Checks that a payment message follows the rules applying to the type of transaction or service.
acceptedZhAnswers: 支付报文业务规则校验

examples.en: The training file distinguished business validation from the earlier check of the message structure itself.
examples.zh: 培训文件将「支付报文业务规则校验」与较早对报文自身结构的检查作了区分。

examples.en: We compared two business validation results after reading the explanation on each mock payment record.
examples.zh: 我们读过两份模拟付款记录上的说明后，对比了「支付报文业务规则校验」的结果。

words.enDefinition: formal permission for a company to buy back its own shares

examples.en: The board's buyback authorization in the example set a maximum amount for purchases of shares.
examples.zh: 示例中董事会的「股份回购授权」为买入股份规定了最高金额。

examples.en: Our group discussed why a buyback authorization did not itself show that shares had been bought.
examples.zh: 我们小组讨论了为什么「股份回购授权」本身并不说明公司已经购回股份。

collocations: the limits of a buyback authorization

words.enDefinition: the investment return earned within one calendar year

examples.en: The bar chart showed a separate calendar-year return for every full year in the example.
examples.zh: 柱状图对示例中的每个完整年份分别给出「按自然年列示的回报率」。

examples.en: The tutor asked how the latest calendar-year return differed from the figure reported since inception.
examples.zh: 导师问，最近的「自然年回报率」与自设立以来所报告的数字有什么差别。

words.enDefinition: terms limiting when or how the issuer may call a bond before maturity

examples.en: The sample note offered call protection for the early years before regular call dates began.
examples.zh: 在常规可赎回日期开始之前，样本票据最初几年有「限制提前赎回的保护」。

examples.en: The lecturer explained how call protection affected the expected timing of payments in the example.
examples.zh: 讲师解释了示例中的「限制提前赎回的保护」会怎样影响预期付款时间。

words.enDefinition: a schedule of dates or periods and associated prices at which a bond may be called

examples.en: The call schedule showed a lower redemption price later in the life of the bond.
examples.zh: 「赎回日期与价格表」显示，债券存续到后期时的赎回价格更低。

examples.en: We checked the call schedule while comparing two hypothetical notes with the same maturity date.
examples.zh: 我们比较到期日相同的两只假设票据时，查了「赎回日期与价格表」。

collocations: find a price on the call schedule

words.enDefinition: a bond that the issuer may redeem before maturity under the terms of the issue

examples.en: We read the dates on the callable bond before comparing it with a noncallable issue.
examples.zh: 我们先读「可提前赎回债券」上的日期，再把它和不可提前赎回的债券作比较。

examples.en: The lecturer used a callable bond to show how an issuer could repay debt before maturity.
examples.zh: 讲师用「可提前赎回债券」说明发行人可以怎样在到期前清偿债务。

words.enDefinition: a Canadian federal loan programme supporting eligible apprentices during periods of technical training

examples.en: The trades programme guide discussed the Canada Apprentice Loan in its section on funding technical training.
examples.zh: 技工项目指南在资助技术培训的章节讨论了「加拿大学徒贷款」。

examples.en: The adviser showed where a Canada Apprentice Loan would appear in an example aid record.
examples.zh: 顾问指出「加拿大学徒贷款」会显示在示例资助记录的什么位置。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大与安大略联合学生贷款
words.enDefinition: a student loan combining Canadian federal and Ontario provincial funding under one arrangement
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大与安大略联合学生贷款

examples.en: The example Canada-Ontario Integrated Student Loan included federal and provincial amounts in the same statement.
examples.zh: 示例「加拿大与安大略联合学生贷款」在同一份对账单里列了联邦及省级金额。

examples.en: Our adviser used a Canada-Ontario Integrated Student Loan to explain how joint funding is recorded.
examples.zh: 顾问拿一笔「加拿大与安大略联合学生贷款」解释了联合资助怎样记入记录。

collocations: receive a Canada-Ontario Integrated Student Loan
repay a Canada-Ontario Integrated Student Loan

words.zhGloss: 加拿大学生经济资助计划
words.enDefinition: the Canadian federal programme providing grants and loans for eligible students in post-secondary education
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大学生经济资助计划

examples.en: The booklet introduced the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program before listing its federal grants and loans.
examples.zh: 小册子先介绍「加拿大学生经济资助计划」，再列出其中的联邦助学金和贷款。

examples.en: The class discussed how provinces work with the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program to provide funding.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论了各省如何与「加拿大学生经济资助计划」配合提供资助。

collocations: funding under the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program
Canada Student Financial Assistance Program grants
Canada Student Financial Assistance Program eligibility

words.expression: Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students
words.lemma: canada student grant for full-time students
words.zhGloss: 加拿大全日制学生助学金
words.enDefinition: a Canadian federal grant for eligible full-time post-secondary students with financial need
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大全日制学生助学金
acceptedEnVariants: Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students

examples.en: The sample aid package listed the Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students before showing the loan amount.
examples.zh: 示例资助组合先列出「加拿大全日制学生助学金」，再显示贷款金额。

examples.en: We saw the Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students in a guide to Canadian federal aid.
examples.zh: 我们在加拿大联邦资助指南里看到了「加拿大全日制学生助学金」。

collocations: receive the Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students
Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students eligibility
amount of the Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students

words.expression: Canada Student Grant for Part-Time Students
words.lemma: canada student grant for part-time students
words.zhGloss: 加拿大非全日制学生助学金
words.enDefinition: a Canadian federal grant for eligible part-time post-secondary students with financial need
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大非全日制学生助学金
acceptedEnVariants: Canada Student Grant for Part-Time Students

examples.en: The adviser explained which figure in the example was the Canada Student Grant for Part-Time Students.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了案例中的哪个数额对应「加拿大非全日制学生助学金」。

examples.zh: 大学护理专业指南在必修实习章节介绍了「澳洲联邦必修实习补助」。

examples.en: Our adviser explained where the Commonwealth Prac Payment appeared on the example funding checklist.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了示例资助清单上「澳洲联邦必修实习补助」在哪一项。

collocations: apply for the Commonwealth Prac Payment
eligibility for the Commonwealth Prac Payment

words.zhGloss: 澳洲联邦补贴就读名额
words.enDefinition: an Australian higher education place for which the government pays part of the tuition cost
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲联邦补贴就读名额

examples.en: The university's sample offer showed a Commonwealth supported place with a separate student contribution amount.
examples.zh: 大学的录取样本显示「澳洲联邦补贴就读名额」，还单列了学生自付费用金额。

examples.en: The adviser explained how a Commonwealth supported place differed from a place charging full tuition.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「澳洲联邦补贴就读名额」与全额收取学费的名额之间的区别。

collocations: enrol in a Commonwealth supported place
eligibility for a Commonwealth supported place

words.enDefinition: in a Treasury auction, a bid specifying the yield, discount rate or discount margin sought

examples.en: The example showed a competitive bid alongside the final yield reported for that Treasury auction.
examples.zh: 示例把「竞争性投标」与本次国债拍卖通报的最终收益率并排列出。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why a competitive bid could be accepted in full or only in part.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么「竞争性投标」可能被全额接受，也可能只中标一部分。

collocations: competitive bid at a Treasury auction

words.enDefinition: A promise to support completion or cover agreed costs if it fails

examples.en: The sponsor provided a completion guarantee for the building phase in our case.
examples.zh: 在案例中，发起人为建设阶段提供了「完工保证」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed where the completion guarantee ended on the project timeline.
examples.zh: 导师在项目时间轴上指出了「完工保证」何时结束。

words.enDefinition: A check that a completed asset meets agreed operating requirements

examples.en: The completion test in the example checked whether the pumps met capacity requirements.
examples.zh: 示例里的「完工验收测试」检查了泵能否达到规定的能力。

examples.en: We placed the completion test before the first day of the operating period.
examples.zh: 我们把「完工验收测试」安排在运营期第一天之前。

collocations: the results of a completion test

words.enDefinition: a comparison standard combining weighted returns from several components

examples.en: Our composite benchmark combined two index returns in the proportions specified on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们的「复合业绩基准」按课堂练习表指定的比例组合了两项指数回报率。

examples.en: The factsheet explained how the composite benchmark changed when one component's weight was adjusted.
examples.zh: 概况表解释，一个成分权重调整后，「复合业绩基准」会发生什么变化。

collocations: compare performance with a composite benchmark

words.enDefinition: in New Zealand's Student Loan scheme, fees required by an education provider for enrolment in a course

examples.en: The New Zealand sample loan covered compulsory course fees paid directly to the education provider.
examples.zh: 新西兰的示例贷款用于「必缴课程费用」，款项直接付给院校。

examples.en: The adviser distinguished compulsory course fees from the cost of textbooks bought separately.
examples.zh: 顾问把「必缴课程费用」和单独购买教科书的开支区分开。

collocations: compulsory course fees charged by the provider

words.enDefinition: a study loan repayment required by Australian rules, usually calculated as part of the tax assessment

examples.en: The example notice included a compulsory repayment and listed its amount separately from income tax.
examples.zh: 样本通知里有一笔「强制还款额」，其金额与所得税分开列出。

examples.en: The adviser explained where the compulsory repayment appeared in the Australian tax assessment example.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「强制还款额」在澳大利亚税务评估示例的什么位置。

words.enDefinition: A contract granting rights to operate a facility or service

examples.en: The concession agreement set out who could operate the bus terminal.
examples.zh: 「特许经营协议」规定了谁可以运营公交总站。

examples.en: Our class found the handback provisions in the draft concession agreement.
examples.zh: 全班在「特许经营协议」草案里找到了移交条款。

words.enDefinition: The agreed span during which a concession remains in force

examples.en: The concession period ended before the last year in our demand forecast.
examples.zh: 「特许经营期限」在需求预测的最后一年之前就结束了。

examples.en: We marked the end of the concession period on the project timeline.
examples.zh: 我们在项目时间轴上标出了「特许经营期限」的终点。

collocations: the end of the concession period
cash flows over the concession period

words.enDefinition: Acceptance of a loan application subject to further requirements being met

examples.en: The sample conditional loan approval required a clearer copy of the fictional applicant's payslip.
examples.zh: 「贷款有条件获批」的样本要求虚构申请人提供更清晰的工资单副本。

examples.en: We reviewed the conditional loan approval and found that the address evidence was pending.
examples.zh: 我们查阅了「贷款有条件获批」的通知，发现地址证明还有待提交。

words.enDefinition: A sale arrangement transferring ownership only after specified conditions are met

examples.en: The fictional conditional sale agreement stated when ownership of the bicycle would pass.
examples.zh: 虚构的「附条件销售协议」写明了自行车的所有权何时转移。

examples.en: Our class compared the rights described in two sample conditional sale agreement forms.
examples.zh: 全班比较了两份「附条件销售协议」表单样本描述的权利。

collocations: terms of a conditional sale agreement

words.enDefinition: Requirements that must be met before a borrower can receive funds

examples.en: The checklist included insurance records among the conditions precedent to drawdown for the construction loan.
examples.zh: 清单把保险记录列为这笔建设贷款的「提款先决条件」之一。

examples.en: Our sample schedule listed the conditions precedent to drawdown separately from later reporting duties.
examples.zh: 我们的进度表样本把「提款先决条件」和后续报告义务分开列出。

collocations: meet the conditions precedent to drawdown

words.enDefinition: official confirmation from a provider that a student is attending the course, used in administering some funding

examples.en: The university sent confirmation of attendance after completing its checks for the start of term.
examples.zh: 大学完成开学核查后，发出了「课程到读确认」。

examples.en: The tuition funding guidance explained when the provider would submit confirmation of attendance to the funding service.
examples.zh: 学费资助指南说明了院校会在什么时候向资助机构提交「课程到读确认」。

words.enDefinition: in UK student finance, confirmation from a university or college that a student has registered on the course

examples.en: The funding portal was still waiting for confirmation of registration two days after classes started.
examples.zh: 开课两天后，资助门户还在等待学院发出「课程注册确认」。

examples.en: I asked whether confirmation of registration had been sent before the first payment was scheduled.
examples.zh: 我问，在安排首次发放前，学校有没有发出「课程注册确认」。

words.enDefinition: a formal request for bondholders to consent to proposed changes or other actions under the bond documents

examples.en: The issuer sent a consent solicitation explaining its proposed change to the reporting deadline.
examples.zh: 发行人发出「征求债券持有人同意」的文件，解释了拟议的报告截止日期变更。

examples.en: We counted the responses to the sample consent solicitation during the classroom exercise on bond terms.
examples.zh: 在有关债券条款的课堂练习中，我们统计了「征求债券持有人同意」样本的回复。

words.enDefinition: A projection using prices from a single base period throughout

examples.en: The constant-price forecast kept the unit price unchanged to isolate expected volume growth.
examples.zh: 「不变价格预测」保持单价不变，以便单独观察预计销量增长。

examples.en: We noted the base year before reading the constant-price forecast in the case.
examples.zh: 阅读案例中的「不变价格预测」之前，我们记下了基准年份。

collocations: the base year in a constant-price forecast

words.enDefinition: Conversion of construction borrowing to a term loan after specified milestones

examples.en: The case scheduled construction-to-term conversion after the plant passed its completion tests.
examples.zh: 案例把「建设贷款转长期贷款」安排在工厂通过完工测试之后。

examples.en: Our diagram placed construction-to-term conversion between construction funding and the repayment schedule.
examples.zh: 我们的图把「建设贷款转长期贷款」放在建设资金与还款进度表之间。

words.enDefinition: A request by a consumer to see their own credit information

examples.en: The report labelled my fictional request as a consumer-initiated inquiry in the access log.
examples.zh: 报告在访问日志里把我模拟提出的请求标为「本人发起的查询」。

examples.en: The lecture explained why a consumer-initiated inquiry was different from a lender's request.
examples.zh: 老师解释了「本人发起的查询」和贷款机构查询的区别。

collocations: a consumer-initiated inquiry on the file

words.enDefinition: an organisation that regularly assembles or evaluates consumer information to provide consumer reports under US law

examples.en: The sample letter named a consumer reporting agency that compiled background reports for landlords.
examples.zh: 示例信里提到一家为房东汇编背景报告的「消费者信息报告机构」。

examples.en: Our lecturer compared the information held by a consumer reporting agency with our banking records.
examples.zh: 老师把「消费者信息报告机构」持有的信息与银行记录作了比较。

collocations: data held by a consumer reporting agency
report from a consumer reporting agency

words.enDefinition: a sales charge imposed on redemption under stated holding conditions

examples.en: The hypothetical contingent deferred sales charge applied when shares were sold before the stated holding period ended.
examples.zh: 假设中的「有条件递延销售费」适用于在规定持有期结束前卖出的份额。

examples.en: We found the contingent deferred sales charge in a footnote to the sample fee table.
examples.zh: 我们在样本费用表的脚注里找到了「有条件递延销售费」。

collocations: incur a contingent deferred sales charge
waive a contingent deferred sales charge
a schedule for the contingent deferred sales charge

words.enDefinition: Revenue due under already agreed arrangements with buyers or counterparties

examples.en: Our worksheet showed contracted revenue separately from sales at future market prices.
examples.zh: 我们的练习表把「合同约定收入」和按未来市价销售产生的收入分开显示。

examples.en: The lender stress tested contracted revenue after considering risks to the contract.
examples.zh: 贷款机构考虑合同风险后，对「合同约定收入」做了压力测试。

collocations: separate contracted revenue from market sales

words.enDefinition: an agreement in which a provider gives up specified fees

examples.en: The hypothetical adviser agreed to a contractual fee waiver lasting through the dates in our case.
examples.zh: 假设中的投资顾问同意「合同约定的费用减免」，有效期涵盖案例所列日期。

examples.en: The footnote said that the contractual fee waiver applied to only one of the share classes.
examples.zh: 脚注说明，「合同约定的费用减免」只适用于其中一个份额类别。

words.enDefinition: the amount of a portfolio's overall return attributable to a component

examples.en: The report showed each holding's contribution to return in percentage points for the quarter.
examples.zh: 报告以百分点列示了该季度各项持仓的「回报贡献」。

examples.en: We checked why one sizeable holding made a negative contribution to return in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了练习中的一项大额持仓为什么带来了负的「回报贡献」。

words.zhGloss: 资料提供人的信息披露同意与授权
words.enDefinition: a FAFSA contributor's agreement to share identifying information and authorise the receipt, use and permitted onward disclosure of federal tax information
acceptedZhAnswers: 资料提供人的信息披露同意与授权

examples.en: The sample FAFSA showed a separate section for contributor consent and approval before the signature.
examples.zh: FAFSA 样表在签名之前单设了一个「资料提供人的信息披露同意与授权」栏。

examples.en: The adviser explained contributor consent and approval while showing us how the sample application was organised.
examples.zh: 顾问展示申请样表的结构时，解释了「资料提供人的信息披露同意与授权」。

words.enDefinition: an invitation asking a required person to complete their section of a US FAFSA form

examples.en: The student checked whether the contributor invitation had reached the parent listed on the form.
examples.zh: 学生查看了「资料提供人填写邀请」是否已送到表里登记的家长那里。

examples.en: The aid office showed us where the contributor invitation appeared in the application status page.
examples.zh: 助学办公室指给我们看，「资料提供人填写邀请」在申请状态页的什么位置。

words.enDefinition: a shareholder able to direct key company decisions through voting power or other rights

examples.en: The fictional company's controlling shareholder had enough votes to determine who joined the board.
examples.zh: 虚构公司的「控股股东」拥有足够票数来决定谁进入董事会。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how a controlling shareholder could hold fewer shares than all other owners combined.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「控股股东」的持股数量可能少于其他所有股东的持股总和。

words.enDefinition: Conversion of funds into another currency when the receiving institution handles an incoming payment.

examples.en: The accounting example described conversion on receipt before the money was credited to the local account.
examples.zh: 财务示例说明，款项记入当地账户前发生了「收款端兑换币种」。

examples.en: We identified conversion on receipt as the step that changed how the deposit appeared in local currency.
examples.zh: 我们确认，是「收款端兑换币种」改变了入账记录用当地币种列示的金额。

words.enDefinition: a bond that can be converted into another security, typically the issuer's shares, under specified terms

examples.en: The class reviewed a convertible bond that could be converted into shares of the same company.
examples.zh: 课堂上我们看了一只「可转换债券」，它可以换成同一家公司的股票。

examples.en: The terms of the convertible bond gave the dates when holders could exercise the conversion right.
examples.zh: 「可转换债券」条款列出了持有人可行使转换权的日期。

collocations: convert a convertible bond into shares

words.enDefinition: preferred shares that can convert into another share class on specified terms

examples.en: The sample's convertible preferred stock could become common shares at the ratio stated in the terms.
examples.zh: 样本中的「可转换优先股」可以按条款所列比例转为普通股。

examples.en: We compared the dividend terms of convertible preferred stock with those of the sample's common shares.
examples.zh: 我们把「可转换优先股」的股息条款与样本普通股的条款作了比较。

collocations: convert convertible preferred stock into common shares

words.enDefinition: an instruction selecting among options in a corporate action

examples.en: The statement recorded a corporate action election choosing cash instead of shares in the sample merger.
examples.zh: 对账单记录了持有人在样本合并中作出领取现金的「公司行动选择指示」。

examples.en: We checked whether the holder's corporate action election was recorded correctly in the example.
examples.zh: 我们核对了示例中持有人的「公司行动选择指示」是否记载正确。

collocations: record a holder's corporate action election

words.enDefinition: a communication describing a change affecting a security or its holders

examples.en: The corporate action notice explained how the fictional stock split would affect positions in brokerage accounts.
examples.zh: 「公司行动通知」解释了虚构的股票拆分会怎样影响券商账户中的持仓。

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the corporate action notice listed the dates for the proposed merger.
examples.zh: 导师问，「公司行动通知」在哪儿列出了拟议合并相关日期。

collocations: dates in a corporate action notice

words.enDefinition: Banking in which one bank provides services or processes payments on behalf of another bank.

examples.en: The lecture used correspondent banking to explain why several institutions might handle one international payment.
examples.zh: 讲座用「代理银行业务」解释，为什么一笔跨境付款可能经由多家机构处理。

examples.en: We discussed correspondent banking while following a sample payment from one country's bank to another.
examples.zh: 我们追踪一笔从一国银行到另一国银行的示例付款时，讨论了「代理银行业务」。

words.enDefinition: a change to the expense estimate a school uses when calculating student financial aid

examples.en: The aid office discussed a cost of attendance adjustment after reviewing receipts for required equipment.
examples.zh: 助学办公室审阅必备器材的收据后，讨论了「就学总费用调整」。

examples.en: The revised transport estimate appeared beneath a cost of attendance adjustment on my notice.
examples.zh: 我收到的通知在「就学总费用调整」下面列出了修改后的交通费用估算。

collocations: request a cost of attendance adjustment
review a cost of attendance adjustment
approve a cost of attendance adjustment

words.enDefinition: Credit available to cover eligible costs above a project's agreed budget

examples.en: The contract listed a cost overrun facility beside the main construction loan.
examples.zh: 合同把「超支备用融资额度」列在主要建设贷款旁边。

examples.en: We checked when the cost overrun facility could be used in the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构的协议里查看了何时可以使用「超支备用融资额度」。

collocations: draw on a cost overrun facility

words.enDefinition: the distribution of portfolio assets by country

examples.en: The country allocation in the factsheet used the issuer locations described in its footnote.
examples.zh: 概况表中「按国家划分的配置」使用脚注所述的发行人所在地口径。

examples.en: The exercise asked why country allocation figures might differ across two reports for the same fund.
examples.zh: 练习问，同一只基金的两份报告，「按国家划分的配置」数据为什么可能不同。

words.enDefinition: A court decision in England or Wales ordering payment, often for debt

examples.en: The report exercise showed a county court judgment relating to an unpaid bill.
examples.zh: 报告练习中有一份涉及未付账单的「郡法院判决」。

examples.en: The tutor explained what a county court judgment meant in the fictional borrower's case.
examples.zh: 导师解释了「郡法院判决」在那位虚构借款人的案例中意味着什么。

words.enDefinition: the highest coupon rate permitted by the terms of a variable-rate instrument

examples.en: The sample note reached its coupon cap after the reference rate rose during the year.
examples.zh: 示例票据的参考利率在年内上涨后，票面利率触及「票面利率上限」。

examples.en: We found the coupon cap in the same section of the prospectus as the reference rate.
examples.zh: 我们在募集文件介绍参考利率的那个章节，找到了「票面利率上限」。

words.enDefinition: the lowest coupon rate that can apply under the terms of a variable-rate instrument

examples.en: The coupon floor came into effect when the reference rate fell in the sample calculation.
examples.zh: 示例计算中参考利率下降后，「票面利率下限」开始起作用。

examples.en: The prospectus placed the coupon floor beside a separate provision setting the highest rate allowed.
examples.zh: 募集文件把「票面利率下限」和规定最高利率的条款并排列出。

words.enDefinition: a margin added to or subtracted from a reference rate to determine a floating coupon

examples.en: The terms specified a coupon spread to be added to the reference rate at each reset.
examples.zh: 条款约定，每次重设利率时，都在参考利率上加上「票息利差」。

examples.en: We checked whether the coupon spread stayed fixed when the note's reference rate moved higher.
examples.zh: 票据的参考利率走高时，我们检查了「票息利差」是否保持原值。

collocations: coupon spread over the reference rate

words.enDefinition: the share of a full-time course load a student is taking, expressed as a percentage

examples.en: The Canadian aid form asked for the course load percentage for the upcoming period of study.
examples.zh: 加拿大资助表要求填写接下来就读期间的「修读量占全日制比例」。

examples.en: The adviser checked the course load percentage after the student withdrew from one of the classes.
examples.zh: 学生退出一门课后，顾问核对了「修读量占全日制比例」。

words.enDefinition: in New Zealand's Student Loan scheme, a borrowing component for expenses such as books or equipment used for study

examples.en: The New Zealand example showed course-related costs for books separately from fees paid to the provider.
examples.zh: 新西兰的例子把购书用的「课程相关开支」与付给院校的费用分开显示。

examples.en: Our guide listed a few course-related costs that a student might see in a funding estimate.
examples.zh: 指南列了几项学生可能在资助估算看到的「课程相关开支」。

words.enDefinition: a failure to comply with a particular requirement or restriction in a debt agreement

examples.en: The case described a covenant breach after the issuer failed to provide the required statements.
examples.zh: 发行人没提供规定需要的报表，案例把这称为「违反契约约定」。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the covenant breach in the example had been resolved by the company.
examples.zh: 导师问，案例公司是否已解决那次「违反契约约定」的问题。

words.zhGloss: 距触发契约限值的余量
words.enDefinition: the margin between an actual or forecast financial measure and the limit in a covenant
acceptedZhAnswers: 距触发契约限值的余量

examples.en: The example showed less covenant headroom after the company's forecast interest expense increased for the quarter.
examples.zh: 公司的季度预测利息支出增加后，例子里的「距触发契约限值的余量」变小了。

examples.en: We calculated covenant headroom by comparing the forecast ratio with the limit in the agreement.
examples.zh: 我们把预测比率与协议里的限值作比较，算出「距触发契约限值的余量」。

words.enDefinition: an agreement by the relevant creditor or holders to waive a specified covenant requirement or breach

examples.en: The fictional borrower obtained a covenant waiver covering the missed reporting date in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，虚构借款人拿到了一项涵盖错过报告日的「契约要求豁免」。

examples.en: Our lecturer explained why a covenant waiver for one breach did not remove the entire clause.
examples.zh: 讲师解释了为什么对一次违约的「契约要求豁免」不等于删除整个条款。

words.enDefinition: A separate transfer of funds used to settle an underlying payment whose instruction is sent separately.

examples.en: The diagram showed a cover payment alongside the separate instruction about the underlying customer transfer.
examples.zh: 图中同时列出一笔「补偿付款」和对应的单独客户汇款指令。

examples.en: We matched the cover payment with the related customer transfer in the set of practice records.
examples.zh: 我们把练习记录中的「补偿付款」和对应的客户汇款配对。

collocations: match a cover payment with the related instruction

words.zhGloss: 涵盖在汇款披露中的第三方费用
words.enDefinition: fees charged to the recipient by third parties in connection with a US remittance transfer, excluding fees classified as non-covered under its rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 涵盖在汇款披露中的第三方费用

examples.en: The mock receipt grouped covered third-party fees separately from the charge set by the transfer provider.
examples.zh: 模拟回执把「涵盖在汇款披露中的第三方费用」和汇款服务商自行收取的费用分开列示。

examples.en: Our class compared covered third-party fees with the warning about other charges in the sample disclosure.
examples.zh: 我们班把「涵盖在汇款披露中的第三方费用」与披露示例中有关其他收费的提醒作了比较。

collocations: list covered third-party fees on the form

words.zhGloss: 加拿大退休金计划缴费
words.enDefinition: Money paid into Canada's public pension plan through eligible earnings
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大退休金计划缴费

examples.en: The example earnings slip listed CPP contributions in a box below wages.
examples.zh: 收入税务单样本在工资下面一栏列出「加拿大退休金计划缴费」。

examples.en: We compared the CPP contributions across two mock slips from separate employers.
examples.zh: 我们对照了不同雇主的两张模拟单据上的「加拿大退休金计划缴费」。

words.enDefinition: the assets or cash delivered to create ETF shares

examples.en: The sample's creation basket included several securities and a small amount of cash.
examples.zh: 样本中的「ETF申购组合」包括几种证券和少量现金。

examples.en: Our exercise compared the creation basket with the ETF's complete holdings on the same date.
examples.zh: 练习把「ETF申购组合」和该 ETF 同日的全部持仓作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a large block of shares created or redeemed directly with an ETF

examples.en: The sample ETF prospectus defined a creation unit as a block of fifty thousand shares.
examples.zh: 样本 ETF 招募说明书将一个「ETF申购单位」定义为五万份基金份额。

examples.en: The tutor asked why one creation unit was much larger than a typical exchange order.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么一个「ETF申购单位」远大于普通的交易所订单。

collocations: the size of a creation unit

words.enDefinition: The party that receives rights transferred under a credit agreement

examples.en: The mock notice gave the name of the credit agreement assignee in bold.
examples.zh: 模拟通知用粗体列出了「信贷协议受让方」的名称。

examples.en: We looked for the credit agreement assignee after reading about the transfer in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上读完转让说明后，找了找「信贷协议受让方」是谁。

collocations: a notice from the credit agreement assignee

words.enDefinition: An intermediary who connects prospective borrowers with credit providers

examples.en: The fictional credit broker introduced the student to two local lenders.
examples.zh: 虚构的「信贷经纪人」把那位学生介绍给两家本地贷款机构。

examples.en: We checked which company was named as the credit broker on the form.
examples.zh: 我们查了表单上哪家公司被列为「信贷经纪机构」。

collocations: a fee charged by a credit broker

words.enDefinition: The UK activity of arranging or facilitating access to borrowing

examples.en: The seminar distinguished credit broking from providing funds directly to a borrower.
examples.zh: 研讨课区分了「信贷中介业务」和直接向借款人放款。

examples.en: The class identified credit broking in an example involving a fictional dealer.
examples.zh: 全班在涉及虚构经销商的示例中识别出了「信贷中介业务」。

words.enDefinition: A lender's offer on terms different from those the applicant requested

examples.en: The lender made a credit counteroffer for a smaller amount in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，贷款机构提出了金额较低的「信贷条件变更要约」。

examples.en: We discussed a credit counteroffer that changed only the proposed repayment period.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了一份只改了拟议还款期限的「信贷条件变更要约」。

words.enDefinition: The currency in which an amount is credited to the receiving account.

examples.en: The credit currency appeared beside the university's deposit amount in the practice account statement.
examples.zh: 模拟账户流水在大学的入账金额旁列出了「入账币种」。

examples.en: The class compared the credit currency with the currency used on the payer's original receipt.
examples.zh: 同学们把「入账币种」与付款方原始回执使用的币种作了比较。

collocations: display the credit currency on a statement

words.enDefinition: A communication reporting the outcome of an application for credit

examples.en: The credit decision notice reached the fictional applicant after the lender finished its checks.
examples.zh: 贷款机构做完核实后，虚构申请人收到了「授信决定通知」。

examples.en: We identified the result in the credit decision notice before looking at the reasons.
examples.zh: 我们先在「授信决定通知」里确认结果，再看理由。

words.enDefinition: The process or result of linking identifying details to a credit file

examples.en: The sample credit file match failed because the two dates of birth were different.
examples.zh: 由于两个出生日期不同，示例里的「信用档案匹配」失败了。

examples.en: A correct credit file match in the exercise required more than a shared surname.
examples.zh: 在这个练习里，只凭同姓无法正确完成「信用档案匹配」。

words.enDefinition: a movement of an issuer or obligation from one credit rating category to another over time

examples.en: The worksheet used credit migration to compare changes in rating groups across several annual observations.
examples.zh: 练习表通过「信用评级迁移」比较了连续几年各评级类别的变化。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished credit migration from changes in the market price of the same notes.
examples.zh: 导师把「信用评级迁移」与同一批票据市场价格的变化作了区分。

words.enDefinition: A Swift tracking reason indicating that credit to the recipient account depends on receipt of cover funds.

examples.en: The Swift training note used credit pending funds when the receiving institution still awaited cover funds.
examples.zh: 收款机构还在等补偿付款提供的结算资金时，Swift 培训说明用了「待资金到位后入账」这一表述。

examples.en: The class read credit pending funds and compared it with a later confirmation of credit.
examples.zh: 班里阅读了「待资金到位后入账」，再和稍后出现的入账确认作了比较。

collocations: a reason marked credit pending funds
look up the credit pending funds explanation

words.enDefinition: A permitted departure from a lender's usual rules for reviewing applications

examples.en: The handout showed a credit policy exception approved by a second reviewer.
examples.zh: 讲义展示了一项由第二位审核员批准的「信贷审批政策例外」。

examples.en: We discussed why the fictional lender documented a credit policy exception in its review.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了虚构的贷款机构为什么要在审核中记下一项「信贷审批政策例外」。

words.enDefinition: A letter from an institution describing someone's record of handling credit

examples.en: The credit reference letter in our exercise described how long the account had been open.
examples.zh: 练习里的「信用情况证明信」说明了账户开立了多久。

examples.en: The fictional lender treated the credit reference letter as supporting evidence about earlier payments.
examples.zh: 虚构贷款机构把「信用情况证明信」作为以往还款表现的佐证。

words.enDefinition: A person or organisation to whom a credit report was supplied

examples.en: The sample disclosure listed a credit report recipient beside the reason for access.
examples.zh: 披露样本在访问原因旁列出了一家「信用报告接收方」。

examples.en: An estate agency appeared as a credit report recipient in our fictional rental application.
examples.zh: 在虚构的租房申请里，一家房产中介被列为「信用报告接收方」。

words.enDefinition: Collecting or supplying information about how people manage financial accounts

examples.en: The handout explained how credit reporting differs from a monthly statement sent to customers.
examples.zh: 讲义解释了「信用数据报送」和寄给客户的月账单有什么区别。

examples.en: We discussed how delayed credit reporting left a paid balance on the sample file.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么「信用数据报送」延迟，会让已结清的余额仍出现在档案样本上。

words.enDefinition: A delay between an account change and its appearance on a report

examples.en: A credit reporting lag explained why the cleared balance still appeared in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习里结清的余额仍然显示，是因为「信用数据报送滞后」。

examples.en: Our tutor illustrated credit reporting lag with two sample reports issued weeks apart.
examples.zh: 导师用相隔几周出具的两份报告样本说明了「信用数据报送滞后」。

collocations: account for a credit reporting lag

words.enDefinition: A measure used to estimate the chance of missed repayment

examples.en: The lecturer used previous borrowing patterns as a credit risk indicator in the exercise.
examples.zh: 老师在练习中把以往借款方式作为一个「信用风险指标」。

examples.en: The table showed how a credit risk indicator changed across three hypothetical applicants.
examples.zh: 表格显示一个「信用风险指标」在三位假设申请人之间有何变化。

collocations: a credit risk indicator in a model

words.enDefinition: An identifier for a factor that affected a credit score

examples.en: The sample credit score reason code pointed to recent changes in the account history.
examples.zh: 样本中的「信用评分原因代码」对应账户历史近期发生的变化。

examples.en: I matched the credit score reason code with the explanation printed below the fictional score.
examples.zh: 我把「信用评分原因代码」和虚构评分下方印出的解释对上了。

collocations: look up a credit score reason code
explain a credit score reason code
a listed credit score reason code

words.enDefinition: A UK credit file entry recording that a search took place

examples.en: A credit search footprint showed which company had looked at the mock applicant's file.
examples.zh: 一条「信用查询留痕」显示了哪家公司查过模拟申请人的档案。

examples.en: We compared one credit search footprint with the date printed on the application form.
examples.zh: 我们对照了一条「信用查询留痕」和申请表印的日期。

collocations: a credit search footprint on the file

words.enDefinition: a yield difference between debt with credit risk and a comparable benchmark or lower-risk debt

examples.en: The chart showed a wider credit spread for the corporate bond than for its peers.
examples.zh: 图表显示，这只公司债券的「信用利差」比同类债券更大。

examples.en: We calculated the credit spread after choosing a government bond of similar maturity as the benchmark.
examples.zh: 我们选了一只到期时间相近的国债作为基准，然后计算「信用利差」。

words.enDefinition: A person who evaluates applications and the risk of granting credit

examples.en: A credit underwriter reviewed the application after the fictional borrower's income changed.
examples.zh: 虚构借款人的收入变化后，一位「信贷审核员」重新看了申请。

examples.en: The credit underwriter in our case study asked about two different addresses.
examples.zh: 案例中的「信贷审核员」询问了两个不同的地址。

collocations: refer an application to a credit underwriter

words.enDefinition: A tracking status indicating that funds have reached the recipient's bank in the reporting flow.

examples.en: The sample showed credited to beneficiary bank before the university confirmed its own account entry.
examples.zh: 大学确认自己账户的入账记录之前，示例显示「已到达收款银行」。

examples.en: We compared credited to beneficiary bank with the message confirming deposit into the customer's account.
examples.zh: 我们把「已到达收款银行」与确认已存入客户账户的报文作了比较。

collocations: a status marked credited to beneficiary bank
a tracker showing credited to beneficiary bank

words.enDefinition: The financial institution servicing the payee's account in the payment message.

examples.en: The creditor agent was the institution servicing the university's account in this practice example.
examples.zh: 在这个练习例子里，「收款方账户服务机构」是为大学提供账户的金融机构。

examples.en: The table showed the creditor agent on its own line beside the payee in the payment.
examples.zh: 表格在收款方旁单独列了一行，注明「收款方账户服务机构」。

collocations: check the name of the creditor agent

words.enDefinition: A reference used by the creditor to identify and reconcile the incoming payment.

examples.en: The creditor reference let the accounts team match the model payment to the corresponding invoice.
examples.zh: 「收款方对账用参考号」让财务团队把模拟付款与相应的账单匹配起来。

examples.en: The group's report distinguished the creditor reference from the bank's code for tracking the payment.
examples.zh: 小组报告区分了「收款方对账用参考号」和银行用来追踪付款的编号。

collocations: match a payment with its creditor reference
check the creditor reference on the invoice

words.enDefinition: The review of a person's suitability for borrowing and repaying credit

examples.en: Our case study began with a creditworthiness assessment for a small personal loan.
examples.zh: 案例从一笔小额个人贷款的「信用状况评估」开始。

examples.en: The lecturer described how a creditworthiness assessment looked beyond a single score.
examples.zh: 老师讲了「信用状况评估」为何会参考一个分数以外的信息。

words.enDefinition: a clause triggered when specified other debt is declared due early after a default

examples.en: The lawyer in the case explained when the cross-acceleration clause would apply to the separate note.
examples.zh: 案例中的律师说明了「交叉加速到期条款」会在什么情况下适用于另一只票据。

examples.en: Our tutor used the cross-acceleration clause to distinguish a missed payment from formally accelerating a loan.
examples.zh: 导师用「交叉加速到期条款」区分了漏还一笔款和正式宣布贷款提前到期。

words.enDefinition: A payment in which the payer and recipient are debited and credited in different currencies.

examples.en: The worksheet showed a cross-currency payment for a course fee charged in the recipient's currency.
examples.zh: 练习表展示了一笔「跨币种付款」，课程费用用收款方币种计价。

examples.en: We compared a cross-currency payment with a cross-border example where both sides used the same currency.
examples.zh: 我们把一笔「跨币种付款」与一笔双方使用同一币种的跨境付款作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a clause under which a covered default on other debt can trigger a default under this agreement

examples.en: In the case, our group reviewed the cross-default clause after another covered loan went into default.
examples.zh: 案例中的另一笔纳入条款的贷款发生违约后，我们小组查看了「交叉违约条款」。

examples.en: The sample cross-default clause defined which other debts were covered before listing possible consequences.
examples.zh: 示例「交叉违约条款」先定义涵盖的其他债务，再列出可能的后果。

words.enDefinition: An exchange rate between two currencies derived using their rates against a common third currency.

examples.en: We calculated a cross rate from two fictional currency quotations in the central bank reading exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用央行阅读练习里的两组虚构汇率报价计算了「交叉汇率」。

examples.en: The worksheet showed the cross rate separately from the two original quotes used to derive it.
examples.zh: 练习表将「交叉汇率」和推算它所用的两笔原始报价分开列示。

words.zhGloss: 项目净现值交叉折现率
words.enDefinition: The discount rate at which two projects have equal net present values
acceptedZhAnswers: 项目净现值交叉折现率

examples.en: The two plotted lines met at the crossover rate in our graph.
examples.zh: 在我们画的图里，两条线在「项目净现值交叉折现率」处相交。

examples.en: We compared project rankings above and below the crossover rate in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上比较了高于和低于「项目净现值交叉折现率」时的项目排序。

collocations: compare project ranks around the crossover rate

words.enDefinition: The PAYE method using pay and tax so far that year

examples.en: On a cumulative basis, the example calculation included pay from earlier months.
examples.zh: 在「按年内累计计税」的情况下，示例计算包括之前几个月的工资。

examples.en: The worksheet used a cumulative basis to explain two employees with different pay histories.
examples.zh: 练习表用「按年内累计计税」来说明两名员工此前工资记录不同的情况。

collocations: calculate PAYE on a cumulative basis
apply a code on a cumulative basis

words.enDefinition: the overall percentage change in value across a period

examples.en: We calculated cumulative return across three years by combining the annual growth factors in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把练习中的年度增长因子连乘，计算三年「累计回报率」。

examples.en: The full-period cumulative return was shown beside the average yearly figure in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 课堂表格把全期「累计回报率」列在年平均数据旁边。

words.enDefinition: a system allowing votes for several seats to be concentrated on one candidate

examples.en: The case used cumulative voting to let minority shareholders concentrate votes on a single nominee.
examples.zh: 案例用「累积投票制」让少数股东可以把选票集中给一名候选人。

examples.en: We distributed hypothetical votes across candidates to understand cumulative voting in the sample board election.
examples.zh: 我们把假设选票分给各候选人，以理解模拟董事选举中的「累积投票制」。

words.enDefinition: a share class that seeks to reduce certain exchange-rate effects

examples.en: The currency-hedged share class in our case sought to reduce fluctuations against its stated dealing currency.
examples.zh: 案例中的「货币对冲份额类别」力求减少相对于所列交易货币的汇率波动影响。

examples.en: The tutor asked why returns for a currency-hedged share class could differ from another class's returns.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「货币对冲份额类别」和另一个份额类别的回报可能不同。

collocations: compare a currency-hedged share class with other classes
returns for a currency-hedged share class

words.enDefinition: an England student finance assessment based on current tax-year income rather than the usual earlier tax year

examples.en: The adviser used a current year income assessment example involving a recent fall in household income.
examples.zh: 顾问用一个家庭收入近期下降的例子，说明什么是「本税年收入重新评估」。

examples.en: I read where the current year income assessment was recorded on the example funding application.
examples.zh: 我查看了在示例资助申请的哪里记录「本税年收入重新评估」。

collocations: request a current year income assessment
complete a current year income assessment

words.enDefinition: a bond's annual coupon amount divided by its current clean market price

examples.en: We calculated current yield before considering the effect of the final repayment on total return.
examples.zh: 我们先算了「当期收益率」，再考虑最终还本对总回报的影响。

examples.en: The worksheet showed a higher current yield after we lowered the bond's example market price.
examples.zh: 调低示例债券市场价格后，练习表显示的「当期收益率」更高了。

words.enDefinition: a nine-character identifier used for securities in the US and Canada

examples.en: The sample statement gave a CUSIP beside the company's name and the quantity of shares.
examples.zh: 样本对账单在公司名称和持股数量旁列出了「北美证券识别码」。

examples.en: We compared the CUSIP entries for two share classes issued by the same fictional company.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一家虚构公司发行的两个股份类别的「北美证券识别码」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for safeguarding fund assets and related services

examples.en: The fund's custody fee covered safekeeping the securities shown in the classroom holdings schedule.
examples.zh: 基金的「托管费」用于保管课堂持仓明细表所列的证券。

examples.en: The sample expense breakdown listed a custody fee separately from the manager's advisory charge.
examples.zh: 样本费用明细将「托管费」和管理人的投资顾问费分开列出。

words.enDefinition: in UK student finance, an identifier assigned to a person for their correspondence and account records
