examples.en: The mock lender cited insufficient credit references as one reason for its decision.
examples.zh: 模拟贷款机构把「信用证明不足」列为作此决定的原因之一。

examples.en: Our lecturer used a sample notice that mentioned insufficient credit references after the review.
examples.zh: 老师用了份通知样本，里面提到审查后发现「信用证明不足」。

collocations: a decision mentioning insufficient credit references

words.enDefinition: Employment pay counted when assessing Canadian employment insurance premiums and benefits

examples.en: The class found insurable earnings in a section near the listed premiums.
examples.zh: 全班在保费附近的一栏找到了「计入就业保险的收入」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked why insurable earnings and total pay could be different.
examples.zh: 练习表问，为什么「计入就业保险的收入」和工资总额可能不同？

words.zhGloss: 联邦与省合并发放的学生贷款
words.enDefinition: a loan administered jointly under Canadian federal and participating provincial student aid arrangements
acceptedZhAnswers: 联邦与省合并发放的学生贷款

examples.en: The borrower had an integrated student loan with federal and provincial portions on the same statement.
examples.zh: 借款人有一笔「联邦与省合并发放的学生贷款」，同一份对账单显示两个部分。

examples.en: The adviser used an integrated student loan to explain why the statement showed two balances.
examples.zh: 顾问以一笔「联邦与省合并发放的学生贷款」解释对账单为什么显示两个余额。

collocations: balance on an integrated student loan

words.enDefinition: The amount to be settled between the institutions involved in a particular payment step.

examples.en: The record listed the interbank settlement amount separately from what the customer had asked to send.
examples.zh: 记录把「银行间结算金额」与客户要求汇出的金额分开列示。

examples.en: We matched the interbank settlement amount with the currency shown on the same line of the form.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「银行间结算金额」和表格同一行所列的币种。

collocations: check the interbank settlement amount and currency

words.enDefinition: Borrowing interest accruing while the funded asset is being built

examples.en: The model calculated interest during construction before the plant began to earn revenue.
examples.zh: 模型计算了工厂开始取得收入前的「建设期利息」。

examples.en: We moved interest during construction into the financing section of the project worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「建设期利息」移到了项目练习表的融资一栏。

words.enDefinition: a status during which interest is not charged on a loan or a particular part of it

examples.en: The Canadian adviser explained what interest-free status meant for the portion shown in our sample statement.
examples.zh: 加拿大顾问解释了样本账单上那一部分标为「免计利息状态」是什么意思。

examples.en: The borrower asked whether the provincial portion would retain interest-free status during the next study period.
examples.zh: 借款人问，下个就读期内，贷款的省级部分是否仍是「免计利息状态」。

words.enDefinition: A span of time when payments cover interest without reducing principal

examples.en: The sample schedule showed an interest-only period followed by payments that reduced principal.
examples.zh: 示例还款表列出一个「只还利息的期间」，之后的付款才会减少本金。

examples.en: We checked the balance at the end of the fictional interest-only period.
examples.zh: 我们查了虚构案例中「只还利息的期间」结束时的余额。

words.enDefinition: a date specified for paying interest on a loan or debt security

examples.en: The schedule listed the next interest payment date below the information about the annual coupon rate.
examples.zh: 还款表在年度票面利率信息下方列出了下一个「利息支付日」。

examples.en: We checked the interest payment date because it fell after the end of our comparison period.
examples.zh: 我们查了「利息支付日」，因为它落在比较期结束以后。

words.enDefinition: a recalculation of a floating interest rate under the applicable formula and timing rules

examples.en: The next interest rate reset would use the new reference rate published after the holiday.
examples.zh: 下一次「利率重设」会使用假期后公布的新参考利率。

examples.en: The workbook showed how an interest rate reset changed the coupon payment for the following quarter.
examples.zh: 练习册展示了一次「利率重设」如何改变下一季度的票息付款。

words.enDefinition: Interest returned or credited when it is no longer owed

examples.en: The worksheet showed an interest rebate after the fictional loan ended early.
examples.zh: 练习题显示，虚构贷款提前结束后产生了一笔「利息退还额」。

examples.en: We checked where an interest rebate appeared in the lender's example calculations.
examples.zh: 我们查看了「利息退还额」在贷款机构的示例计算中列在哪里。

words.enDefinition: Tax savings available when interest expense can reduce taxable income

examples.en: The interest tax shield appeared on a separate line in the financing worksheet.
examples.zh: 融资练习表单列了「利息税盾」。

examples.en: Our exercise compared the interest tax shield under two hypothetical borrowing amounts.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们比较了两种假设借款金额下的「利息税盾」。

collocations: the present value of the interest tax shield

words.enDefinition: an estimated per-share value updated during the trading day

examples.en: The sample chart showed the intraday indicative value at several times before the market closed.
examples.zh: 样本图表列出了收盘前不同时点的「盘中参考净值」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the intraday indicative value differed from the final NAV per share.
examples.zh: 导师问，「盘中参考净值」为什么与最终公布的基金份额净值不同。

collocations: compare price with the intraday indicative value

words.enDefinition: An identifier used to locate or follow a particular institutional investigation about a payment.

examples.en: The support record listed the investigation case reference on a separate line from the payment identifier.
examples.zh: 支持记录把「查询案件参考编号」与付款标识分行列出。

examples.en: The investigation case reference linked the bank's initial notice and the reply in our sample file.
examples.zh: 「查询案件参考编号」把示例文件中银行最初发出的通知与后续答复关联了起来。

words.enDefinition: a bond with a credit rating that meets an agency's threshold for investment grade

examples.en: The prospectus listed an investment-grade bond beside an issue rated below that agency's applicable cutoff.
examples.zh: 募集文件把一只「投资级债券」和低于该评级机构门槛的债券并排列出。

examples.en: Our tutor said an investment-grade bond could still be affected by changing rates and issuer risk.
examples.zh: 导师说，「投资级债券」仍可能受利率变化和发行人风险影响。

words.enDefinition: what the fund aims to achieve through its investments

examples.en: The investment objective described the sample fund's aim of matching a broad regional index.
examples.zh: 「投资目标」写明，样本基金力求跟踪一项广泛覆盖该地区的指数。

examples.en: We compared the investment objective in two documents from different dates for the same fund.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一基金不同时期的两份文件里列出的「投资目标」。

words.enDefinition: The currency used to state the amounts due in an invoice.

examples.en: The invoice currency differed from the currency on the sender's account in the worked example.
examples.zh: 在完整演算的例子里，「账单计价币种」和汇款人账户上的币种不同。

examples.en: The accounts office checked the invoice currency before comparing the course fee with the credited amount.
examples.zh: 财务办公室核对了「账单计价币种」，然后把课程费用和入账金额作比较。

collocations: compare the invoice currency with the debit currency

words.enDefinition: presentations to prospective investors before an initial public offering

examples.en: Our case described an IPO roadshow at which the company presented its business plans to investors.
examples.zh: 案例介绍了一场「首次公开发行路演」，会上公司向投资者介绍了经营计划。

examples.en: The class identified which estimates appeared during the IPO roadshow but not in the final prospectus.
examples.zh: 同学们找出哪些估计值出现在「首次公开发行路演」中，却未出现在最终招募说明书里。

words.enDefinition: a twelve-character international identifier for a financial instrument

examples.en: The exercise gave an ISIN so we could match the same security across both documents.
examples.zh: 练习给出了一个「国际证券识别码」，以便我们在两份文件中匹配同一证券。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed out that the ISIN identified the security rather than its trading venue.
examples.zh: 导师指出，「国际证券识别码」标识的是证券本身，而非其交易场所。

collocations: identify a security by its ISIN

words.enDefinition: An international standard defining structured messages and data for payments and other financial services.

examples.en: Our workshop introduced ISO 20022 through a sample message for a cross-border university payment.
examples.zh: 培训通过一笔跨境大学缴费的示例报文介绍了「ISO 20022 金融报文标准」。

examples.en: The tutor explained how ISO 20022 gives financial institutions a shared vocabulary for payment messages.
examples.zh: 老师解释了「ISO 20022 金融报文标准」怎样给金融机构提供一套通用的支付报文用语。

words.enDefinition: the excess of the issue price of a security above its face value

examples.en: The exercise used a small issue premium for the bond because it was issued above face value.
examples.zh: 练习把债券设为略有「发行溢价」，因为发行价高于面值。

examples.en: We recorded the issue premium separately when comparing proceeds from the two fictional bond issues.
examples.zh: 比较两笔虚构债券发行所得时，我们把「发行溢价」单独记了下来。

collocations: a bond issued at an issue premium

words.enDefinition: a credit rating for a particular debt obligation that may reflect its own terms and rank

examples.en: The issue rating differed from the company's general credit rating because the note ranked lower.
examples.zh: 这只票据受偿顺位较低，「单项债券信用评级」便与公司的整体信用评级不同。

examples.en: We checked the issue rating for the unsecured notes in the agency's example table.
examples.zh: 我们查看了评级机构示例表中无担保票据的「单项债券信用评级」。

collocations: an issue rating on a bond

words.enDefinition: shares that a company has issued to holders

examples.en: The worksheet listed issued shares before subtracting those bought back and held by the company.
examples.zh: 练习表先列出「已发行股份」，再减去公司回购并持有的股份。

examples.en: We checked the number of issued shares before reading the sample company's ownership disclosures.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「已发行股份」的数量，再阅读样本公司的股权披露。

collocations: issued shares held by the company

words.enDefinition: a credit rating assessing an issuer's general capacity and willingness to meet financial obligations

examples.en: The agency table displayed an issuer rating before listing separate ratings for the company's two bonds.
examples.zh: 评级机构的表上先显示「发行人信用评级」，再列公司两只债券各自的评级。

examples.en: The tutor explained why the issuer rating assessed the company rather than the terms of one bond.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么「发行人信用评级」评估的是公司整体，单只债券的条款另看。

words.enDefinition: A breakdown of where the financed amount was applied or paid

examples.en: The itemization of amount financed showed that most funds went to the fictional dealer.
examples.zh: 「净融资额明细」显示，大部分资金都付给了虚构的经销商。

examples.en: Our exercise used the itemization of amount financed to identify four separate amounts.
examples.zh: 我们的练习用「净融资额明细」找出了四笔不同的金额。

collocations: read the itemization of amount financed
include an itemization of amount financed
request the itemization of amount financed

words.enDefinition: a short disclosure about a packaged investment's risks, performance, and costs

examples.en: The European sample key information document highlighted the product's risks and charges on separate pages.
examples.zh: 欧洲样本「关键信息文件」在不同页面分别列出了产品风险和费用。

examples.en: Our tutor compared a key information document for an EU fund with its longer prospectus.
examples.zh: 导师把一只欧盟基金的「关键信息文件」和更长的招募说明书作了比较。

collocations: costs in a key information document

words.enDefinition: a short investor disclosure used under certain UCITS rules

examples.en: An archived UK key investor information document showed the sample fund's objective and ongoing charges.
examples.zh: 一份存档的英国「投资者关键信息文件」列出了样本基金的投资目标和持续费用。

examples.en: The class identified the risk scale in an archived key investor information document from the UK.
examples.zh: 同学们在一份存档的英国「投资者关键信息文件」中找到了风险等级划分。

collocations: review a key investor information document
an archived key investor information document
charges in the key investor information document

words.zhGloss: 最近已确认的付款状态
words.enDefinition: The most recent status actually reported or confirmed in the available tracking record.
acceptedZhAnswers: 最近已确认的付款状态

examples.en: The last confirmed status came from the intermediary institution in the example's tracking table.
examples.zh: 示例追踪表中的「最近已确认的付款状态」由中介机构发出。

examples.en: We compared the last confirmed status with a separate credit entry received later that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们把「最近已确认的付款状态」与当天下午晚些时候收到的一条单独入账记录作了比较。

collocations: ask about the last confirmed status
read the last confirmed status before interpreting the record

words.enDefinition: the firm coordinating the underwriting group for an offering

examples.en: The sample document named a lead underwriter and two smaller firms working on the offering.
examples.zh: 样本文件列出了一家「主承销商」及两家参与发行的较小机构。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which tasks belonged to the lead underwriter in the mock offering timetable.
examples.zh: 导师问，在模拟发行时间表中哪些任务属于「主承销商」。

collocations: the lead underwriter on an offering

words.enDefinition: a document from a nominee authorising the beneficial owner to vote directly

examples.en: The sample meeting materials explained why a beneficial owner might need a legal proxy to vote directly.
examples.zh: 样本会议材料解释了受益所有人直接投票时为什么可能需要「正式表决授权文件」。

examples.en: Our exercise identified the legal proxy as the document conferring voting authority in the case.
examples.zh: 练习确认，「正式表决授权文件」是案例中授予表决权的文件。

words.enDefinition: Contractual rights for lenders to intervene under specified project problems

examples.en: The guide discussed lender step-in rights in its example of an operator default.
examples.zh: 指南用运营方违约案例讨论了「贷款方介入权」。

examples.en: We highlighted the contract clauses describing lender step-in rights in the fictional project.
examples.zh: 我们标出了虚构项目合同中描述「贷款方介入权」的条款。

words.enDefinition: a written purchase commitment that may qualify for a sales-load discount

examples.en: In our US fund case, a letter of intent specified purchases over a stated period.
examples.zh: 我们分析的美国基金案例中，「基金申购意向书」注明了在指定期间内的申购安排。

examples.en: The sample prospectus explained how the sales charge would change if the letter of intent was unfulfilled.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书解释了没有履行「基金申购意向书」时，销售费会有什么变化。

collocations: meet a letter of intent commitment
purchases covered by a letter of intent

words.enDefinition: A document showing that a claim against property has been removed

examples.en: The sample lien release documented removal of the lender's claim against the car.
examples.zh: 「解除担保权文件」的样本载明了贷款机构对汽车的担保权已解除。

examples.en: We found the lien release beside the fictional final payment receipt in class.
examples.zh: 在课上，我们在虚构的末笔还款收据旁找到了「解除担保权文件」。

words.enDefinition: A party with a legal claim against property securing a debt

examples.en: The sample title showed the fictional lender as the lienholder on the car.
examples.zh: 产权证明样本把虚构贷款机构列为汽车的「车辆担保权人」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which organisation appeared as the lienholder on the form.
examples.zh: 导师问，例表上哪家机构被列为「车辆担保权人」？

collocations: list the lienholder on the title

words.enDefinition: The total cost of acquiring, operating, and disposing of an asset

examples.en: The life-cycle cost included a renewal of the pipes after several years.
examples.zh: 「全寿命周期成本」计入了若干年后的管道更换费用。

examples.en: We calculated the life-cycle cost before comparing the two designs in class.
examples.zh: 课上比较两个设计之前，我们计算了「全寿命周期成本」。

words.zhGloss: 美国终身学习税额抵免
words.enDefinition: A US education credit for qualifying study costs, including certain skills courses
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国终身学习税额抵免

examples.en: The guide cited the Lifetime Learning Credit in an example about a job skills course.
examples.zh: 指南在关于职业技能课程的例子中提到「美国终身学习税额抵免」。

examples.en: The workshop put the Lifetime Learning Credit example beside the university fee statement.
examples.zh: 工作坊把「美国终身学习税额抵免」的示例放在大学收费报表旁。

collocations: eligibility for the Lifetime Learning Credit

words.enDefinition: Project borrowing permitting claims against sponsors only in defined circumstances

examples.en: The case used limited recourse financing with sponsor support confined to the construction phase.
examples.zh: 案例采用「有限追索融资」，发起人只在施工阶段提供支持。

examples.en: Our class identified which liabilities were covered under the limited recourse financing.
examples.zh: 全班找出了「有限追索融资」中发起人需要承担哪些责任。

words.enDefinition: An address connected to a consumer elsewhere in their credit record

examples.en: The sample linked address belonged to a shared flat occupied the previous year.
examples.zh: 档案样本中的「关联地址」是前一年住过的合租房。

examples.en: Maya spotted a linked address in the exercise that belonged to someone else.
examples.zh: 玛雅在练习中发现一个属于别人的「关联地址」。

words.enDefinition: a right to payment ahead of specified equity holders in liquidation

examples.en: The sample term sheet gave preferred holders a liquidation preference over the common shareholders.
examples.zh: 样本条款清单赋予优先股持有人相对于普通股股东的「清算优先权」。

examples.en: We used the liquidation preference to read the order of payments in the fictional winding-up example.
examples.zh: 我们借助「清算优先权」理解虚构清算示例中的付款顺序。

collocations: a liquidation preference over common shares

words.enDefinition: the date on which shares are listed on an exchange

examples.en: The sample exchange notice showed the listing date beside the company's new trading symbol.
examples.zh: 样本交易所公告在公司的新交易代码旁列出了「上市日期」。

examples.en: We compared the listing date with the earlier date on which the offer price was set.
examples.zh: 我们将「上市日期」和更早确定发行价的日期作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Directions stating where borrowed funds should be sent or paid out

examples.en: The loan disbursement instructions in the case sent part of the funds to the seller.
examples.zh: 案例中的「贷款资金划付说明」要求把部分资金付给卖方。

examples.en: I matched the loan disbursement instructions to the fictional recipients listed on the form.
examples.zh: 我把「贷款资金划付说明」与表上列的虚构收款方一一对应起来。

words.enDefinition: the present value of cash flow available for debt service through loan maturity divided by the outstanding loan balance

examples.en: The loan life coverage ratio used forecast cash only through the scheduled loan maturity date.
examples.zh: 「贷款期限偿债覆盖率」只用了截至贷款计划到期日的预测现金流。

examples.en: We checked the outstanding balance used in the loan life coverage ratio during class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上核对了计算「贷款期限偿债覆盖率」使用的未偿余额。

collocations: calculate the loan life coverage ratio
assess the loan life coverage ratio
test a loan life coverage ratio

words.enDefinition: a proportional adjustment to a student loan limit based on factors such as enrolment or the length of study

examples.en: The loan officer explained loan proration using two students with different lengths of study.
examples.zh: 贷款工作人员用两名学习时长不同的学生举例说明「贷款额度按比例折算」。

examples.en: Our practice aid notice showed loan proration separately from an adjustment to the estimated tuition costs.
examples.zh: 练习通知把「贷款额度按比例折算」与预估学费的调整分开显示。

words.zhGloss: 贷款到期后的项目余期
words.enDefinition: The interval between scheduled loan maturity and the project's expected end
acceptedZhAnswers: 贷款到期后的项目余期

examples.en: The schedule left a loan tail after the final planned loan instalment.
examples.zh: 进度表显示，最终一笔计划还款之后仍有一段「贷款到期后的项目余期」。

examples.en: Our example's loan tail ended when the concession period expired.
examples.zh: 示例中的「贷款到期后的项目余期」在特许经营期届满时结束。

collocations: compare the loan tail across proposals

words.enDefinition: an agreement restricting sales of specified shares for a period

examples.en: The sample prospectus described a lock-up agreement covering shares held by two of the founders.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书介绍了一份涵盖两名创始人持股的「股份锁定协议」。

examples.en: We read the lock-up agreement to see which holdings the fictional parties had agreed to restrict.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「股份锁定协议」，确认虚构当事人同意对哪些持股加以限制。

words.enDefinition: the period during which specified shares are subject to sale restrictions

examples.en: The fictional issuer's lock-up period ended on the date stated in the schedule.
examples.zh: 虚构发行人的「股份锁定期」于时间表所列日期结束。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which holdings were still subject to the lock-up period in the later filing.
examples.zh: 导师问，后续申报文件中哪些持股仍受「股份锁定期」限制。

collocations: the end of a lock-up period
shares covered during the lock-up period

words.enDefinition: exposure measured through the underlying assets of an indirect holding

examples.en: The analysis used look-through exposure to show which sectors were held through the underlying funds.
examples.zh: 分析用「穿透后敞口」说明通过底层基金持有哪些行业。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to compare direct holdings with look-through exposure in the sample portfolio.
examples.zh: 导师要求我们比较样本投资组合的直接持仓和「穿透后敞口」。

words.enDefinition: the share of exposure expected to be lost if the borrower defaults, after considering recoveries

examples.en: We compared loss given default in two examples with different values for the pledged assets.
examples.zh: 我们比较了担保物价值不同的两个示例中的「违约损失率」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the estimated loss given default was shown as a percentage, not a currency amount.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么估算的「违约损失率」用百分比表示，而不是货币金额。

words.enDefinition: An Australian offset reducing income tax for eligible lower income taxpayers

examples.en: The sample calculation showed the low income tax offset below the initial tax figure.
examples.zh: 税额计算样本把「澳洲低收入税额抵免」列在初算税额下方。

examples.en: The tutor introduced the low income tax offset before discussing two example incomes.
examples.zh: 导师先介绍了「澳洲低收入税额抵免」，再讨论两种示例收入。

collocations: calculate the low income tax offset
eligibility for the low income tax offset
a low income tax offset example

words.enDefinition: the weighted average time to receive a bond's cash flows, weighted by their present values

examples.en: We calculated Macaulay duration using each payment's timing and its share of the total present value.
examples.zh: 我们根据每笔付款的时间和它在总现值中所占比重，计算「麦考利久期」。

examples.en: The tutor expressed Macaulay duration in years when we compared the two example bonds in class.
examples.zh: 课堂比较两只示例债券时，导师以年为单位表示「麦考利久期」。

words.enDefinition: Capital spending needed to keep existing operations functioning at capacity

examples.en: The forecast included maintenance capex for replacing worn pumps at the facility.
examples.zh: 预测中列了为更换设施旧泵而支出的「维持运营的资本支出」。

examples.en: We kept maintenance capex separate from the proposed addition of a new production line.
examples.zh: 我们把「维持运营的资本支出」和计划新增一条生产线的开支分开了。

words.enDefinition: a covenant requiring a borrower to satisfy a test on a recurring basis, such as at reporting dates

examples.en: The lender tested the maintenance covenant at each quarterly reporting date in our fictional example.
examples.zh: 在虚构示例里，贷款方在每季度报告日都检验是否满足「定期维持型约束条款」。

examples.en: The tutor contrasted a maintenance covenant with a test that applied only when new debt was issued.
examples.zh: 导师把「定期维持型约束条款」与仅在新发债务时才适用的测试作了对比。

words.enDefinition: a non-repayable living-cost award under certain UK student finance arrangements, subject to programme eligibility

examples.en: The sample offer listed a maintenance grant beside a loan with a separate repayment section.
examples.zh: 示例资助方案把一笔「生活费助学金」和一笔单列还款说明的贷款并排列出。

examples.en: We checked the maintenance grant line in the example from a Welsh student finance guide.
examples.zh: 我们查看了威尔士学生资助指南示例中的「生活费助学金」一栏。

words.enDefinition: funding intended to help cover living expenses while studying, such as a loan or grant

examples.en: The adviser explained which amount in the UK offer was maintenance support for living costs.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了英国资助方案里哪笔钱是供生活开支的「生活费资助」。

examples.en: The letter listed maintenance support on a separate page from the amount paid to the college.
examples.zh: 信函把「生活费资助」与付给学院的款项分在不同页上。

words.enDefinition: a voting system requiring more than half of a specified vote total

examples.en: The example used majority voting and defined which ballots counted toward the required total.
examples.zh: 示例采用「过半数投票制」，并明确哪些选票计入所需总数。

examples.en: Our group checked how majority voting affected the outcome when several shareholders abstained.
examples.zh: 我们小组核对了数名股东弃权时，「过半数投票制」如何影响结果。

words.zhGloss: 带补偿机制的提前赎回
words.enDefinition: an issuer's early redemption priced by a formula that discounts remaining scheduled principal and interest, subject to the terms
acceptedZhAnswers: 带补偿机制的提前赎回

examples.en: The tutor used a make-whole call to show how remaining principal and interest affect redemption pricing.
examples.zh: 导师用「带补偿机制的提前赎回」说明剩余本金和利息会怎样影响赎回定价。

examples.en: The sample indenture defined which benchmark rate applied when calculating the price of a make-whole call.
examples.zh: 样本契约规定了计算「带补偿机制的提前赎回」的价格时适用哪个基准利率。

words.enDefinition: the spread specified in bond terms to add to the benchmark yield used in a make-whole redemption calculation

examples.en: The indenture listed the make-whole spread beside the method for selecting a benchmark Treasury.
examples.zh: 这份债券契约把「补偿赎回计价利差」列在美国基准国债的选取方法旁。

examples.en: We added the make-whole spread to the benchmark yield before discounting the remaining scheduled payments.
examples.zh: 我们把「补偿赎回计价利差」加到基准收益率上，再折算剩余的约定付款。

collocations: add a make-whole spread to the benchmark yield

words.enDefinition: an item proposed by company management for a shareholder vote

examples.en: The sample management proposal asked investors to approve a change to the company's share structure.
examples.zh: 样本「管理层提案」请求投资者批准变更公司的股份结构。

examples.en: Our worksheet compared a management proposal with an item put forward by a shareholder.
examples.zh: 练习表将「管理层提案」和一项由股东提出的事项作了比较。

words.enDefinition: redemption required by the bond terms when scheduled or when certain conditions are met

examples.en: The sample issue required mandatory redemption of some bonds on the dates in the schedule.
examples.zh: 示例发行要求在表列日期对部分债券进行「强制赎回」。

examples.en: We read the mandatory redemption section before calculating which notes would remain outstanding next year.
examples.zh: 我们阅读了「强制赎回」一节，再计算明年还有哪些票据未偿还。

words.enDefinition: Review of an application by a person instead of automatic processing

examples.en: The case went to manual underwriting when the system could not match records.
examples.zh: 系统无法匹配记录时，案例转入了「人工信贷审核」。

examples.en: Our tutor described manual underwriting using a fictional borrower with varied monthly earnings.
examples.zh: 导师用一位月收入不固定的虚构借款人说明了「人工信贷审核」。

collocations: refer a case for manual underwriting

words.enDefinition: a rate applied to the part of Australian repayment income that falls within a relevant bracket, where marginal rates apply

examples.en: Our class used a marginal repayment rate to calculate an example Australian student loan repayment.
examples.zh: 课堂上我们采用「边际还款比率」计算一笔澳洲助学贷款的示例还款。

examples.en: The adviser explained which marginal repayment rate applied to that part of the example income.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了示例收入的这部分适用哪个「边际还款比率」。

collocations: marginal repayment rate for a bracket

words.enDefinition: fund performance based on market prices and applicable distributions

examples.en: The market price return in the ETF example was based on stated closing prices.
examples.zh: ETF 示例中的「按市价计算的回报率」是按列出的收盘价计算的。

examples.en: The tutor asked why market price return and NAV return might differ over the same period.
examples.zh: 导师问，同一个期间内「按市价计算的回报率」和按净值计算的回报率为什么可能不同。

collocations: a comparison of market price returns

words.enDefinition: the largest percentage drop from a peak to a subsequent trough

examples.en: The chart showed a maximum drawdown during the steepest fall in the sample portfolio's value.
examples.zh: 图表显示，样本投资组合价值跌得最厉害时出现了「最大回撤」。

examples.en: We checked whether changing the observation period altered the calculated maximum drawdown in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了改变观察期会不会改变练习中算出的「最大回撤」。

words.zhGloss: 三十日买卖价差中位数
words.enDefinition: the median relative bid-ask spread over the previous thirty days
acceptedZhAnswers: 三十日买卖价差中位数

examples.en: The sample ETF page showed the median 30-day bid-ask spread as a percentage of the quoted midpoint.
examples.zh: 样本 ETF 页面以买卖报价中点的百分比表示「三十日买卖价差中位数」。

examples.en: We located the median 30-day bid-ask spread beside the fund's market price and NAV per share.
examples.zh: 我们在基金市价与份额净值旁找到了「三十日买卖价差中位数」。

words.zhGloss: 澳洲医保不具资格证明
words.enDefinition: An Australian document recording a period of Medicare ineligibility
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲医保不具资格证明

examples.en: The Medicare Entitlement Statement in the case study showed dates for the uncovered period.
examples.zh: 案例里的「澳洲医保不具资格证明」列出不具备资格期间的日期。

examples.en: The training pack placed a Medicare Entitlement Statement beside a sample levy exemption entry.
examples.zh: 培训资料包把一份「澳洲医保不具资格证明」放在示例税费豁免条目旁。

collocations: dates on a Medicare Entitlement Statement

words.enDefinition: An Australian tax levy helping fund the public Medicare system

examples.en: The example assessment listed the Medicare levy on its own line beneath income tax.
examples.zh: 税额核定样本在所得税下方单列了「澳洲医疗保险税」。

examples.en: Nina highlighted the Medicare levy before reading the explanation on the next page.
examples.zh: 妮娜先标出「澳洲医疗保险税」，再看下一页的说明。

words.enDefinition: An additional Australian levy linked to income and private hospital cover

examples.en: The Australian reading listed the Medicare levy surcharge in a separate section about hospital cover.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚阅读材料在单独说明住院保险的一节列出「澳洲医疗保险附加税」。

examples.en: Our tutor located the Medicare levy surcharge in the example calculation below the initial levy.
examples.zh: 导师在样例计算单上找到了「澳洲医疗保险附加税」，它在基本医疗保险税下方。

words.zhGloss: 未锁定收入的市场敞口
words.enDefinition: Exposure to uncontracted revenue depending on market prices or demand
acceptedZhAnswers: 未锁定收入的市场敞口

examples.en: The exercise showed merchant exposure after the fixed price electricity contract expired.
examples.zh: 练习显示，固定电价合同到期后，项目出现了「未锁定收入的市场敞口」。

examples.en: The lender model separated contracted income from revenue subject to merchant exposure.
examples.zh: 贷款机构的模型把合同收入与面临「未锁定收入的市场敞口」的收入区分开。

words.enDefinition: cash, shares, or other value received by holders in a merger

examples.en: The sample's merger consideration consisted of cash plus shares in the company acquiring the business.
examples.zh: 样本中的「合并对价」由现金和实施收购的企业的股份组成。

examples.en: We read where the merger consideration appeared in the notice sent to shareholders about the deal.
examples.zh: 我们阅读了交易通知，查看发给股东的文件在哪儿说明「合并对价」。

words.enDefinition: A reference that identifies a particular payment message rather than each transaction it contains.

examples.en: The analyst used the message identification to match the system reply to the original message.
examples.zh: 分析员用「报文标识」把系统答复与原始报文对应起来。

examples.en: The class compared the message identification with the separate reference for the payment in the example.
examples.zh: 同学们把例子里的「报文标识」与该笔付款单独使用的参考编号作了对比。

words.enDefinition: The procedure used to check an item disputed on a credit report

examples.en: The mock letter asked how the bureau would describe its method of verification.
examples.zh: 模拟信询问报告机构会如何描述自己的「异议信息的核实方式」。

examples.en: The method of verification was explained beside the result in the fictional response.
examples.zh: 虚构回复在调查结果旁说明了「异议信息的核实方式」。

collocations: ask about the method of verification

words.enDefinition: A valuation convention treating annual cash flows as occurring midyear

examples.en: The class applied the midyear convention when the example cash arrived throughout the year.
examples.zh: 示例现金在全年陆续到账时，全班采用了「年中现金流折现惯例」。

examples.en: We changed the time column to reflect the midyear convention on our sheet.
examples.zh: 我们改了表上的时间栏，使它反映「年中现金流折现惯例」。

collocations: value a project under the midyear convention

words.enDefinition: the smallest principal amount of a security that can be purchased or held under its terms

examples.en: The offering document stated the minimum denomination before listing the increments allowed above that amount.
examples.zh: 发行文件先列「最低认购面额」，再列超过该金额后的允许递增档。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked whether the example amount met the minimum denomination of the issued note.
examples.zh: 练习表问，示例金额是否达到所发票据的「最低认购面额」。

words.enDefinition: the smallest amount accepted for a first investment in a fund

examples.en: The minimum initial investment differed across the classes listed in the exercise's sample prospectus.
examples.zh: 练习提供的样本招募说明书中，各个份额类别的「首次投资最低金额」不同。

examples.en: Our lecturer asked which line of the table stated the minimum initial investment for new holders.
examples.zh: 讲师问，表格中哪一行写的是新持有人的「首次投资最低金额」。

words.enDefinition: A commitment to make up some revenue below a specified level

examples.en: The case included a minimum revenue guarantee tied to traffic on the road.
examples.zh: 案例列了一项和道路车流量挂钩的「最低收入保障」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained which shortfalls the minimum revenue guarantee covered in the model.
examples.zh: 导师解释了模型中的「最低收入保障」涵盖哪些收入缺口。

collocations: support under a minimum revenue guarantee

words.enDefinition: the smallest amount accepted for a later purchase

examples.en: The fund's minimum subsequent investment was listed below the amount needed to open a holding.
examples.zh: 基金的「追加投资最低金额」列在首次申购所需金额的下方。

examples.en: We compared the minimum subsequent investment in the two classes shown on the application form.
examples.zh: 我们比较了申请表上两个类别的「追加投资最低金额」。

words.enDefinition: a shareholder who holds a non-controlling ownership interest

examples.en: In the case, a minority shareholder questioned why the lower-vote shares received the same dividend.
examples.zh: 案例中，一名「少数股东」质疑为什么表决票数较少的股份获得同样的股息。

examples.en: The class reviewed what information a minority shareholder received before the sample company's meeting.
examples.zh: 班上查看了「少数股东」在样本公司的会议前会收到哪些信息。

collocations: a minority shareholder in the company

words.enDefinition: A credit file that mistakenly combines information about different people

examples.en: The instructor showed a mixed file containing two borrowers with the same name.
examples.zh: 老师展示了一个「混入他人资料的档案」，里面有两位同名借款人的信息。

examples.en: We saw how a mixed file could list a loan the applicant never requested.
examples.zh: 我们了解到，「混入他人资料的档案」怎么会列出申请人从未申请过的贷款。

words.enDefinition: An example form showing how a remittance disclosure can present information to the sender.

examples.en: The model disclosure form kept the transfer costs and recipient amount on clearly labelled lines.
examples.zh: 「汇款披露示范表」分行列明了汇款成本和收款金额。

examples.en: We used a model disclosure form to learn where an availability date could be shown.
examples.zh: 我们用「汇款披露示范表」学习可领取或使用款项的日期可以列在哪里。

collocations: compare disclosures with the model disclosure form

words.enDefinition: a measure approximating a bond's percentage price change for a small change in its own yield, assuming fixed cash flows

examples.en: Our class used modified duration to estimate how the fixed-rate bond's price would respond to higher yields.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用「修正久期」估算收益率升高时固定利率债券的价格如何变化。

examples.en: The analyst compared modified duration across two bonds whose cash flows were fixed in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，分析人员比较了两只现金流固定的债券的「修正久期」。

collocations: estimate price change using modified duration

words.enDefinition: A project return measure using specified financing and reinvestment rates

examples.en: The formula for modified internal rate of return used two separate rate assumptions in our model.
examples.zh: 我们模型里的「修正内部收益率」公式用了两个单列的利率假设。

examples.en: I checked the modified internal rate of return after changing the reinvestment input in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我在练习中更改再投资利率后，核对了「修正内部收益率」。

collocations: calculate the modified internal rate of return
report the modified internal rate of return
a higher modified internal rate of return

words.enDefinition: Repeated random sampling from input distributions to estimate possible outcomes

examples.en: The Monte Carlo simulation generated a range of project values in the exercise.
examples.zh: 「蒙特卡洛模拟」在练习中得出了一系列可能的项目价值。

examples.en: We checked the input distributions before running the Monte Carlo simulation in class.
examples.zh: 在课上运行「蒙特卡洛模拟」之前，我们先核对了输入变量的分布。

collocations: inputs for a Monte Carlo simulation

words.enDefinition: Multiple rates that each make the same project’s net present value zero

examples.en: The model gave multiple internal rates of return for the project with a large final outflow.
examples.zh: 模型对期末有大笔现金流出的那个项目给出了「多个内部收益率」。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the curve to illustrate why multiple internal rates of return could arise.
examples.zh: 导师画了条曲线来说明为什么可能出现「多个内部收益率」。

collocations: produce multiple internal rates of return
a case with multiple internal rates of return
test for multiple internal rates of return

words.enDefinition: Investment alternatives where choosing one rules out choosing another

examples.en: The machines were mutually exclusive projects because they both needed the only available space.
examples.zh: 两台机器都需要唯一可用的空间，因此对应的方案是「相互排斥的项目」。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked how the values of mutually exclusive projects would be compared.
examples.zh: 练习表问，应怎样比较「相互排斥的项目」的价值。

words.enDefinition: An Australian Taxation Office app tool for keeping expense records

examples.en: The workshop demonstrated myDeductions with a receipt from a sample work expense.
examples.zh: 工作坊用一项示例工作开支的收据演示了「澳洲扣除记录工具」。

examples.en: The adviser opened myDeductions to show where the example receipt was stored.
examples.zh: 顾问打开「澳洲扣除记录工具」，展示了示例收据保存在哪里。

words.zhGloss: 澳洲 HELP 额度查询平台
words.enDefinition: the Australian service showing HELP borrowing information, including the amount still available under the loan limit
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲 HELP 额度查询平台

examples.en: The adviser used a screenshot of myHELPbalance to show how available borrowing was displayed.
examples.zh: 顾问用「澳洲 HELP 额度查询平台」的截图展示了如何显示剩余可借额度。

examples.en: The guide listed myHELPbalance separately from the account used to view the amount already owed.
examples.zh: 指南分别列出了「澳洲 HELP 额度查询平台」和用于查看已欠金额的账户。

words.zhGloss: 新西兰学生资助线上账户
words.enDefinition: the New Zealand StudyLink online service where users can view and manage student support records
acceptedZhAnswers: 新西兰学生资助线上账户

examples.en: I opened MyStudyLink to check whether my latest student funding letter was available online.
examples.zh: 我打开「新西兰学生资助线上账户」，查看新一份助学资助信函能不能在线阅读。

examples.en: The adviser showed a training screenshot of MyStudyLink during our introduction to student funding.
examples.zh: 助学资助介绍会中，顾问展示了「新西兰学生资助线上账户」的培训截图。

words.zhGloss: 澳洲个人在线报税服务
words.enDefinition: An Australian Taxation Office service for lodging individual returns online
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲个人在线报税服务

examples.en: The training guide included a myTax screenshot with sample income entries.
examples.zh: 培训指南中有一张「澳洲个人在线报税服务」的截图，列出了收入项目样例。

examples.en: Our instructor demonstrated myTax using a set of invented employment records.
examples.zh: 讲师用一组虚构的雇佣收入记录演示了「澳洲个人在线报税服务」。

words.zhGloss: 美国国家学生贷款数据系统
words.enDefinition: the US Department of Education's central system for federal student aid loan and grant records
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国国家学生贷款数据系统

examples.en: The training guide identified the National Student Loan Data System as a source of federal aid history.
examples.zh: 培训指南将「美国国家学生贷款数据系统」列为联邦助学历史记录的来源。

examples.en: The adviser explained what loan information came from the National Student Loan Data System in our example.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了案例里的哪些贷款信息来自「美国国家学生贷款数据系统」。

collocations: records in the National Student Loan Data System
data from the National Student Loan Data System
check the National Student Loan Data System

words.zhGloss: 加拿大学生贷款服务中心
words.enDefinition: the Canadian service where borrowers manage participating government student loans and repayments
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大学生贷款服务中心

examples.en: The National Student Loans Service Centre appeared on the sample statement beside the borrower's account details.
examples.zh: 样本对账单在借款人账户详情旁显示了「加拿大学生贷款服务中心」。

examples.en: Our adviser explained which loan records were held at the National Student Loans Service Centre.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了哪些贷款记录保存在「加拿大学生贷款服务中心」。

collocations: contact the National Student Loans Service Centre
National Student Loans Service Centre account
statement from the National Student Loans Service Centre

words.enDefinition: net assets attributable to a class divided by its outstanding shares

examples.en: The exercise divided the class's net assets by its outstanding shares to find NAV per share.
examples.zh: 这道练习用该类别的净资产除以其流通在外的份额数量，求出「基金份额净值」。

examples.en: We compared the ETF's quoted market price with its NAV per share on the same date.
examples.zh: 我们把这只 ETF 的市场报价与同日的「基金份额净值」作了比较。

words.enDefinition: fund performance calculated using net asset values and applicable distributions

examples.en: The sample ETF reported NAV return and market price return in separate columns on its factsheet.
examples.zh: 样本 ETF 在概况表中把「按净值计算的回报率」和按市价计算的回报率分开列出。

examples.en: We used the NAV return in the exercise to compare the fund's performance with its benchmark.
examples.zh: 我们用练习中的「按净值计算的回报率」将基金业绩与基准比较。

words.enDefinition: Growth of a loan balance because payments do not cover interest

examples.en: The table illustrated negative amortization by showing the balance rise despite regular payments.
examples.zh: 表格说明了「负摊还」现象。借款人定期还款，余额却上升。

examples.en: Our fictional example showed negative amortization during months with unusually small payments.
examples.zh: 我们的虚构示例显示，在还款特别少的月份发生了「负摊还」。

words.enDefinition: a covenant prohibiting or limiting a borrower or issuer from taking particular actions

examples.en: The negative covenant limited the assets the example issuer could pledge for a new loan.
examples.zh: 「限制性承诺条款」限制了示例发行人可为新贷款提供哪些资产作为担保。

examples.en: Our class discussed why the negative covenant required an exception for certain routine business transactions.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论了为什么「限制性承诺条款」需要给某些日常商业交易留出例外。

words.enDefinition: a rating outlook indicating that the credit rating may be lowered within the relevant horizon

examples.en: The sample release retained the current rating but attached a negative outlook to the issuer.
examples.zh: 样本公告保留了当前评级，但将发行人列为「负面评级展望」。

examples.en: Our lecturer explained that a negative outlook describes a possible direction for a future rating change.
examples.zh: 讲师解释了「负面评级展望」说明的是未来评级变化的一种可能方向。

collocations: credit rating with a negative outlook

words.enDefinition: the value of a fund's assets minus its liabilities

examples.en: We calculated the fund's net asset value after subtracting its liabilities in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中，我们从基金资产中扣掉负债，算出了「基金资产净值」。

examples.en: The sample report listed net asset value before showing the number of shares in issue.
examples.zh: 样本报告先列出「基金资产净值」，再列出已发行份额数量。

collocations: a fund's total net asset value

words.enDefinition: the expense ratio after applicable waivers or reimbursements

examples.en: The net expense ratio in the example was lower because an adviser reimbursed some expenses.
examples.zh: 示例中的「减免后费用率」较低，因为投资顾问返还了部分费用。

examples.en: We checked whether the same arrangement explained both the net expense ratio and its footnote.
examples.zh: 我们核对「减免后费用率」及其脚注说的是不是同一项安排。

collocations: the net expense ratio after waivers

words.enDefinition: money actually raised after stated offering fees and expenses

examples.en: The company in the case stated net proceeds after deducting the underwriting charge and other expenses.
examples.zh: 案例中的公司列出了扣除承销费用和其他开支之后的「发行募集净额」。

examples.en: We compared net proceeds with the larger amount paid for all the offered shares.
examples.zh: 我们将「发行募集净额」与买入全部发售股份所支付的更高金额作了比较。

collocations: estimated net proceeds from an offering

words.enDefinition: Settlement of balances left after offsetting amounts that participants owe to each other.

examples.en: The exercise showed net settlement by offsetting what each institution owed against what it would receive.
examples.zh: 这道练习用各机构的应付款抵销应收款，展示了「净额结算」。

examples.en: In the diagram, net settlement produced one final balance instead of entries for every original payment.
examples.zh: 图中的「净额结算」生成了一个最终余额，无须逐笔结算原付款。

collocations: compare net settlement with gross settlement

words.enDefinition: the cash payable or receivable after applicable transaction charges

examples.en: The net trade amount in the exercise reflected both the purchase cost and the stated fees.
examples.zh: 练习中的「交易净额」反映了买入成本和列出的费用。

examples.en: We reconciled the net trade amount on the confirmation with the entry in the cash ledger.
examples.zh: 我们用现金账上的记录核对确认单里的「交易净额」。

collocations: a net trade amount after charges

words.zhGloss: 加拿大个人电子报税服务
words.enDefinition: A CRA service for sending individual returns through certified software
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大个人电子报税服务

examples.en: The workshop described NETFILE after introducing certified Canadian tax software.
examples.zh: 工作坊介绍了加拿大认证报税软件，接着说明了「加拿大个人电子报税服务」。

examples.en: Our training screen showed a sample confirmation from NETFILE after transmission.
examples.zh: 培训画面显示，提交后收到了「加拿大个人电子报税服务」的回执样本。

words.enDefinition: A confirmation that the messaging network received or accepted a message for handling.

examples.en: The class saw a network acknowledgement before any separate report on the payment itself arrived.
examples.zh: 单独的付款状态报文还没到时，同学们先看到了「报文网络接收确认」。

examples.en: The sample network acknowledgement related to the message, while another document reported the interbank settlement.
examples.zh: 示例的「报文网络接收确认」对应的是报文，另一份文件报告了银行间结算。

collocations: compare a network acknowledgement with a payment status

words.enDefinition: a fund sold without a front-end or deferred sales load, although it may have other charges and operating expenses

examples.en: The sample no-load fund still reported annual operating expenses in its table of estimated costs.
examples.zh: 样本「无销售佣金基金」仍在估算成本表中报告年度运作费用。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the cost example for a no-load fund might still show substantial expenses.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「无销售佣金基金」的成本示例仍可能显示有可观费用。

collocations: operating expenses of a no-load fund
classify a fund as a no-load fund

words.enDefinition: shares issued without a stated nominal value per share

examples.en: The fictional company's charter described its common shares as no-par value stock throughout the example.
examples.zh: 整份示例中，虚构公司的章程都把其普通股描述为「无面值股票」。

examples.en: Students checked the sample charter to see whether the company could issue no-par value stock.
examples.zh: 学生查阅样本章程，确认公司能否发行「无面值股票」。

collocations: a class of no-par value stock

words.enDefinition: Cash flow stated in future money amounts including assumed inflation

examples.en: The nominal cash flow for year three included the assumed increase in prices.
examples.zh: 第三年的「名义现金流」计入了预估涨价。

examples.en: We matched nominal cash flow to the discount rate stated in nominal terms.
examples.zh: 我们把「名义现金流」与用名义口径表示的折现率配对。

words.enDefinition: in an inflation comparison, the yield expressed before adjusting for changes in purchasing power

examples.en: We compared the nominal yield with an inflation-adjusted figure in the example for the same period.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一时期示例中的「名义收益率」与经通胀调整的数字。

examples.en: The class checked whether the difference between nominal yield and real yield reflected the inflation assumption.
examples.zh: 我们班检查了「名义收益率」与实际收益率的差异是否反映了通胀假设。

words.zhGloss: 不可按常规条款提前赎回的期间
words.enDefinition: a period when the issuer cannot exercise a specified option to redeem the bond early
acceptedZhAnswers: 不可按常规条款提前赎回的期间

examples.en: The bond had a three-year non-call period before the first ordinary issuer call was permitted.
examples.zh: 这只债券有三年的「不可按常规条款提前赎回的期间」，之后才允许发行人按常规条款首次赎回。

examples.en: The tutor asked when the non-call period ended under the terms shown in the example.
examples.zh: 导师问，按示例中的条款，「不可按常规条款提前赎回的期间」何时结束。

words.enDefinition: An adjustment reversing a noncash expense when calculating cash flow

examples.en: We included a non-cash add-back for depreciation after working out operating profit.
examples.zh: 我们算完营业利润后，做了一笔折旧的「非现金项目加回」。

examples.en: The template showed a non-cash add-back between operating profit and operating cash flow.
examples.zh: 模板在营业利润与经营现金流之间列了「非现金项目加回」。

words.zhGloss: 符号多次变化的现金流
words.enDefinition: A series of cash flows that changes sign more than once
acceptedZhAnswers: 符号多次变化的现金流

examples.en: The example showed non-conventional cash flow after a final cleanup payment followed operating receipts.
examples.zh: 示例中，营业收款后还要付最后的清理费，于是形成了「符号多次变化的现金流」。

examples.en: We looked for sign changes to identify non-conventional cash flow on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们通过观察收支符号的变化来识别练习表中的「符号多次变化的现金流」。

collocations: a pattern of non-conventional cash flow

words.zhGloss: 非涵盖的收款机构费用
words.enDefinition: under the US remittance rule, fees charged by the recipient's account institution for receiving the transfer when the institution is not the provider's agent
acceptedZhAnswers: 非涵盖的收款机构费用

examples.en: The training receipt warned that non-covered third-party fees could affect the amount reaching a recipient account.
examples.zh: 培训回执提醒，「非涵盖的收款机构费用」可能影响实际入账金额。

examples.en: The tutor underlined non-covered third-party fees and asked who charged them in the example.
examples.zh: 老师在「非涵盖的收款机构费用」下面划线，并问例子中的费用是谁收的。

collocations: a notice about non-covered third-party fees
look for a warning about non-covered third-party fees

words.enDefinition: The PAYE method applying the code to each pay period separately

examples.en: The example calculated PAYE on a non-cumulative basis for the student's first weekly pay.
examples.zh: 示例对学生第一周的工资「按单个发薪期计税」。

examples.en: On a non-cumulative basis, the worksheet considered just the current month's pay.
examples.zh: 采用「按单个发薪期计税」时，练习表只考虑当月工资。

collocations: use a code on a non-cumulative basis
calculate tax on a non-cumulative basis

words.enDefinition: Essential financial outgoings the borrower cannot readily choose to stop paying

examples.en: The sample budget entered basic household bills under non-discretionary expenditure rather than entertainment.
examples.zh: 预算样本把基本家庭账单列在「必要支出」一栏，没有归入娱乐。

examples.en: We discussed whether a regular childcare payment counted as non-discretionary expenditure in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了练习中定期支付的托儿费用是否算作「必要支出」。

words.enDefinition: A notice to the ATO that an individual return is unnecessary

examples.en: The guide listed non-lodgment advice as a separate type of communication with the ATO.
examples.zh: 指南将「澳洲无需申报通知」单独列为联系澳大利亚税务局的一种文档。

examples.en: Our class read a blank non-lodgment advice while comparing Australian reporting terms.
examples.zh: 比较澳洲申报术语时，全班看了一份空白的「澳洲无需申报通知」。

words.zhGloss: 不按经济状况核定的资助
words.enDefinition: financial support whose availability or amount does not depend on the recipient's assessed means
acceptedZhAnswers: 不按经济状况核定的资助

examples.en: The handbook described non-means-tested support separately from amounts based on the household's assessed income.
examples.zh: 手册把「不按经济状况核定的资助」与依据家庭评估收入计算的金额分开介绍。

examples.en: We compared two sample notices showing non-means-tested support and a separate income-assessed amount for living costs.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两份样本通知，都列有「不按经济状况核定的资助」，另列按收入评估的生活费金额。

words.enDefinition: Borrowing where lenders rely on project assets and revenues for repayment

examples.en: The non-recourse financing in our example rested on revenues from the facility.
examples.zh: 示例中的「无追索融资」依靠设施产生的收入偿还。

examples.en: The worksheet asked which assets supported the non-recourse financing in the case.
examples.zh: 练习表问，案例中哪些资产为「无追索融资」提供保障？

words.enDefinition: shares that generally carry no vote on ordinary shareholder matters

examples.en: The fictional company issued non-voting shares with the same dividend rights as its other common shares.
examples.zh: 虚构公司发行的「无表决权股份」与其其他普通股享有相同的股息权。

examples.en: Students noted that non-voting shares had no votes in the sample's routine election of directors.
examples.zh: 学生注意到，此样本中的「无表决权股份」在常规董事选举中没有选票。

words.enDefinition: in a Treasury auction, a bid accepting the rate, yield or discount margin determined at auction

examples.en: The worksheet showed how a noncompetitive bid used the auction result without specifying a requested yield.
examples.zh: 练习表展示了「非竞争性投标」如何采用拍卖结果，无须事先指定所要求的收益率。

examples.en: The tutor used a noncompetitive bid to explain one of the award categories in the results.
examples.zh: 导师用「非竞争性投标」说明拍卖结果中的一种获配类别。

collocations: noncompetitive bid at a Treasury auction

words.enDefinition: preferred shares whose undeclared dividends do not carry forward

examples.en: The fictional company's noncumulative preferred stock did not carry forward dividends the board had skipped.
examples.zh: 虚构公司的「非累积优先股」不会累计董事会决定不宣派的股息。

examples.en: The tutor asked which dividend rule identified the issue as noncumulative preferred stock in the example.
examples.zh: 导师问，示例中哪一项股息条款表明这次发行的是「非累积优先股」。

words.zhGloss: 我方在他行开立的账户
words.enDefinition: An account a bank holds at another bank, often in another currency, described from the account holder's perspective.
acceptedZhAnswers: 我方在他行开立的账户

examples.en: The diagram showed which bank held the nostro account used for payments in the other currency.
examples.zh: 图中标出了哪家银行持有「我方在他行开立的账户」，用来经办另一币种的付款。

examples.en: From the account holder's perspective, the relationship was recorded as a nostro account in the example.
examples.zh: 示例从账户持有方的视角，把该账户记为「我方在他行开立的账户」。

collocations: record funds in a nostro account

words.enDefinition: a document announcing an annual shareholder meeting and its details

examples.en: The notice of annual meeting gave the time and place for the fictional company's vote.
examples.zh: 「年度股东大会通知」列明了虚构公司股东表决的时间和地点。

examples.en: We checked the notice of annual meeting before reading the sample's proposed resolutions.
examples.zh: 阅读样本的拟议决议前，我们查阅了「年度股东大会通知」。

collocations: issue a notice of annual meeting
circulate the notice of annual meeting
details in a notice of annual meeting

words.enDefinition: An HMRC notice explaining a PAYE code and its calculation

examples.en: The example notice of coding listed one adjustment below the personal allowance line.
examples.zh: 「英国工资税代码通知」样本在个人免税额一行下方列了一项调整。

examples.en: Our adviser compared the notice of coding with the code on the mock payslip.
examples.zh: 顾问把「英国工资税代码通知」与模拟工资单上的代码作了对照。

collocations: details on a notice of coding

words.enDefinition: A UK consumer's statement added to explain an entry in their credit file

examples.en: The fictional customer supplied a notice of correction explaining their interrupted payment history.
examples.zh: 虚构客户提交了一份「信用档案说明声明」，解释为什么还款记录中断过。

examples.en: Our class discussed what the notice of correction added to the sample report.
examples.zh: 全班讨论了「信用档案说明声明」给报告样本补充了哪些信息。

collocations: a notice of correction on a credit file

words.enDefinition: An oral or written report from a sender describing a possible problem with the transfer.

examples.en: The case file included a notice of error about money arriving later than the disclosed date.
examples.zh: 案件档案里有一份「汇款差错报告」，反映款项晚于披露日期到达。

examples.en: The provider's sample letter confirmed a notice of error had been received from the sender.
examples.zh: 服务商的示例信件确认，已收到汇款人的「汇款差错报告」。

collocations: keep a record of a notice of error

words.zhGloss: 信贷申请材料不全通知
words.enDefinition: A US lender's notice explaining what a credit application still lacks
acceptedZhAnswers: 信贷申请材料不全通知

examples.en: The sample notice of incompleteness asked the fictional applicant to provide one missing statement.
examples.zh: 「信贷申请材料不全通知」的样本要求虚构申请人补一份缺少的账单。

examples.en: We compared the notice of incompleteness with a letter declining a completed application.
examples.zh: 我们对照了「信贷申请材料不全通知」和拒绝一份材料齐全申请的信。

collocations: respond to a notice of incompleteness

words.expression: notice of internet availability of proxy materials
words.lemma: notice of internet availability of proxy materials
words.zhGloss: 委托投票材料上网通知
words.enDefinition: a US notice that voting materials are accessible online
acceptedZhAnswers: 委托投票材料上网通知
acceptedEnVariants: notice of internet availability of proxy materials

examples.en: The notice of internet availability of proxy materials gave the web address for the sample meeting documents.
examples.zh: 「委托投票材料上网通知」给出了可查看样本会议文件的网址。

examples.en: We read a notice of internet availability of proxy materials before opening the sample proxy statement.
examples.zh: 在打开样本股东委托投票说明书前，我们读了一份「委托投票材料上网通知」。

collocations: send a notice of internet availability of proxy materials
receive a notice of internet availability of proxy materials
details in the notice of internet availability of proxy materials

words.zhGloss: 加拿大税务重新核定通知
words.enDefinition: A CRA notice showing a revised assessment for a tax year
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大税务重新核定通知

examples.en: The sample notice of reassessment followed a later change to the original filing.
examples.zh: 「加拿大税务重新核定通知」的样本是在原申报后来变化后出具的。

examples.en: We compared the notice of reassessment with the first assessment in the case.
examples.zh: 我们把「加拿大税务重新核定通知」与案例中的初次核定作了对照。

collocations: changes on a notice of reassessment

words.enDefinition: a formal notice stating that some or all of a bond issue will be redeemed

examples.en: The fictional issuer's notice of redemption gave holders the amount and date of the upcoming payment.
examples.zh: 虚构发行人的「债券赎回通知」告诉持有人即将支付的金额和日期。

examples.en: Our class checked whether the notice of redemption covered the whole issue or only part.
examples.zh: 我们班核对了「债券赎回通知」是覆盖整个发行批次，还是只覆盖其中一部分。

words.enDefinition: A US written notice explaining the result of a credit dispute review

examples.en: The sample notice of results explained which credit entries changed after the review.
examples.zh: 「异议调查结果通知」的样本说明了复查后哪些信用记录改了。

examples.en: We received a fictional notice of results and matched it to the relevant dispute.
examples.zh: 我们收到了一份虚构的「异议调查结果通知」，并找出它对应哪起异议。

words.enDefinition: Authorisation for a contractor to start work on an agreed scope

examples.en: The schedule began on the day the notice to proceed was issued.
examples.zh: 工程进度从发出「开工指令」的当天开始计算。

examples.en: We found the notice to proceed on the timeline after contract signing.
examples.zh: 我们在合同签署之后的时间线上找到了「开工指令」。

collocations: work after the notice to proceed

words.enDefinition: A graph showing net present value at different discount rates

examples.en: Our NPV profile sloped downward as the discount rate rose in the example.
examples.zh: 本例中，折现率上升时我们的「净现值曲线」向下倾斜。

examples.en: The class drew an NPV profile for each of the two proposed machines.
examples.zh: 全班为两台拟采购设备分别画了「净现值曲线」。

words.enDefinition: The span of time during which a lender's offer remains available

examples.en: The two fictional lenders used different dates for the offer validity period.
examples.zh: 两家虚构贷款机构为「报价有效期」设了不同的日期。

examples.en: The contract preview showed the offer validity period above the estimated payment amount.
examples.zh: 合同预览把「报价有效期」列在预计还款额上方。

words.enDefinition: the price at which securities are initially offered to buyers

examples.en: We found the final offering price on the cover of the sample share prospectus.
examples.zh: 我们在样本股票招募说明书封面找到了最终「发行价格」。

examples.en: The worksheet separated the offering price from the stock's first traded price on the exchange.
examples.zh: 练习表将「发行价格」与该股票在交易所的首笔成交价分开。

words.enDefinition: the number or total value of securities offered

examples.en: The sample prospectus expressed offering size both in shares and in estimated monetary terms.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书用股份数量和估计金额两种方式表示「发行规模」。

examples.en: The class noted how the offering size changed between the preliminary and final documents.
examples.zh: 同学们注意到初步文件与最终文件之间的「发行规模」有何变化。

words.enDefinition: A contract for a buyer to purchase a project's output

examples.en: The offtake agreement described how the buyer would pay for delivered output.
examples.zh: 「项目产出承购协议」说明了买方怎样为交付的产出付款。

examples.en: We included revenue covered by the offtake agreement in its own row.
examples.zh: 我们把「项目产出承购协议」涵盖的收入单独列了一行。

words.enDefinition: A buyer that agrees to take output from a project

examples.en: The offtaker in our case agreed to buy the plant's output.
examples.zh: 案例中的「项目产出承购方」同意购买工厂的产出。

examples.en: We noted which offtaker was responsible for the contracted payments.
examples.zh: 我们记下了由哪家「项目产出承购方」支付合同款项。

words.enDefinition: Testing how an outcome changes when a single assumption changes

examples.en: The one-way sensitivity analysis changed only projected sales while other inputs stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 「单因素敏感性分析」只改变了预测销量，其余输入值保持不变。

examples.en: We used one-way sensitivity analysis to see which demand assumption mattered most.
examples.zh: 我们用「单因素敏感性分析」看哪项需求假设影响最大。

collocations: a one-way sensitivity analysis of costs

words.enDefinition: a UK fund disclosure measure of specified recurring expenses

examples.en: The archived UK document showed an ongoing charges figure alongside a separate note about transaction costs.
examples.zh: 这份存档的英国文件列有「持续费用率」，另有说明解释交易成本。

examples.en: We compared the ongoing charges figure in the archived document with the fees in our sample.
examples.zh: 我们将存档文件中的「持续费用率」与样本里的费用作了比较。

words.zhGloss: 安大略省学生资助计划

acceptedZhAnswers: 安大略省学生资助计划

examples.en: The sample funding letter was issued under the Ontario Student Assistance Program for the coming term.
examples.zh: 资助样本信是在「安大略省学生资助计划」下为下学期发出的。

examples.en: The Ontario college guide linked to the Ontario Student Assistance Program from its funding page.
examples.zh: 安大略省的学院指南在资助页面链接了「安大略省学生资助计划」。

words.enDefinition: A shortfall when operating income does not cover operating expenses

examples.en: The first operating year showed an operating deficit because revenue rose slowly.
examples.zh: 第一运营年收入增长缓慢，出现了「运营收支赤字」。

examples.en: The spreadsheet showed how the operating deficit changed after demand estimates fell.
examples.zh: 电子表格显示，需求预估下降后，「运营收支赤字」如何变化。

collocations: an operating deficit in the first year

words.enDefinition: A contract setting out responsibility for operating and maintaining a facility

examples.en: The operations and maintenance agreement explained who would inspect the site after construction.
examples.zh: 「运营维护协议」说明了工程完工后由谁检查场地。

examples.en: The template put the fee under the operations and maintenance agreement beside forecast operating costs.
examples.zh: 模板把「运营维护协议」项下的收费列在预计运营成本旁。

collocations: sign an operations and maintenance agreement
services under an operations and maintenance agreement
review an operations and maintenance agreement

words.enDefinition: a model-based spread over benchmark rates after accounting for embedded options in a bond

examples.en: We used the option-adjusted spread to compare the sample callable bond with a similar noncallable issue.
examples.zh: 我们用「期权调整利差」比较样本可赎回债券与一只类似的不可赎回债券。

examples.en: The analyst explained why the option-adjusted spread changed when the assumed interest rate volatility changed.
examples.zh: 分析人员解释了为什么假定的利率波动率改变后，「期权调整利差」也会变化。

words.enDefinition: Flexibility to delay a project until more information becomes available

examples.en: The example valued an option to defer while the team waited for new information.
examples.zh: 范例估算了团队等待新信息期间「延后投资选择权」的价值。

examples.en: The worksheet included an option to defer alongside the immediate investment case.
examples.zh: 练习表把「延后投资选择权」和立即投资的情况并列展示。

words.enDefinition: a redemption the issuer may choose to make under the stated conditions

examples.en: The terms included optional redemption after a specified date at the price shown in the table.
examples.zh: 条款包括在指定日期后按表列价格进行「选择性赎回」的安排。

examples.en: We discussed whether optional redemption changed the cash flows we needed to model for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「选择性赎回」是否会改变练习中需要模拟的现金流。

words.enDefinition: A monetary amount shown in the currency used before any later conversion or translation.

examples.en: The report kept the original currency amount alongside its equivalent in the university's reporting currency.
examples.zh: 报告保留了「原币金额」，并在旁边列出按大学报告币种折算后的金额。

examples.en: We located the original currency amount before comparing two records of the same payment in class.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「原币金额」，再在课堂上比较同一笔付款的两份记录。

words.enDefinition: the amount by which certain debt is issued below the amount repayable at maturity

examples.zh: 示例在票据到期应付金额旁列了「原始发行折价」。

examples.zh: 讲师区分了「原始发行折价」与后来债券市场价格的下跌。

words.enDefinition: Reference details that identify the earlier payment to which a later message relates.

examples.zh: 示例退回记录包含「原交易参考信息」，这样财务团队可以把两份记录配对。

examples.en: The original transaction reference pointed to a different record than the number for the return itself.
examples.zh: 「原交易参考信息」和退回业务本身的编号指向不同记录。

collocations: use the original transaction reference to match records

words.enDefinition: The lender that originally made the loan to the borrower

examples.zh: 示例将「最初发放贷款的机构」与管理还款的公司分开列出。

examples.zh: 我们把「最初发放贷款的机构」和最初申请表上写的公司对上了。

words.zhGloss: 澳洲海外学习支出贷款

examples.zh: 大学的出国交换指南把「澳洲海外学习支出贷款」放在如何筹措海外学习费用的章节。

examples.en: The adviser used OS-HELP as an example of a loan for eligible overseas study costs.
examples.zh: 顾问以「澳洲海外学习支出贷款」为例，说明可用于符合条件的海外学习支出的贷款。

words.enDefinition: A label used in a U.S. remittance disclosure for covered fees charged by parties other than the provider.

examples.en: The Other Fees line of the mock receipt showed a charge applied through the payment chain.
examples.zh: 模拟回执的「其他费用」一栏显示了付款链路中产生的一笔费用。

examples.en: We read the explanation beside Other Fees before comparing the figure with the provider's own charge.
examples.zh: 我们先读了「其他费用」一栏旁的说明，再把这一金额与服务商自己的收费作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a scholarship given by an organisation other than the school the student attends

examples.en: The university asked me to report an outside scholarship awarded by a local community foundation.
examples.zh: 学校请我报告当地社区基金会发给我的「校外机构奖学金」。

examples.en: An outside scholarship appeared as a separate entry in my revised aid offer for the semester.
examples.zh: 这学期更新的资助方案把「校外机构奖学金」单列为一项。

words.enDefinition: issued shares currently held by parties other than the issuing company

examples.zh: 案例计算公司的「发行在外股份」时排除了库存股。

examples.en: The ownership table showed how a new issue increased outstanding shares in the fictional company.
examples.zh: 股权表显示新发行如何增加虚构公司的「发行在外股份」。

words.enDefinition: an option allowing underwriters to purchase extra shares under agreed terms

examples.en: The sample prospectus listed an over-allotment option separately from the initial number of offered shares.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书把「超额配售选择权」和最初发售的股份数量分开列出。

examples.zh: 我们核对虚构的交割公告，确认承销商是否行使了「超额配售选择权」。

words.zhGloss: 在境外期间累积的欠款

examples.zh: 样本对账单把「在境外期间累积的欠款」与当前月度金额分开列出。

examples.en: The loan adviser explained what the overseas arrears line meant in the fictitious borrower record.
examples.zh: 贷款顾问解释了虚构借款人记录中的「在境外期间累积的欠款」一栏是什么意思。

examples.zh: 借款人指南展示了在面向境外居住人士的章节哪里出现「在境外期间的收入评估」。

examples.zh: 顾问解释了示例信里的「在境外期间的收入评估」适用于哪个国家。
