examples.en: The report showed an overweight position in a sector that made up less of the benchmark.
examples.zh: 报告显示一个「超配头寸」，该行业在基准中占比较小。

examples.en: Our class identified an overweight position by comparing the portfolio's sector weight with the benchmark's.
examples.zh: 我们比较投资组合和基准的行业权重，找出一个「超配头寸」。

collocations: an overweight position relative to the benchmark

words.enDefinition: a reduction in an existing holder's ownership percentage

examples.en: The worksheet illustrated ownership dilution when the fictional company issued additional shares to new investors.
examples.zh: 练习表说明，虚构公司向新投资者增发股份时如何造成「持股比例稀释」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which assumptions mattered when calculating ownership dilution under the two proposed share issues.
examples.zh: 导师问，计算两项拟议发行下的「持股比例稀释」时，哪些假设重要。

words.zhGloss: 英国雇员福利与费用申报表
words.enDefinition: A UK form reporting certain expenses and benefits provided to employees
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国雇员福利与费用申报表

examples.en: The example P11D showed a benefit that the employer had reported separately.
examples.zh: 「英国雇员福利与费用申报表」样本显示了一项雇主单独申报的福利。

examples.en: Our tutor compared a P11D with an ordinary monthly payroll statement.
examples.zh: 导师把「英国雇员福利与费用申报表」与普通月度工资报表作了比较。

words.zhGloss: 英国停工后的退税申请表
words.enDefinition: An HMRC form for certain repayments after someone stops working
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国停工后的退税申请表

examples.en: The tax guide introduced P50 in its example about stopping work.
examples.zh: 税务指南在有关停止工作的例子中介绍了「英国停工后的退税申请表」。

examples.en: Our lesson used a blank P50 to illustrate repayment request documents.
examples.zh: 课程用空白的「英国停工后的退税申请表」来说明退税申请文件。

words.zhGloss: 英国薪税年末结算通知
words.enDefinition: An HMRC calculation comparing PAYE income tax paid with tax due
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国薪税年末结算通知

examples.en: The example P800 compared income tax paid with the calculated amount due.
examples.zh: 「英国薪税年末结算通知」样本比较了已缴所得税和计算出的应缴所得税。

examples.en: The workshop put a P800 beside the mock yearly pay summary.
examples.zh: 工作坊把一份「英国薪税年末结算通知」放在模拟年度薪资汇总表旁。

words.enDefinition: An HMRC form for reporting departure from the United Kingdom

examples.en: We found P85 in the document examples about moving overseas from Britain.
examples.zh: 我们在有关从英国移居海外的文件示例中找到了「英国离境税务通知表」。

examples.en: The sample P85 asked when the fictional employee had left the country.
examples.zh: 「英国离境税务通知表」样本问那名虚构员工何时离开英国。

collocations: the departure date on form P85

words.zhGloss: 英国简易税额核定通知
words.enDefinition: The HMRC letter setting out a Simple Assessment tax bill
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国简易税额核定通知

examples.en: Our tutor showed how the PA302 set out the calculated balance.
examples.zh: 导师展示了「英国简易税额核定通知」如何列出计算得出的应缴余额。

examples.en: The sample PA302 also listed the payment reference below the balance.
examples.zh: 「英国简易税额核定通知」样本还在应缴余额下方列出了付款参考编号。

collocations: the amount shown on a PA302

words.enDefinition: a stated nominal amount assigned to a share

examples.en: The sample charter gave each share a par value smaller than the public offering price.
examples.zh: 样本章程给每股定的「股份面值」低于公开发行价。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to separate par value from the quoted price on the exchange.
examples.zh: 导师让我们区分「股份面值」与交易所报价。

words.enDefinition: a Latin phrase meaning on equal footing, often used when obligations rank equally

examples.en: The lecturer pointed out that the two notes ranked pari passu in the example's payment structure.
examples.zh: 讲师指出，在该示例的付款结构中，两只票据处于「同等受偿顺位」。

examples.en: Our reading group discussed what pari passu meant for holders of the two unsecured notes.
examples.zh: 读书小组讨论了「同等受偿顺位」对两只无担保票据的持有人意味着什么。

words.enDefinition: A return of only part of the amount of an original payment.

examples.en: The training case showed a partial return of funds for one part of the original invoice.
examples.zh: 培训案例显示，原账单中一部分款项作了「资金部分退回」处理。

examples.en: The analyst distinguished a partial return of funds from a correction to the invoice amount.
examples.zh: 分析员区分了「资金部分退回」与更正账单金额。

collocations: record a partial return of funds
receive a partial return of funds
a report of a partial return of funds

words.enDefinition: an order for which only some of the requested amount has traded

examples.en: The simulation showed a partially filled order after only six of the ten shares were bought.
examples.zh: 十股中只买入六股后，模拟系统显示为一笔「部分成交的委托单」。

examples.en: We checked whether the remaining shares on the partially filled order appeared in the second trade confirmation.
examples.zh: 我们核对了这笔「部分成交的委托单」尚未成交的股份是否出现在第二份成交确认单上。

collocations: a partially filled order for stock
remaining quantity on a partially filled order

words.enDefinition: preferred shares entitled to participate in additional distributions under specified terms

examples.en: The case gave holders of participating preferred stock a share of proceeds remaining after the preference payment.
examples.zh: 案例中的「参与分配优先股」持有人可以分享支付优先分配额后剩余的款项。

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the extra distribution rights for participating preferred stock appeared in the sample terms.
examples.zh: 导师问，在样本条款的哪里能看到「参与分配优先股」的额外分配权。

words.enDefinition: An Australian notice showing an instalment toward expected income tax

examples.en: The workshop used a PAYG instalment notice in an example about a freelancer's income.
examples.zh: 工作坊用一份「澳洲PAYG预缴税通知」讲解一名自由职业者的收入案例。

examples.en: We checked the reporting period printed on the sample PAYG instalment notice.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「澳洲PAYG预缴税通知」样本上印的报告期间。

collocations: the amount on a PAYG instalment notice

words.enDefinition: An Australian payer's summary of payments and withholding during an income year

examples.en: The old payroll example recorded the withheld amount on a PAYG payment summary.
examples.zh: 过去的薪资示例通过一份「澳洲PAYG付款汇总单」记录预扣金额。

examples.en: I compared the mock PAYG payment summary with a separate employment income record.
examples.zh: 我把模拟的「澳洲PAYG付款汇总单」与一份单列的受雇收入记录作了对照。

collocations: amounts on a PAYG payment summary

words.enDefinition: A formal request by one institution asking another to cancel or return a previously instructed payment.

examples.en: The records included a payment cancellation request before the other bank reported its decision about returning funds.
examples.zh: 另一家银行报告是否退回款项的决定之前，记录里已有一条「请求取消付款的报文」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the payment cancellation request alone showed how the transfer finally ended.
examples.zh: 老师问，只看「请求取消付款的报文」能不能知道汇款的最终结果。

collocations: distinguish a payment cancellation request from a confirmed return

words.enDefinition: The sequence of participants and institutions that handle a payment from its origin to its destination.

examples.en: The diagram traced the payment chain from the university's bank to the supplier's receiving institution.
examples.zh: 这张图追踪了从大学的银行到供应商收款机构的「支付处理链路」。

examples.en: The workshop diagram showed where a charge had been recorded along the sample payment chain.
examples.zh: 培训示意图显示了示例「支付处理链路」中在哪个环节记录了一笔费用。

collocations: track a payment through the payment chain

words.enDefinition: The exchange and reconciliation of payment instructions before settlement, sometimes including calculation of net obligations.

examples.en: The lesson used payment clearing to describe how institutions checked instructions before settling their balances.
examples.zh: 课程用「支付清算」说明各机构在结算余额之前怎样核对指令。

examples.en: We studied payment clearing separately from the final movement of funds between the institutions.
examples.zh: 我们把「支付清算」与机构间资金最终划拨这两个环节分开学习。

words.enDefinition: A payment problem or unexpected condition that requires additional handling outside the usual process.

examples.en: The support record showed a payment exception before the institution confirmed the instruction could continue.
examples.zh: 机构确认指令可以继续处理前，支持记录显示出现了「支付处理异常」。

examples.en: Our training case followed one payment exception from the initial report to the final explanation.
examples.zh: 培训案例跟踪了一项「支付处理异常」，从最初报告讲到最终说明。

words.enDefinition: a loan status indicating that scheduled payments are not currently required, such as during eligible studies

examples.en: The borrower asked how payment-free status would be shown after the school confirmed their enrolment.
examples.zh: 借款人询问，学校确认在读后会怎样显示「暂免还款状态」。

examples.en: The sample letter used payment-free status to explain why there was no monthly amount due.
examples.zh: 样本信函用「暂免还款状态」解释了为什么没有每月应还金额。

collocations: keep a loan in payment-free status

words.enDefinition: A table showing payment status for successive months on one account

examples.en: The payment history grid showed a blank box for the month the account opened.
examples.zh: 「还款历史表格」里，开户当月的格子是空白的。

examples.en: We read the payment history grid from right to left using its printed dates.
examples.zh: 我们对着印好的日期，从右向左读「还款历史表格」。

collocations: a missing month in the payment history grid

words.enDefinition: A group of reference elements used to identify a payment or its instructions in a message.

examples.en: The sample payment identification grouped several references near the top of the international payment record.
examples.zh: 跨境付款记录示例上方的「付款标识信息」集中列出了几个参考编号。

examples.en: The trainer identified the payment identification before explaining what each reference in that group meant.
examples.zh: 培训员先指出「付款标识信息」的位置，再解释其中每个参考编号的意思。

collocations: a group of payment identification fields

words.enDefinition: A message requesting that a financial institution start one or more payments on behalf of an initiating party.

examples.en: The worksheet distinguished a payment initiation message from the payment record the bank produced later.
examples.zh: 练习表区分了「付款发起报文」和银行后来生成的付款记录。

examples.en: We read a payment initiation message in the example about a university paying two suppliers.
examples.zh: 大学向两家供应商付款的示例中，我们读到一条「付款发起报文」。

words.zhGloss: 付款查询调查答复报文
words.enDefinition: An institutional message responding to an inquiry about a particular payment or payment exception.
acceptedZhAnswers: 付款查询调查答复报文

examples.en: The payment investigation response described what the second bank had verified in its own records.
examples.zh: 「付款查询调查答复报文」说明了第二家银行在本机构记录中核实了什么。

examples.en: We compared the payment investigation response with the details in the training case's original inquiry.
examples.zh: 我们把「付款查询调查答复报文」和培训案例最初查询中的详细信息作了比对。

collocations: compare the payment investigation response with the inquiry

words.enDefinition: One stage of a payment or one of the linked transfers making up a transaction.

examples.en: The worksheet showed a payment leg between the sending institution and the first correspondent bank.
examples.zh: 练习表展示了发送机构到第一家代理银行之间的「付款链路中的一段」。

examples.en: We learned that a payment leg could be recorded separately from later stages of the transaction.
examples.zh: 我们了解到，「付款链路中的一段」可以与交易后续环节分开记录。

words.enDefinition: An advance payment toward a UK Self Assessment tax bill

examples.en: The timeline showed a payment on account before the final Self Assessment calculation.
examples.zh: 时间线显示，计算最终的自行申报税额之前有一笔「英国自行申报预缴款」。

examples.en: We distinguished a payment on account from the remaining balance in the example ledger.
examples.zh: 我们在账目样本上区分了「英国自行申报预缴款」和剩余应缴余额。

words.enDefinition: The recorded date the provider received the sender's payment for the transfer.

examples.en: The payment received date was shown in a different box from the date funds became available.
examples.zh: 「服务商收款日期」与款项可用日期列在不同的方框里。

examples.en: The agent compared the payment received date with the time recorded in the first case note.
examples.zh: 客服人员把「服务商收款日期」和首条案件记录上写的时间作了比较。

collocations: look up the payment received date

words.enDefinition: Review and correction of a payment instruction that could not proceed in its original form.

examples.en: The payment repair case showed that an authorised team had reviewed the incomplete instruction for accuracy.
examples.zh: 「支付报文修正处理」案例显示，获授权的团队核对了不完整指令的准确性。

examples.en: We read a payment repair note in the practice record before comparing the later status message.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读练习记录中的「支付报文修正处理」说明，再去对比后来的状态报文。

collocations: send an instruction for payment repair

words.enDefinition: A message carrying information about a payment being returned, such as the original references and reason.

examples.en: The example separated the payment return message from the record of the original settled payment.
examples.zh: 例子把「退回付款报文」与原来已结算付款的记录分开了。

examples.en: The analyst used the payment return message to link the returned funds to the original instruction.
examples.zh: 分析员用「退回付款报文」把退回的资金与原始指令对应起来。

words.enDefinition: A short identifier describing an account's reported payment standing

examples.en: The sample account showed a payment status code for each month in the table.
examples.zh: 样例账户的表格里，每个月都有一个「付款状态代码」。

examples.en: The lecturer explained why the same payment status code appeared beside three different months.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么相同的「付款状态代码」出现在三个不同月份旁边。

words.enDefinition: A message reporting the processing status of a payment or a related instruction.

examples.en: The student compared the payment status report with the original instruction in the practice example.
examples.zh: 学生把练习里的「付款状态报文」与原始指令作了比较。

examples.en: The payment status report noted that the interbank settlement step had completed in this example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，「付款状态报文」显示银行间结算环节已经完成。

collocations: compare a payment status report with the original instruction

words.enDefinition: A message asking another institution to report the current status of a previously sent payment.

examples.en: We matched the payment status request with the later reply in the set of training records.
examples.zh: 我们把培训记录中的「付款状态查询报文」和后来收到的答复配对。

examples.en: The payment status request referred to an instruction the institution had sent the previous business day.
examples.zh: 「付款状态查询报文」指的是该机构前一个营业日发出的指令。

collocations: match a payment status request with the response

words.zhGloss: 付款已转交，当前追踪不再继续
words.enDefinition: A Swift tracking reason indicating onward transfer to another institution or system without further tracking in that flow.
acceptedZhAnswers: 付款已转交，当前追踪不再继续

examples.en: The training record displayed payment transferred and not tracked after the bank passed the instruction onward.
examples.zh: 银行把指令继续转交后，培训记录显示「付款已转交，当前追踪不再继续」。

examples.en: We compared payment transferred and not tracked with the example that showed actual credit to the recipient.
examples.zh: 我们把「付款已转交，当前追踪不再继续」与显示收款方实际入账的示例作了比较。

collocations: a reason marked payment transferred and not tracked
read payment transferred and not tracked
explain payment transferred and not tracked

words.enDefinition: A settlement arrangement in which each linked currency payment becomes final only if the other becomes final too.

examples.en: The workshop used payment-versus-payment to illustrate the link between the two currency payments in settlement.
examples.zh: 培训用「支付对支付结算」来说明结算中不同币种的两笔付款怎样相互关联。

examples.en: We compared payment-versus-payment with an example where the two currencies settled independently of each other.
examples.zh: 我们把「支付对支付结算」与两种货币各自独立结算的例子作了比较。

words.enDefinition: An employment benefit whose value is taxed through UK payroll

examples.en: A payrolled benefit appeared beside cash earnings in the mock payroll figures.
examples.zh: 模拟工资数据里，现金工资旁边列有一项「通过工资计税的福利」。

examples.en: We traced the payrolled benefit to the employer's note explaining the extra amount.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「通过工资计税的福利」找到了雇主解释额外金额的备注。

collocations: show a payrolled benefit on a payslip

words.enDefinition: a comparison with funds sharing similar objectives or characteristics

examples.en: The peer group comparison in our exercise included only funds with a similar investment objective.
examples.zh: 练习中的「同类基金比较」只纳入投资目标相似的基金。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed a peer group comparison that used funds with two different reporting periods.
examples.zh: 导师讨论了一项「同类基金比较」，其中的基金使用了两个不同的报告期间。

words.zhGloss: 佩尔助学金计算所用修读比例
words.enDefinition: the share of a full-time course load a student takes for purposes of calculating Pell Grant amounts
acceptedZhAnswers: 佩尔助学金计算所用修读比例

examples.en: The aid office explained the Pell Grant enrollment intensity used for a student taking fewer credits.
examples.zh: 助学办公室解释了，学分数较少的学生采用什么「佩尔助学金计算所用修读比例」。

examples.en: We compared the Pell Grant enrollment intensity in two examples with different numbers of credits.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个学分数不同的例子中的「佩尔助学金计算所用修读比例」。

collocations: check the Pell Grant enrollment intensity

words.zhGloss: 佩尔助学金终身资格已用比例
words.enDefinition: the percentage of a student's lifetime Pell Grant eligibility already used, calculated from prior awards
acceptedZhAnswers: 佩尔助学金终身资格已用比例

examples.en: The handbook showed how Pell Grant Lifetime Eligibility Used appeared in a student's aid record.
examples.zh: 手册展示了「佩尔助学金终身资格已用比例」在学生助学记录里的呈现方式。

examples.en: The adviser checked Pell Grant Lifetime Eligibility Used before discussing the student's remaining grant eligibility.
examples.zh: 顾问先核对了「佩尔助学金终身资格已用比例」，再谈这名学生还剩多少助学金额度。

collocations: review Pell Grant Lifetime Eligibility Used
check Pell Grant Lifetime Eligibility Used
report Pell Grant Lifetime Eligibility Used

words.zhGloss: 佩尔助学金全日制全年核定额
words.enDefinition: the amount a student would receive in Pell Grant aid for full-time attendance over a full academic year
acceptedZhAnswers: 佩尔助学金全日制全年核定额

examples.en: Our adviser compared the Pell Grant Scheduled Award with the actual award for reduced enrolment.
examples.zh: 顾问把「佩尔助学金全日制全年核定额」与减少修读量后实际核定的金额作了比较。

examples.en: The worksheet used the Pell Grant Scheduled Award before adjusting the payment for enrollment intensity.
examples.zh: 练习表先列「佩尔助学金全日制全年核定额」，再按修读量比例调整发放金额。

collocations: calculate the Pell Grant Scheduled Award
determine the Pell Grant Scheduled Award
note the Pell Grant Scheduled Award

words.zhGloss: 加拿大养老金累积调整额
words.enDefinition: A Canadian figure reflecting pension benefits accrued through certain employer plans
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大养老金累积调整额

examples.en: The sample earnings slip showed a pension adjustment next to its numbered box.
examples.zh: 收入税务单样本的编号栏旁边列了「加拿大养老金累积调整额」。

examples.en: The class checked the pension adjustment against the note about the workplace plan.
examples.zh: 全班根据单位养老金计划的备注核对了「加拿大养老金累积调整额」。

collocations: a pension adjustment on a slip

words.enDefinition: analysis explaining how investment decisions contributed to portfolio results

examples.en: The performance attribution table separated the effects of sector weights from choices within each sector.
examples.zh: 「业绩归因」表区分了行业权重和行业内投资选择带来的影响。

examples.en: Our tutor used performance attribution to discuss why the sample fund lagged behind its benchmark.
examples.zh: 导师用「业绩归因」讨论为什么样本基金业绩落后于基准。

words.enDefinition: a fee linked to investment results under stated terms

examples.en: The sample performance fee depended on results measured against the benchmark defined in the document.
examples.zh: 样本「业绩报酬」取决于按文件规定的基准衡量的业绩。

examples.en: We checked how the performance fee appeared in the cost breakdown of the fictional fund.
examples.zh: 我们查了「业绩报酬」在虚构基金的成本明细里是怎么列示的。

words.enDefinition: a minimum result required before a performance fee is payable

examples.en: The worksheet compared the sample fund's result with the performance fee hurdle stated in its terms.
examples.zh: 练习表将样本基金的业绩与条款列出的「业绩报酬门槛」作了比较。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the performance fee hurdle was a fixed rate or a benchmark return.
examples.zh: 导师问，「业绩报酬门槛」是固定比率还是基准回报率。

words.zhGloss: 约定的性能不达标赔偿额
words.enDefinition: Contractually predetermined damages for failing to achieve defined performance levels
acceptedZhAnswers: 约定的性能不达标赔偿额

examples.en: The example provided for performance liquidated damages if the plant failed its output tests.
examples.zh: 本例规定，工厂产出测试不达标时须付「约定的性能不达标赔偿额」。

examples.en: Our group identified performance liquidated damages in the contract's performance section.
examples.zh: 我们组在合同的性能章节里找出了「约定的性能不达标赔偿额」。

collocations: a clause on performance liquidated damages

words.enDefinition: A legally recognised reason for obtaining a US consumer report

examples.en: The class identified a permissible purpose in the hypothetical lender's request for information.
examples.zh: 全班从假设的贷款机构信息调取请求中识别出一个「允许查询的用途」。

examples.en: The sample form asked the company to declare its permissible purpose for access.
examples.zh: 表单样本要求公司说明访问报告的「允许用途」。

words.enDefinition: a bond with no scheduled maturity date, though the issuer may have a right to redeem it

examples.en: The terms of the perpetual bond listed call dates but showed no fixed maturity date.
examples.zh: 「永续债券」的条款列出了可赎回日期，没有列固定到期日。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the perpetual bond would have to be redeemed at its first call date.
examples.zh: 导师问，「永续债券」是否必须在首次可赎回日期赎回。

words.zhGloss: 英国个人税务在线账户
words.enDefinition: An HMRC online service for viewing and managing personal tax information
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国个人税务在线账户

examples.en: The training screenshot showed estimated income in a personal tax account.
examples.zh: 培训截图显示，一份「英国个人税务在线账户」会列出预计收入。

examples.en: The adviser explained where a personal tax account might display the current PAYE code.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「英国个人税务在线账户」在哪个位置可能显示当前的工资计税代码。

collocations: information shown in a personal tax account

words.zhGloss: 英国学生贷款还款方案一
words.enDefinition: a UK student loan repayment category that includes Northern Ireland loans and some older English or Welsh loans
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生贷款还款方案一

examples.en: The sample Plan 1 letter was for someone who had borrowed through Student Finance Northern Ireland.
examples.zh: 这封「英国学生贷款还款方案一」样本信面向通过北爱尔兰学生资助服务借款的人。

examples.en: Our class compared the official Plan 1 description with summaries for other UK repayment plans.
examples.zh: 我们班把官方对「英国学生贷款还款方案一」的说明和其他英国还款方案的摘要作了比较。

words.zhGloss: 英国学生贷款还款方案二
words.enDefinition: a UK student loan repayment category covering specified English and Welsh loans, depending on the course and dates
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生贷款还款方案二

examples.en: A guide used Plan 2 as its example when explaining why course dates matter for repayment.
examples.zh: 有份指南用「英国学生贷款还款方案二」举例，解释课程日期为什么与还款有关。

examples.en: The adviser pointed to Plan 2 on the sample account before discussing other repayment categories.
examples.zh: 顾问先指出示例账户上的「英国学生贷款还款方案二」，再介绍其他还款类别。

words.zhGloss: 英国学生贷款还款方案四
words.enDefinition: the UK student loan repayment category for loans taken through the Student Awards Agency Scotland
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生贷款还款方案四

examples.en: The workbook showed Plan 4 for a borrower funded through the Student Awards Agency Scotland.
examples.zh: 练习册用「英国学生贷款还款方案四」举例，借款人通过苏格兰学生资助署获得资助。

examples.en: I read the Plan 4 heading while comparing the official summaries of the UK plans.
examples.zh: 我在对比英国各方案的官方摘要时，读到了「英国学生贷款还款方案四」这个标题。

words.zhGloss: 英国学生贷款还款方案五
words.enDefinition: a UK student loan repayment category for certain newer loans administered under English student finance arrangements
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生贷款还款方案五

examples.en: The example referred to Plan 5 for a newer undergraduate loan under Student Finance England.
examples.zh: 例子在谈英格兰学生资助服务下较新的本科贷款时，提到了「英国学生贷款还款方案五」。

examples.en: The adviser used a Plan 5 notice to show where the repayment category was printed.
examples.zh: 顾问拿了「英国学生贷款还款方案五」通知，展示还款类别印在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a system electing candidates with the most votes regardless of an absolute majority

examples.en: The fictional election used plurality voting and awarded seats to the candidates with the most votes.
examples.zh: 虚构选举采用「相对多数投票制」，得票最多的候选人当选。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how plurality voting would treat a candidate receiving less than half the votes.
examples.zh: 导师问，在「相对多数投票制」下，怎样处理获得不足半数选票的候选人。

words.enDefinition: a change in portfolio weights away from their targets

examples.en: Price changes caused portfolio drift even though the sample fund had made no new trades.
examples.zh: 尽管样本基金没有新交易，价格变动仍造成了「组合权重偏离」。

examples.en: Our class checked how much portfolio drift had occurred since the allocation targets were last set.
examples.zh: 我们班核对了自上次设定配置目标以来出现了多大的「组合权重偏离」。

words.enDefinition: a release of information about the investments a fund holds

examples.en: The exercise asked which asset categories appeared in the fund's most recent portfolio holdings disclosure.
examples.zh: 练习问，基金最近一次「组合持仓披露」中列出了哪些类资产。

examples.en: The dates on the portfolio holdings disclosure helped us distinguish it from the earlier fact sheet.
examples.zh: 我们看了「组合持仓披露」上的日期，把它和此前的基金概况表区分开来。

words.enDefinition: a manager's explanation of portfolio activity and performance

examples.en: The portfolio manager commentary linked the quarter's results to weakness in two large holdings.
examples.zh: 「组合经理评述」把本季度业绩与两项大额持仓表现疲软联系起来。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to distinguish the portfolio manager commentary from the table of reported returns.
examples.zh: 导师让我们区分「组合经理评述」和所报告的回报率表。

words.enDefinition: the extent to which portfolios hold the same investments

examples.en: The exercise checked portfolio overlap between two sample funds with very different names and objectives.
examples.zh: 练习检查了两个名称和目标相差很大的样本基金的「组合持仓重叠」情况。

examples.en: Our tutor used portfolio overlap to explain why comparing fund names alone gave an incomplete picture.
examples.zh: 导师用「组合持仓重叠」说明为什么仅比较基金名称会遗漏一些情况。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred when a fund trades its investments

examples.en: The sample fund reported portfolio transaction costs separately from the ongoing charges on the factsheet.
examples.zh: 这只样本基金把「组合交易成本」和概况表里的持续费用分开报告。

examples.en: Our exercise showed how frequent trading could affect portfolio transaction costs for the hypothetical fund.
examples.zh: 练习展示了频繁交易可能怎样影响假设基金的「组合交易成本」。

words.enDefinition: a ratio estimating the extent to which a fund trades holdings

examples.en: The shareholder report listed the portfolio turnover rate for the sample fund's latest fiscal year.
examples.zh: 持有人报告列出了样本基金最近一个财年的「投资组合换手率」。

examples.en: We discussed why a higher portfolio turnover rate might be associated with more transaction costs.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么较高的「投资组合换手率」可能伴随更多交易成本。

words.enDefinition: the proportion of a portfolio represented by an investment or category

examples.en: The worksheet calculated the portfolio weight of each holding using its share of total portfolio value.
examples.zh: 练习表按各项持仓占组合总值的比例计算其「投资组合权重」。

examples.en: Our class compared the portfolio weight of a holding before and after a price change.
examples.zh: 我们班比较了一项持仓在价格变动前后的「投资组合权重」。

words.enDefinition: a rating outlook indicating that the credit rating may be raised within the relevant horizon

examples.en: The fictional issuer received a positive outlook after the agency assessed its improving finances.
examples.zh: 评级机构评估财务状况有所改善后，虚构发行人的评级被赋予「正面评级展望」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the positive outlook was shown separately from the unchanged bond rating.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「正面评级展望」与没有变化的债券评级分开显示。

words.zhGloss: 英国研究生贷款还款方案
words.enDefinition: a UK repayment category for eligible English or Welsh postgraduate master's and doctoral student loans
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国研究生贷款还款方案

examples.en: My online account shows a Postgraduate Loan plan alongside a different plan for undergraduate study.
examples.zh: 我的在线账户既显示「英国研究生贷款还款方案」，也显示另一种本科贷款还款方案。

examples.en: The guide displayed the Postgraduate Loan plan in a separate row from the undergraduate examples.
examples.zh: 指南把「英国研究生贷款还款方案」与本科贷款示例分行列出。

collocations: payments under a Postgraduate Loan plan

words.enDefinition: An agreement governing the sale of electricity from a generator

examples.en: The power purchase agreement specified who would buy the electricity and how prices moved.
examples.zh: 「电力购买协议」明确了购电方是谁，以及电价怎样调整。

examples.en: The course used a power purchase agreement from an illustrative solar project.
examples.zh: 课程采用了一份示例太阳能项目的「电力购买协议」。

collocations: sell under a power purchase agreement
tariffs under a power purchase agreement

words.enDefinition: Key information supplied in the UK before a borrower agrees to credit

examples.en: The class highlighted pre-contract credit information in the example pack for UK borrowers.
examples.zh: 全班在面向英国借款人的材料样本里标出了「签约前信贷信息」。

examples.en: We compared pre-contract credit information from two fictional lenders offering the same amount.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两家虚构贷款机构就同一金额提供的「签约前信贷信息」。

words.zhGloss: 澳洲报税预填信息汇总
words.enDefinition: An ATO report gathering available data for preparing an individual return
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲报税预填信息汇总

examples.en: The pre-filling report contained a bank entry that we checked against the sample statement.
examples.zh: 「澳洲报税预填信息汇总」中有一条银行记录，我们用报表样本进行了核对。

examples.en: The adviser showed how the mock pre-filling report grouped entries from different sources.
examples.zh: 顾问展示了模拟的「澳洲报税预填信息汇总」如何把不同来源的信息分组。

words.enDefinition: shares with specified priority over common stock for certain distributions

examples.en: The mock offering described preferred stock that ranked ahead of common shares for dividend payments.
examples.zh: 模拟发行文件介绍了在股息支付顺序上优先于普通股的「优先股」。

examples.en: In the case, the terms of the preferred stock specified when holders could vote.
examples.zh: 案例中，「优先股」的条款说明了持有人在何时可以表决。

words.enDefinition: A settlement account in which funds are set aside in advance to cover payment obligations.

examples.en: The sample report described a prefunded settlement account with money reserved before any balances were settled.
examples.zh: 示例报告介绍了一个「预先注资的结算账户」，在结算余额前便已备好资金。

examples.en: A prefunded settlement account appeared in the payment diagram before the final settlement entries were shown.
examples.zh: 在最后几条结算记录出现前，付款示意图里先列出了「预先注资的结算账户」。

collocations: review a prefunded settlement account balance

words.enDefinition: an early offering prospectus that may omit final terms

examples.en: The preliminary prospectus did not yet give the final issue price in our classroom case.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例中，「初步招募说明书」尚未给出最终发行价。

examples.en: We compared the risk disclosures in the preliminary prospectus with the later version of the document.
examples.zh: 我们把「初步招募说明书」中的风险披露与文件的后续版本作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A borrowing charge paid separately or withheld when credit is extended

examples.en: We identified a prepaid finance charge in the mock disclosure before checking its totals.
examples.zh: 我们在核对总额之前，先在模拟披露表里找到了「预付融资费用」。

examples.en: The prepaid finance charge was withheld from the funds in our fictional loan example.
examples.zh: 在虚构贷款的例子中，「预付融资费用」从放款中扣除了。

words.enDefinition: A US offer sent after screening consumers against initial criteria

examples.en: A fictional student received a prescreened offer before asking any lender about borrowing.
examples.zh: 一位虚构学生在向任何贷款机构询问借款前，就收到了「预筛选授信邀约」。

examples.en: We compared a prescreened offer sent by mail with an ordinary lending advertisement.
examples.zh: 我们把邮寄的「预筛选授信邀约」和普通贷款广告作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Selecting US consumers for offers based on credit-related criteria before they apply

examples.en: The marketing example showed how prescreening could produce a list for mail offers.
examples.zh: 营销示例展示了如何用「营销名单预筛选」生成邮寄邀约的名单。

examples.en: The lecturer drew a timeline showing prescreening before any applications were received.
examples.zh: 老师画了条时间线，显示「营销名单预筛选」发生在收到任何申请之前。

words.enDefinition: An instruction not to use a US consumer's data for prescreening

examples.en: The sample notice used prescreening opt-out to describe a choice about marketing lists.
examples.zh: 告知样本用「退出授信营销预筛选」来说明营销名单上的一项选择。

examples.en: We underlined the prescreening opt-out wording in a fictional card offer sent by mail.
examples.zh: 我们在一份虚构的邮寄信用卡邀约上划出了「退出授信营销预筛选」的措辞。

words.enDefinition: A financial institution in an earlier part of the payment chain that previously sent an instruction.

examples.en: The example named a previous instructing agent after showing two banks that had handled the order.
examples.zh: 示例展示了处理过该指令的两家银行后，列出了一家「前序指令发送机构」。

examples.en: We found the previous instructing agent on the earlier part of the payment chain diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在支付链路图较前的位置找到了「前序指令发送机构」。

collocations: check the previous instructing agent entry

words.enDefinition: a return based only on price movements

examples.en: The price return in the exercise excluded the distributions shown in the next column.
examples.zh: 练习中的「价格回报率」不包括下一栏里的分配收益。

examples.en: Our tutor used price return to explain why a price index could differ from its total return version.
examples.zh: 导师通过「价格回报率」解释，价格指数为何可能与对应的总回报指数不同。

collocations: compare price return with total return

words.enDefinition: the date on which the final terms include an agreed price

examples.en: The fictional company's pricing date came before the first day of trading in our timetable.
examples.zh: 按我们的时间表，虚构公司的「发行定价日」早于首个交易日。

examples.en: We checked the pricing date before comparing two documents with different offering prices.
examples.zh: 我们先核对了「发行定价日」，再比较两份列出不同发行价格的文件。

collocations: terms fixed on the pricing date

words.enDefinition: the main comparison standard stated for a portfolio

examples.en: The sample equity fund listed a broad domestic index as its primary benchmark for performance.
examples.zh: 这只样本股票基金将一个覆盖面广的本国指数列为「主要业绩基准」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the primary benchmark had changed between the two versions of the report.
examples.zh: 导师问，这两版报告之间「主要业绩基准」是否有变化。

words.enDefinition: an offering in which an issuer sells newly issued shares

examples.en: The case's primary offering raised money for the company because it sold newly issued shares.
examples.zh: 案例中的「发行人发售新股」为公司筹集了资金，因为出售的是新发行的股份。

examples.en: The tutor contrasted a primary offering with a sale of shares held by existing owners.
examples.zh: 导师把「发行人发售新股」与现有股东出售持股作了比较。

collocations: shares issued in a primary offering

words.enDefinition: the main approaches a fund uses to pursue its objective

examples.en: The principal investment strategies section explained why the fund held only some index constituents.
examples.zh: 「主要投资策略」一节解释了基金为何只持有部分指数成分证券。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the principal investment strategies explained the sample fund's preference for smaller companies.
examples.zh: 导师问，「主要投资策略」有没有说明样本基金为何更偏向较小规模的公司。

collocations: a change in principal investment strategies

words.enDefinition: A main factor behind a lender's decision to decline an application

examples.en: The sample letter included a principal reason for denial beside the decision date.
examples.zh: 信件样本在决定日期旁写了一项「拒绝授信的主要原因」。

examples.en: We matched the principal reason for denial to the information highlighted in the mock report.
examples.zh: 我们把「拒绝授信的主要原因」和模拟报告里标出的信息对上了。

collocations: list the principal reason for denial
state a principal reason for denial
read the principal reason for denial

words.enDefinition: the main investment risks disclosed for a fund

examples.en: The principal risks section discussed what could happen if the fund's foreign holdings lost value.
examples.zh: 「主要投资风险」一节讨论了基金境外持仓贬值时可能发生什么。

examples.en: Students highlighted principal risks in the sample document before discussing the fund's short operating history.
examples.zh: 同学们在样本文件中标出了「主要投资风险」，然后讨论该基金较短的运作历史。

words.enDefinition: a transaction in which the firm buys or sells for its own account

examples.en: The sample confirmation identified a principal trade because the broker sold shares from its own account.
examples.zh: 样本确认单将这笔交易标为「券商自营交易」，因为卖出的是券商自身账户中的股份。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how a principal trade would be labelled in the fictional stock transaction record.
examples.zh: 导师解释了在虚构的股票交易记录中，「券商自营交易」会怎样标注。

collocations: a broker acting in a principal trade

words.enDefinition: A change reported this year to an amount from a previous year

examples.en: The sample tuition statement included a prior-year adjustment for a reversed charge.
examples.zh: 学费报表样本因一笔费用被撤销而列出「对往年金额的调整」。

examples.en: Our guide displayed the prior-year adjustment separately from this year's tuition payments.
examples.zh: 指南把「对往年金额的调整」和今年缴纳的学费分开显示。

words.zhGloss: 澳洲私人医保税务报表
words.enDefinition: An insurer's Australian statement with policy and premium details for tax
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲私人医保税务报表

examples.en: The class found a policy period on the sample private health insurance statement.
examples.zh: 全班在「澳洲私人医保税务报表」样本上找到了保单期间。

examples.en: The example private health insurance statement came from the insurer in our document matching exercise.
examples.zh: 在文件配对练习中，示例「澳洲私人医保税务报表」来自保险公司。

collocations: review a private health insurance statement
request a private health insurance statement
premiums on a private health insurance statement

words.enDefinition: the estimated chance that a borrower or specified obligation will default over a stated period

examples.en: The model reported the probability of default over one year for each fictional borrower in the exercise.
examples.zh: 模型报告了练习中每个虚构借款人一年内的「违约概率」。

examples.en: We used the same time horizon when comparing each borrower's estimated probability of default.
examples.zh: 我们先统一了时间区间，再比较表中各借款人的估计「违约概率」。

words.enDefinition: a short disclosure under the UK's consumer composite investments regime

examples.en: The UK example's product summary explained the fund's costs and described its intended holding period.
examples.zh: 英国样例的「投资产品摘要」解释了基金费用，并说明了预期持有期。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the risk wording in a UK product summary with the fund's prospectus.
examples.zh: 导师比较了英国「投资产品摘要」和基金招募说明书的风险措辞。

collocations: costs disclosed in a product summary

words.zhGloss: 资助人员个案酌情判断
words.enDefinition: in US financial aid, a qualified administrator's discretion to make certain case-specific adjustments under programme rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 资助人员个案酌情判断

examples.en: The adviser used professional judgment to review the documented cost of attendance in our sample case.
examples.zh: 在示例案例中，顾问依据「资助人员个案酌情判断」复核了材料里的就学总费用。

examples.en: Our workshop explained when the phrase professional judgment appears in federal financial aid guidance.
examples.zh: 工作坊解释了联邦助学指南在哪些情况下会出现「资助人员个案酌情判断」这个说法。

words.enDefinition: Present value of future net cash flows divided by initial investment

examples.en: The profitability index showed discounted net inflows relative to each project’s upfront cost.
examples.zh: 「获利指数」显示各项目折现后现金净流入与初始投资额的比率。

examples.en: The class compared the profitability index for two proposals needing different upfront amounts.
examples.zh: 全班比较了两项初始支出不同的方案所对应的「获利指数」。

collocations: a project with a higher profitability index

words.zhGloss: 禁止作为差别待遇的依据
words.enDefinition: A protected characteristic US lenders must not unlawfully use against applicants
acceptedZhAnswers: 禁止作为差别待遇的依据

examples.en: Our worksheet asked whether the case showed treatment based on a prohibited basis.
examples.zh: 练习题问，案例是否显示有人根据「禁止作为差别待遇的依据」区别对待申请人。

examples.en: The lecturer gave a fictional example to explain the phrase prohibited basis.
examples.zh: 老师用一个虚构例子解释了「禁止作为差别待遇的依据」这个术语。

collocations: a prohibited basis under fair lending rules

words.enDefinition: An amount added to estimated costs for uncertain project expenses

examples.en: The model added a project contingency allowance to the provisional construction estimate.
examples.zh: 模型在暂估建设费上加了「项目预备费」。

examples.en: We checked whether the project contingency allowance covered unforeseen work in our case.
examples.zh: 我们核对了该案例的「项目预备费」是否涵盖未预见的工程。

collocations: costs covered by a project contingency allowance

words.zhGloss: 项目寿命期偿债覆盖率
words.enDefinition: the present value of cash flow available for debt service over the remaining project life divided by outstanding debt
acceptedZhAnswers: 项目寿命期偿债覆盖率

examples.en: The project life coverage ratio used years that fell after the scheduled loan maturity.
examples.zh: 「项目寿命期偿债覆盖率」计入了贷款计划到期后的年份。

examples.en: The exercise calculated the project life coverage ratio using the remaining plant life.
examples.zh: 练习用工厂剩余寿命计算了「项目寿命期偿债覆盖率」。

collocations: calculate the project life coverage ratio
report the project life coverage ratio
compare the project life coverage ratio

words.enDefinition: A disagreement about which project ranks higher under different selection measures

examples.en: Our chart showed a project ranking conflict when the two measures preferred different machines.
examples.zh: 两种指标分别偏向不同机器，我们的图里就出现了「项目排序冲突」。

examples.en: The class traced the project ranking conflict to differences in the timing of receipts.
examples.zh: 全班发现，这次「项目排序冲突」源于收到现金的时间不同。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大税务收入证明摘要
words.enDefinition: A CRA summary of income and deductions from an assessed return
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大税务收入证明摘要

examples.en: The fictional scholarship office requested a proof of income statement for the earlier year.
examples.zh: 虚构的奖助学金办公室要求提供上一年度的「加拿大税务收入证明摘要」。

examples.en: Our class compared the proof of income statement with an employer's statement of wages.
examples.zh: 全班把「加拿大税务收入证明摘要」和雇主的工资报表作了对照。

collocations: request a proof of income statement
review a proof of income statement
income on a proof of income statement

words.enDefinition: Evidence that past payments were made by their due dates

examples.en: Dated receipts served as proof of on-time payments in the fictional shop owner's application.
examples.zh: 在虚构店主的申请里，注明日期的收据是「按时付款的证明」。

examples.en: I matched the proof of on-time payments to the months marked late in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我把「按时付款的证明」与练习中标为逾期的月份一一对照。

collocations: ask for proof of on-time payments

words.enDefinition: a later notice that adds to or updates a prospectus

examples.en: The prospectus supplement showed that the sample fund had appointed a new portfolio manager.
examples.zh: 「招募说明书补充文件」显示样本基金任命了新的组合经理。

examples.en: Our group compared the fee table with the prospectus supplement dated two weeks later.
examples.zh: 我们小组把费用表和晚两周发布的「招募说明书补充文件」做了比较。

words.zhGloss: 汇款服务商收取的费用
words.enDefinition: A fee charged by the remittance provider itself for carrying out the payment.
acceptedZhAnswers: 汇款服务商收取的费用

examples.en: A provider-imposed fee appeared above the charges attributed to the banks involved in the transfer.
examples.zh: 「汇款服务商收取的费用」列在参与该笔汇款的银行所收费用上方。

examples.en: The worksheet identified a provider-imposed fee before comparing it with the amount deducted after sending.
examples.zh: 练习表先标明「汇款服务商收取的费用」，再与汇出后被扣的金额作比较。

collocations: list a provider-imposed fee on a receipt

words.zhGloss: 服务商的差错处理联系方式
words.enDefinition: The provider's contact information for questions or complaints about possible transfer errors.
acceptedZhAnswers: 服务商的差错处理联系方式

examples.en: The model receipt listed the provider's error resolution contact under the paragraph about transfer problems.
examples.zh: 示范回执在汇款问题说明一段下方，列出了「服务商的差错处理联系方式」。

examples.en: We compared where the provider's error resolution contact appeared on the two sample forms.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「服务商的差错处理联系方式」在两份示例表格上的位置。

collocations: find the provider's error resolution contact
check the provider's error resolution contact
list the provider's error resolution contact

words.enDefinition: the part of a Canadian student loan funded by a province rather than the federal government

examples.en: The provincial portion appeared underneath the federal amount on the Canadian sample repayment statement.
examples.zh: 加拿大还款样本对账单把「贷款的省级部分」列在联邦金额下方。

examples.en: We checked whether the provincial portion had a separate line for interest in the example.
examples.zh: 我们查了示例有没有为「贷款的省级部分」单列利息一栏。

words.enDefinition: provincial funding such as student grants or loans provided under a Canadian province's rules

examples.en: The college adviser explained where information about provincial student aid appeared in the local admissions guide.
examples.zh: 学院顾问解释了在本地招生指南哪里可以看到「省级学生资助」的信息。

examples.en: The sample assessment showed provincial student aid in addition to the amounts listed under federal programmes.
examples.zh: 示例评估除了列出联邦计划的金额，也显示了「省级学生资助」。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大省级学费税额抵免
words.enDefinition: A tuition credit applied under an eligible Canadian province's tax rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大省级学费税额抵免

examples.en: The guide discussed a provincial tuition tax credit separately from the federal credit.
examples.zh: 指南把「加拿大省级学费税额抵免」和联邦抵免分开说明。

examples.en: We identified the provincial tuition tax credit in a mock tax worksheet for one province.
examples.zh: 我们在某省的模拟税务练习表里找到了「加拿大省级学费税额抵免」。

collocations: the provincial tuition tax credit calculation
a provincial tuition tax credit example
a provincial tuition tax credit on a return

words.enDefinition: temporary treatment as an independent student on a FAFSA record while eligibility is being reviewed

examples.en: The sample application had provisional independent status while the aid office reviewed the student's circumstances.
examples.zh: 助学办公室复核学生情况时，示例申请显示「暂定独立资助身份」。

examples.en: The student had provisional independent status pending the financial aid office's final determination.
examples.zh: 在资助办公室作出最终认定之前，该学生具有「暂定独立资助身份」。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement allowing eligible shareholders to include nominees in company proxy materials

examples.en: The proxy access provision in our case described when shareholder nominees could appear in company materials.
examples.zh: 案例中的「股东将提名人选列入公司委托投票材料的权利」条款说明，股东提名人选何时可以出现在公司材料中。

examples.en: The class compared proxy access with a separate way of proposing candidates at the meeting.
examples.zh: 我们班把「股东将提名人选列入公司委托投票材料的权利」与会议上提出候选人的另一种方式作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a form by which a registered holder appoints a proxy

examples.en: The registered shareholder used the sample proxy card to appoint someone to act at the meeting.
examples.zh: 登记股东用样本「股东投票委托卡」指定某人在会议上代为表决。

examples.en: The proxy card in the exercise listed separate choices for every director nominee.
examples.zh: 练习中的「股东投票委托卡」为每名董事候选人分别列出选项。

words.enDefinition: documents giving shareholders information and options for an upcoming vote

examples.en: The sample proxy materials included a description of the proposals and a form for voting.
examples.zh: 样本「股东委托投票材料」包括提案说明和一份投票表格。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which parts of the proxy materials explained how each proposal would be counted.
examples.zh: 导师问，「股东委托投票材料」的哪些部分解释了每个提案如何计票。

collocations: proxy materials for a shareholder meeting

words.enDefinition: a document explaining matters on which shareholders are asked to vote

examples.en: The proxy statement described the nominees and explained the sample company's voting standards.
examples.zh: 「股东委托投票说明书」介绍了候选人，并解释了样本公司的表决规则。

examples.en: We compared the proxy statement with the shorter notice announcing the company's annual meeting.
examples.zh: 我们把「股东委托投票说明书」和较短的公司年度会议通知作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A long-term public and private arrangement for infrastructure or services

examples.en: We studied a public-private partnership that financed and operated a local road.
examples.zh: 我们研究了一个为当地道路融资并负责运营的「公私合作模式」案例。

examples.en: The course compared two contract models for a public-private partnership in infrastructure.
examples.zh: 课程比较了基础设施「公私合作模式」的两种合同安排。

words.enDefinition: An item in a credit file drawn from a public source

examples.en: Our fictional report included a public record entry based on a court record.
examples.zh: 我们的虚构报告里有一条来自法院档案的「公共记录条目」。

examples.en: The class checked whether the public record entry listed the correct decision date.
examples.zh: 全班核对了「公共记录条目」上列的裁决日期是否正确。

collocations: remove an incorrect public record entry
a public record entry on the report

words.zhGloss: 美国公共服务贷款豁免
words.enDefinition: a US federal programme for cancelling remaining qualifying Direct Loan debt when its public service and payment rules are met
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国公共服务贷款豁免

examples.en: The handbook compared Public Service Loan Forgiveness with other ways a federal student loan might be cancelled.
examples.zh: 手册比较了「美国公共服务贷款豁免」和其他可取消联邦学生贷款的途径。

examples.en: Our workshop explained why documents about Public Service Loan Forgiveness referred to both employment and payments.
examples.zh: 工作坊解释了为什么「美国公共服务贷款豁免」的材料会同时提到就业和还款。

collocations: apply for Public Service Loan Forgiveness
track Public Service Loan Forgiveness progress

words.enDefinition: a charge paid to the fund on certain purchases of its shares

examples.en: The sample purchase fee went to the fund rather than to an outside distributor.
examples.zh: 样本中的「基金申购费」归基金所有，不支付给外部销售机构。

examples.en: We checked whether the purchase fee appeared in the table for both fictional share classes.
examples.zh: 我们核对「基金申购费」是否出现在两个虚构份额类别的表里。

collocations: purchase fee payable to the fund

words.enDefinition: a bond whose holder can require the issuer to buy it back at times or under conditions specified in the terms

examples.en: The student compared a puttable bond with one that only the issuer could redeem early.
examples.zh: 学生把「可回售债券」与只有发行人能提前赎回的债券作了比较。

examples.en: We found the first holder option date for the puttable bond in the example's terms.
examples.zh: 我们在示例条款中找到了这只「可回售债券」持有人首次可以要求回购的日期。

words.zhGloss: 符合免税条件的奖学金部分
words.enDefinition: the part of a scholarship that qualifies for exclusion from US taxable income under rules for eligible students and educational expenses
acceptedZhAnswers: 符合免税条件的奖学金部分

examples.en: The worksheet classified part of the award as a qualified scholarship.
examples.zh: 练习表把那笔奖助金的一部分归为「符合免税条件的奖学金部分」。

examples.en: We discussed the qualified scholarship before looking at the taxable amount in the exercise.
examples.zh: 查看练习里的应税金额前，我们先讨论了「符合免税条件的奖学金部分」。

collocations: an amount treated as a qualified scholarship

words.zhGloss: 合资格学费及相关费用
words.enDefinition: Eligible tuition and related charges recorded in US education tax reporting
acceptedZhAnswers: 合资格学费及相关费用

examples.en: The statement labelled the main tuition charge qualified tuition and related expenses in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的报表把主要学费项目标为「合资格学费及相关费用」。

examples.en: We compared qualified tuition and related expenses with a separate housing charge on the sample statement.
examples.zh: 我们把「合资格学费及相关费用」和报表样本另列的住宿费作了对照。

collocations: payments for qualified tuition and related expenses
track qualified tuition and related expenses
qualified tuition and related expenses on the statement

words.enDefinition: the number of payments or credited months that meet a programme's loan forgiveness conditions

examples.en: The borrower checked the qualifying payment count in the federal public service forgiveness record online.
examples.zh: 借款人在联邦公共服务豁免的在线记录里查了「合格还款次数」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why the qualifying payment count differed from the number of transactions shown.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么「合格还款次数」跟列出的交易笔数不一样。

words.enDefinition: A UK credit search used to check likely loan terms before applying

examples.en: The lender ran a quotation search before showing possible terms to the fictional applicant.
examples.zh: 贷款机构先做了「贷前报价查询」，再向虚构申请人展示可能提供的条款。

examples.en: The example separated the quotation search from the search made at full application.
examples.zh: 示例把「贷前报价查询」和正式申请时做的查询分开列出。

collocations: a quotation search for a personal loan

words.enDefinition: Comparing rates offered by several lenders for the same kind of borrowing

examples.en: The lesson used rate shopping to explain why three car lenders appeared together.
examples.zh: 课上用「比较多家贷款报价」解释了为什么三家车贷机构会一起出现。

examples.en: Our worksheet separated rate shopping for one car from applications for different products.
examples.zh: 练习题把同一辆车「比较多家贷款报价」和申请不同产品区分开。

collocations: distinguish rate shopping from other credit searches

words.enDefinition: a decision by a rating agency to assign a lower credit rating to an issuer or issue

examples.en: The agency announced the rating downgrade after the company published a revised forecast for the year.
examples.zh: 公司公布修改后的年度预测后，评级机构宣布对债券「下调评级」。

examples.en: We discussed the reasons for the rating downgrade using the fictional agency notice in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们通过虚构评级机构的通知讨论了「评级下调」的原因。

words.enDefinition: one step between adjacent grades on a credit rating agency's scale

examples.en: The issuer moved up by one rating notch after the agency announced the results of its review.
examples.zh: 机构公布复核结果后，发行人提高了一个「评级档位」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained what counted as a rating notch on the scale printed in the notes.
examples.zh: 导师解释了讲义所印评级刻度上，怎样算一个「评级档位」。

collocations: a change of one rating notch

words.enDefinition: a rating agency's indication of the possible direction of a rating over a stated time horizon

examples.en: The rating outlook changed in the example even though the rating itself remained the same.
examples.zh: 虽然评级本身保持原样，例子中的「评级展望」发生了变化。

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the rating outlook appeared in the agency's release about the issuer.
examples.zh: 导师问，评级机构关于发行人的公告里，「评级展望」出现在什么地方。

words.enDefinition: a table showing probabilities or observed frequencies of moving between rating categories over a period

examples.en: We used a rating transition matrix to find how often issuers stayed in the same grade.
examples.zh: 我们用「评级迁移矩阵」查看发行人维持原评级的频率。

examples.en: The rating transition matrix included a column for issuers that defaulted during the observation period.
examples.zh: 「评级迁移矩阵」有一列记录在观察期内发生违约的发行人。

words.enDefinition: a decision by a rating agency to assign a higher credit rating to an issuer or issue

examples.en: The company's rating upgrade followed a review of its ability to repay debt in the case.
examples.zh: 案例中，在审查公司的偿债能力后作出了「评级上调」。

examples.en: The sample announcement explained why the rating upgrade applied to some issues and not others.
examples.zh: 样本公告解释了为什么「评级上调」适用于部分债券，其他债券维持原评级。

words.enDefinition: a designation indicating a focused review that may result in a near-term rating action

examples.en: The agency placed the issuer on rating watch after a proposed sale appeared in the case.
examples.zh: 案例中出现拟议的出售交易后，机构把发行人列入「评级观察」。

examples.en: Our tutor used rating watch to describe a reassessment prompted by the issuer's proposed sale.
examples.zh: 导师用「评级观察」来说明，发行人提出出售计划后引发的评级重新审查。

collocations: place an issuer on rating watch
remove a rating from rating watch

words.zhGloss: 恢复已用的 HELP 可借额度
words.enDefinition: to restore part of a student's available HELP borrowing amount in circumstances permitted by Australian rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 恢复已用的 HELP 可借额度

examples.en: The training case asked whether the university could re-credit a HELP balance after reviewing the records.
examples.zh: 培训案例问，核查记录后大学能不能「恢复已用的 HELP 可借额度」。

examples.en: The adviser explained what it means to re-credit a HELP balance in a sample withdrawal case.
examples.zh: 顾问用退课案例解释了「恢复已用的 HELP 可借额度」是什么意思。

collocations: a decision to re-credit a HELP balance
request to re-credit a HELP balance
when to re-credit a HELP balance

words.enDefinition: a Student Finance England payment status indicating that no further information is needed and payment is scheduled for the date shown

examples.en: The online example changed to Ready to be paid after the university confirmed registration.
examples.zh: 大学确认注册后，在线示例的状态变成了「已安排发放」。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to distinguish Ready to be paid from a payment already received.
examples.zh: 顾问请我区分「已安排发放」和已经到账的款项。

collocations: status shows Ready to be paid
listed as Ready to be paid
change to Ready to be paid

words.zhGloss: 实际购买力口径现金流
words.enDefinition: Cash flow expressed at constant purchasing power rather than future prices
acceptedZhAnswers: 实际购买力口径现金流

examples.en: The real cash flow used the first year's prices in every forecast year.
examples.zh: 「实际购买力口径现金流」在每个预测年度都使用第一年的价格。

examples.en: Our tutor matched real cash flow with a rate that excluded expected inflation.
examples.zh: 导师把「实际购买力口径现金流」和未计入预期通胀的利率配对。

words.enDefinition: Settlement of transactions individually, for their full amounts, as they are processed rather than after netting.

examples.en: The lesson described real-time gross settlement by showing each payment settled separately in the example.
examples.zh: 课程通过展示示例中逐笔结算的付款，说明了「实时全额结算」。

examples.en: Our report compared real-time gross settlement with an arrangement that settled combined balances at intervals.
examples.zh: 我们的报告把「实时全额结算」与定期结算汇总余额的安排作了比较。

collocations: a system for real-time gross settlement

words.enDefinition: a yield adjusted for inflation or quoted in terms of purchasing power

examples.en: The chart compared real yield with a yield before adjustment for changes in the general price level.
examples.zh: 图表比较了「实际收益率」与未经总体物价变化调整的收益率。

examples.en: The tutor explained how an inflation-linked security could be quoted using a real yield figure.
examples.zh: 导师解释了通胀挂钩证券怎样用「实际收益率」报价。

words.enDefinition: A suitable fact-checking process for resolving disputed US credit information

examples.en: The article described a reasonable investigation that considered the account statement and other records.
examples.zh: 文章描述了一次「合理调查」，查阅了账户账单和其他记录。

examples.en: In our exercise, the adviser discussed what a reasonable investigation might involve.
examples.zh: 在练习中，顾问谈到了「合理调查」可能包含哪些工作。

words.enDefinition: a specified deviation that triggers an adjustment toward target weights

examples.en: The course example set a rebalancing threshold based on each asset group's deviation from its target.
examples.zh: 课程示例按照各类资产偏离自身目标的程度设定「再平衡触发阈值」。

examples.en: Our lecturer asked which holding had crossed the rebalancing threshold in the sample worksheet.
examples.zh: 讲师问，样本练习表中哪项持仓已超过「再平衡触发阈值」。

words.enDefinition: A fee a receiving bank or other institution applies to money processed for its customer.

examples.en: The accounts team's note identified a recipient institution fee deducted before the final deposit appeared.
examples.zh: 财务团队的说明注明，最终入账前扣除了一笔「收款机构手续费」。

examples.en: The summary showed a recipient institution fee separately from an earlier deduction by another bank.
examples.zh: 汇总表将「收款机构手续费」与另一家银行先前扣除的费用分开列出。

collocations: ask about a recipient institution fee

words.enDefinition: A discrepancy or unmatched item that needs attention before payment and account records can be reconciled.

examples.en: The missing invoice reference appeared as a reconciliation exception in the university's practice accounts report.
examples.zh: 在大学财务报告练习中，缺少账单参考号被列为一项「对账异常」。

examples.en: We discussed a reconciliation exception involving two recorded amounts in different currencies for one payment.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了一项「对账异常」，同一笔付款记了两种币种的金额。

words.zhGloss: 美国申报与账户合并摘录
words.enDefinition: An IRS transcript combining original return items with tax account activity
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国申报与账户合并摘录

examples.en: The record of account transcript showed both the initial filing and the later adjustment.
examples.zh: 「美国申报与账户合并摘录」同时显示原始申报和后续调整。

examples.en: Our tutor contrasted a record of account transcript with the worksheet showing only initial figures.
examples.zh: 导师对照了「美国申报与账户合并摘录」和一张只列初始数据的练习表。

collocations: request a record of account transcript
view a record of account transcript
data in a record of account transcript

words.enDefinition: the proportion of a defaulted exposure that creditors recover, sometimes measured net of costs or discounted

examples.en: The analyst compared the recovery rate for two defaulted claims after estimating the costs of collection.
examples.zh: 分析人员估算回收成本后，比较了两笔违约债权的「违约债权回收率」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how the assumed recovery rate affected the estimated loss on the bond.
examples.zh: 导师演示了假定的「违约债权回收率」会怎样影响债券损失估计值。

words.enDefinition: preferred shares that may be redeemed under stated conditions

examples.en: The prospectus described redeemable preferred stock with a redemption price stated in the terms.
examples.zh: 招募说明书介绍了条款中列明赎回价格的「可赎回优先股」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which event could trigger redemption of the redeemable preferred stock in the case.
examples.zh: 导师问，案例中哪个事件可能触发「可赎回优先股」的赎回。

words.enDefinition: repayment or redemption of a bond at its face value

examples.en: The terms allowed redemption at par after the first three years of the fictional issue.
examples.zh: 虚构发行的条款规定，最初三年过后可以「按面值赎回」。

examples.en: We compared redemption at par with a separate case in which the issuer paid a premium.
examples.zh: 我们把「按面值赎回」和发行人支付溢价的另一个例子作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the assets or cash delivered when ETF shares are redeemed

examples.en: The sample report described the securities included in the redemption basket for that afternoon.
examples.zh: 样本报告介绍了当天下午「ETF赎回组合」中包含的证券。

examples.en: The class compared the redemption basket with the creation basket shown in the exercise.
examples.zh: 同学们把「ETF赎回组合」与练习中列出的申购组合做了比较。

words.enDefinition: a fee paid to the fund when shares are redeemed under specified conditions

examples.en: The sample fund's redemption fee applied to shares redeemed within a specified holding period.
examples.zh: 样本基金的「赎回费」适用于在指定持有期内赎回的份额。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the redemption fee appeared separately from the sales load in the prospectus.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么招募说明书把「赎回费」和销售费分开列示。

words.enDefinition: an amount paid above face value when a bond is redeemed under its terms

examples.en: The redemption premium made the total repayment higher than the face amount in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「赎回溢价」使偿付总额高于面值。

examples.en: We located the redemption premium in the table before checking which call date it covered.
examples.zh: 我们先在表里找到「赎回溢价」，再核对它适用于哪个可赎回日期。

examples.en: We identified the example email that asked the company to revoke a proxy already submitted.
examples.zh: 我们找到了那封要求公司「撤销先前提交的表决委托」的示例邮件。

collocations: revoke a proxy before the meeting
a right to revoke a proxy

words.enDefinition: An applicable UK right to withdraw from certain signed credit agreements

examples.en: The handout had a separate paragraph about the right of withdrawal in its credit example.
examples.zh: 讲义的信贷示例有一段专门说明「退出信贷协议的权利」。

examples.en: We found the right of withdrawal near the end of the fictional lender's disclosure.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构贷款机构的披露材料末尾附近找到了「退出信贷协议的权利」。

collocations: terms covering the right of withdrawal

words.enDefinition: a sales-charge discount mechanism counting eligible existing holdings toward a breakpoint

examples.en: The example's rights of accumulation counted eligible existing holdings when determining the purchase's sales charge.
examples.zh: 示例中的「累积投资折扣权」把符合条件的现有持仓计入计算申购销售费的基数。

examples.en: Our class compared rights of accumulation with a commitment to make purchases over a future period.
examples.zh: 我们班把「累积投资折扣权」与承诺在未来一段时间内申购的做法作了比较。

words.enDefinition: an offer giving eligible existing shareholders rights to buy additional shares

examples.en: The sample company's rights offering gave eligible existing shareholders an opportunity to buy new shares.
examples.zh: 样本公司通过「向现有股东配股」让符合条件的现有股东有机会购买新股。

examples.en: We read the timetable for the rights offering before interpreting the sample shareholder notice.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「向现有股东配股」的时间表，再解读样本股东通知。

words.zhGloss: 升至投资级的原非投资级债券
words.enDefinition: a bond or issuer upgraded from below investment grade to investment grade
acceptedZhAnswers: 升至投资级的原非投资级债券

examples.en: The worksheet called the bond a rising star after the agency raised it to investment grade.
examples.zh: 评级机构把债券升至投资级后，练习表称它为「升至投资级的原非投资级债券」。

examples.en: We compared the rising star with an issuer that had stayed within the same rating category.
examples.zh: 我们把这只「升至投资级的原非投资级债券」与评级类别没变的发行人作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A discount rate that reflects the risk of particular cash flows

examples.en: The riskier proposal had a higher risk-adjusted discount rate in the lecture example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，风险较高的方案用了更高的「风险调整折现率」。

examples.en: We checked which projected cash flows the risk-adjusted discount rate was meant to value.
examples.zh: 我们查看了「风险调整折现率」要用于估算哪些预测现金流的价值。

words.enDefinition: A table showing which parties bear specific risks under a project

examples.en: The risk allocation matrix assigned construction risks and demand risks to different parties.
examples.zh: 「风险分担矩阵」把建设风险和需求风险分给不同当事方。

examples.en: I checked the risk allocation matrix before modelling losses in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我在练习中估算损失前，先核对了「风险分担矩阵」。

words.enDefinition: Setting borrowing terms based on the lender's assessment of repayment risk

examples.en: The class compared offers to illustrate risk-based pricing without using real applicant data.
examples.zh: 全班对比了几份报价来说明「按风险定价」，数据来自虚构申请人。

examples.en: Our sample used risk-based pricing to explain why two rates were different.
examples.zh: 示例用「按风险定价」说明了为什么两个报价的利率不同。

words.enDefinition: A US disclosure about less favourable terms linked to report information

examples.en: The mock lender's risk-based pricing notice mentioned the credit report used in its decision.
examples.zh: 模拟案例中，贷款机构的「风险定价告知书」提到了作决定所用的信用报告。

examples.en: The example risk-based pricing notice appeared beside the letter setting out the approved terms.
examples.zh: 示例「风险定价告知书」与列明获批条款的信放在一起。

words.enDefinition: a return over a fixed-length window that moves through time

examples.en: We calculated a rolling return for each twelve-month window in the sample performance data.
examples.zh: 我们按样本业绩数据中的每一个十二个月窗口计算「滚动回报率」。

examples.en: The chart's rolling return series showed how results varied depending on when the period began.
examples.zh: 图里的「滚动回报率」序列表明，起始时间不同，结果也会变化。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大注册退休储蓄缴款单
words.enDefinition: A receipt showing a contribution to a Canadian registered retirement savings plan
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大注册退休储蓄缴款单

examples.en: Our class found the reporting period on the sample RRSP contribution receipt from a bank.
examples.zh: 全班在银行的「加拿大注册退休储蓄缴款单」样本上找到了申报期间。

examples.en: The workshop grouped the RRSP contribution receipt with the fictional taxpayer's other tax documents.
examples.zh: 工作坊把「加拿大注册退休储蓄缴款单」与虚构纳税人的其他税务文件归在一起。

collocations: dates on an RRSP contribution receipt

words.enDefinition: an Australian government loan for eligible students to cover the student services and amenities fee

examples.en: The fees guide explained SA-HELP on a page separate from loans for tuition fees.
examples.zh: 收费指南用单独一页解释「澳洲学生服务费贷款」，与学费贷款分开。

examples.en: Our adviser showed an example of SA-HELP covering the service charge rather than course tuition.
examples.zh: 顾问展示了用「澳洲学生服务费贷款」支付服务费的例子，课程学费是另一项。

words.zhGloss: 英国个人自行申报主表
words.enDefinition: The main UK individual Self Assessment tax return form
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国个人自行申报主表

examples.en: The workshop labelled SA100 as the main return in its example pack.
examples.zh: 工作坊在示例资料包里把「英国个人自行申报主表」标为主申报表。

examples.en: I compared the sections of SA100 with the list of supplementary pages.
examples.zh: 我把「英国个人自行申报主表」的各栏与补充页清单作了对照。

words.zhGloss: 英国自行申报受雇收入附页
words.enDefinition: UK Self Assessment supplementary pages for employment income and related details
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国自行申报受雇收入附页

examples.en: The class found employment earnings on SA102 in the sample return.
examples.zh: 全班在申报表样本的「英国自行申报受雇收入附页」上找到了受雇收入。

examples.en: We matched SA102 with the fictional student's annual pay record.
examples.zh: 我们把「英国自行申报受雇收入附页」和虚构学生的年度薪资记录对上了。

words.zhGloss: 英国自行申报境外收入附页
words.enDefinition: UK Self Assessment supplementary pages for foreign income and gains
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国自行申报境外收入附页

examples.en: The sample of SA106 included a section for interest from abroad.
examples.zh: 「英国自行申报境外收入附页」的样本里有一栏填境外利息。

examples.en: Our course placed SA106 with the forms concerning income from different countries.
examples.zh: 课程把「英国自行申报境外收入附页」与涉及不同国家收入的表格归在一起。

words.zhGloss: 英国自行申报居留情况附页
words.enDefinition: UK Self Assessment supplementary pages for residence information and related details
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国自行申报居留情况附页

examples.en: The worksheet used SA109 to introduce residence sections of a UK return.
examples.zh: 练习表通过「英国自行申报居留情况附页」介绍英国申报表中的居留信息栏。

examples.en: Our tutor showed the heading on SA109 beside a mock travel record.
examples.zh: 导师把一份模拟出行记录放在「英国自行申报居留情况附页」旁，给我们看它的标题。

words.zhGloss: 英国自行申报税额计算单
words.enDefinition: An HMRC calculation showing taxable income and tax for Self Assessment
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国自行申报税额计算单

examples.en: The sample SA302 broke down the tax calculated from the return.
examples.zh: 「英国自行申报税额计算单」样本详细列出根据申报表算出的税额。

examples.en: We checked the amounts on the SA302 against the employer's example statement.
examples.zh: 我们用雇主报表样本核对了「英国自行申报税额计算单」上的金额。

words.zhGloss: 以同一币种完成的付款
words.enDefinition: A payment in which the amount is sent and received in the same currency.
acceptedZhAnswers: 以同一币种完成的付款

examples.en: The sample showed a same-currency payment even though the payer and recipient were in different countries.
examples.zh: 尽管付款方和收款方在不同国家，示例显示的是一笔「以同一币种完成的付款」。

examples.en: The trainer paired a same-currency payment with another example that included an actual conversion step.
examples.zh: 培训员把「以同一币种完成的付款」与另一个实际发生币种兑换的例子放在一起。

words.enDefinition: a government savings security that is generally intended for individuals and may be nonmarketable

examples.en: The Treasury guide distinguished a savings bond from the securities sold at regular Treasury auctions.
examples.zh: 财政部指南把「储蓄国债」与通过常规国债拍卖出售的证券区分开。

examples.en: The class discussed why the example savings bond could not be sold to another investor.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论了为什么例中的「储蓄国债」不能在市场上卖给另一位投资者。

words.enDefinition: a shareholder vote expressing a view on executive compensation

examples.en: The sample US proxy statement listed a say-on-pay vote about the company's executive compensation.
examples.zh: 美国样本股东委托投票说明书列出了一项关于该公司高管报酬的「高管薪酬表决」。

examples.en: We looked for the compensation discussion before reading the results of the sample say-on-pay vote.
examples.zh: 阅读样本「高管薪酬表决」结果前，我们先找到有关薪酬的说明。

words.enDefinition: A ranking difference caused by the sizes of the investments compared

examples.en: The scale effect explained why the smaller project ranked higher by return but lower by value.
examples.zh: 「投资规模效应」解释了为什么较小的项目按收益率排得靠前，按价值排得靠后。

examples.en: Our tutor used the initial spending figures to illustrate the scale effect.
examples.zh: 导师用初始支出数据说明了「投资规模效应」。

collocations: a scale effect in project appraisal

words.zhGloss: 加拿大学费抵免计算附表
words.enDefinition: A Canadian federal schedule calculating tuition tax credit amounts and adjustments
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大学费抵免计算附表

examples.en: The sample Schedule 11 showed an amount available to carry to another year.
examples.zh: 「加拿大学费抵免计算附表」样本列出了一笔可以结转到其他年度的金额。

examples.en: We put Schedule 11 beside the tuition certificate from the fictional school.
examples.zh: 我们把「加拿大学费抵免计算附表」放在虚构学校的学费证明旁。

words.zhGloss: 美国个体经营损益附表
words.enDefinition: A US individual tax schedule reporting profit or loss from self-employment
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国个体经营损益附表

examples.en: The example Schedule C listed income from a student-run translation business.
examples.zh: 「美国个体经营损益附表」样本列出了一项学生经营的翻译业务收入。

examples.en: The worksheet used Schedule C to show a fictional tutor's business expenses.
examples.zh: 练习表用「美国个体经营损益附表」展示了一位虚构家教的经营支出。

collocations: the income section of Schedule C

words.enDefinition: a detailed list of investments held on a stated date

examples.en: The schedule of investments listed each security held by the sample fund at year end.
examples.zh: 「投资明细表」列出了样本基金年末持有的每项证券。

examples.en: We checked the schedule of investments after finding a shortened holdings list in the classroom summary.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂摘要里看到简略持仓清单后，又查了「投资明细表」。

collocations: positions listed in the schedule of investments

words.enDefinition: A US individual tax schedule used to determine self-employment tax

examples.en: The second handout used Schedule SE to explain the separate tax calculation.
examples.zh: 第二份讲义用「美国自雇税计算附表」解释了这项单列的税款计算。

examples.en: We put Schedule SE behind the mock page showing the freelancer's business profit.
examples.zh: 我们把「美国自雇税计算附表」放在显示自由职业者营业利润的模拟页面后。

words.zhGloss: 外部奖学金挤减原资助
words.enDefinition: a reduction in previously offered aid after a student receives an additional scholarship
acceptedZhAnswers: 外部奖学金挤减原资助

examples.en: The student newspaper interviewed the aid director about scholarship displacement after several students received outside awards.
examples.zh: 几名学生获得外部资助后，校报就「外部奖学金挤减原资助」采访了助学部门负责人。

examples.en: Our example showed scholarship displacement when a separate scholarship reduced another part of the aid package.
examples.zh: 我们的例子展示了单独获得的奖学金使资助组合中另一部分减少时，什么叫「外部奖学金挤减原资助」。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大奖助金免税待遇
words.enDefinition: A Canadian tax exclusion for certain scholarship and similar amounts
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大奖助金免税待遇

examples.en: The reading discussed the scholarship exemption before showing the example award amount.
examples.zh: 阅读材料先说明「加拿大奖助金免税待遇」，然后再列示例金额。

examples.en: Our workshop used two fictional awards to introduce the scholarship exemption.
examples.zh: 工作坊用了两笔虚构奖助金来介绍「加拿大奖助金免税待遇」。

words.enDefinition: An aspect of a person's information that affects a credit score

examples.en: The score factor in the sample report related to how recently borrowing began.
examples.zh: 报告样本中的这个「评分影响因素」涉及借款是多久前开始的。

examples.en: We chose one score factor from the mock report to explain in class.
examples.zh: 我们从模拟报告里挑了一个「评分影响因素」，准备在课堂上讲解。

words.enDefinition: an additional comparison standard alongside a primary benchmark

examples.en: The report showed a sector index as a secondary benchmark beside the broad market index.
examples.zh: 报告把一个行业指数列为「次要业绩基准」，与宽基市场指数并列。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the fictional fund included a secondary benchmark for its smaller holdings.
examples.zh: 导师问，虚构基金为什么为其规模较小的持仓列入一个「次要业绩基准」。

words.enDefinition: the distribution of a portfolio's assets across industries

examples.en: The report's sector allocation chart showed that the sample fund held investments across several industries.
examples.zh: 报告的「行业配置」图表显示，样本基金在若干行业持有投资。

examples.en: We compared the reported sector allocation with the weights of the fund's benchmark in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们将报告的「行业配置」与练习表所列的基金基准权重作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the effect on relative performance of weighting sectors differently from a benchmark

examples.en: The worksheet showed a positive sector allocation effect after the sample fund overweighted a strong sector.
examples.zh: 样本基金超配了表现强劲的行业后，练习表显示「行业配置效应」为正。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what the sector allocation effect said about the portfolio's sector weights.
examples.zh: 导师问，从「行业配置效应」能看出投资组合行业权重安排的哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: a bond backed by specified assets that can support the holders' claims if the issuer defaults

examples.en: The term sheet described a secured bond backed by equipment owned by the fictional issuer.
examples.zh: 条款概要介绍了一只「有担保物的债券」，担保物是虚构发行人所有的设备。

examples.en: Our lecturer asked which assets supported the secured bond in the second example on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 讲师问，练习表第二例里的「有担保物的债券」由哪些资产提供担保。

words.enDefinition: A legal right in property used to secure an obligation

examples.en: We read where the lender's security interest in the car was described.
examples.zh: 我们读了说明贷款机构在汽车上享有何种「担保权益」的那部分。

examples.en: The mock agreement identified the property covered by the security interest.
examples.zh: 模拟协议标明了「担保权益」涉及的财产。

collocations: a security interest in a vehicle

words.enDefinition: the overall set of collateral, security interests and related documents supporting a financing arrangement

examples.en: The sample security package included a pledge over equipment and an assignment of specified receivables.
examples.zh: 示例「债务担保组合」包含以设备设定担保和转让指定应收款。

examples.en: Our group compared the security package with the general promise to pay in a separate note.
examples.zh: 我们小组把「债务担保组合」与另一只票据中的一般付款承诺作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the effect of security choices within a group on relative performance

examples.en: The security selection effect was negative when the chosen companies lagged behind their industry comparison.
examples.zh: 所选公司表现落后于行业参照时，「证券选择效应」为负。

examples.en: Our tutor used the security selection effect to discuss what happened within the sample's largest sector.
examples.zh: 导师用「证券选择效应」讨论样本中占比最大的行业内部发生了什么。

words.enDefinition: an existing owner selling shares in an offering

examples.en: The prospectus named one selling shareholder and separately listed the shares offered by the company.
examples.zh: 招募说明书列出了一名「出售股份的股东」，并另列公司发售的股份。

examples.en: Our exercise followed which part of the offering proceeds went to the selling shareholder.
examples.zh: 练习让我们追踪本次发行所得的哪一部分归「出售股份的股东」。

collocations: proceeds received by a selling shareholder
shares offered by a selling shareholder

words.enDefinition: a report to fund investors covering half a financial year

examples.en: The semiannual shareholder report covered six months of expenses for the sample US fund.
examples.zh: 「半年度持有人报告」涵盖了这只美国样本基金六个月的费用。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which dates were covered by the semiannual shareholder report in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师让我们找出练习中的「半年度持有人报告」涵盖了哪些日期。

collocations: figures from the semiannual shareholder report

words.enDefinition: A loan arrangement repaid ahead of debt with lower priority

examples.en: The senior facility appeared above other debt in the example financing summary.
examples.zh: 示例融资摘要把「优先级融资额度」列在其他债务上方。

examples.en: I checked the schedule for the first repayment under the senior facility.
examples.zh: 我查了进度表，确定「优先级融资额度」项下第一笔还款在哪。

collocations: repay amounts under a senior facility

words.enDefinition: a bond that ranks as senior debt and is backed by assets pledged as collateral

examples.en: The sample issuer listed the assets securing its senior secured bond in a separate appendix.
examples.zh: 示例发行人在单独的附录里列出了为「优先有担保物债券」提供担保的资产。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why the senior secured bond had priority over the subordinated note in the example.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么例子中的「优先有担保物债券」优先于次级票据受偿。

collocations: holders of a senior secured bond

words.enDefinition: a bond ranking as senior debt without a claim on specific pledged assets

examples.en: The example senior unsecured bond ranked above the subordinated debt in the same company's structure.
examples.zh: 同一家公司的示例结构里，「优先无担保物债券」的受偿顺位高于次级债务。

examples.en: The lecturer noted that the senior unsecured bond was not secured by a particular building.
examples.zh: 讲师指出，这只「优先无担保物债券」没有以某栋特定建筑作为担保。

collocations: rank of a senior unsecured bond

words.enDefinition: the rank of a debt claim relative to other claims for purposes of payment priority

examples.en: The case asked us to compare seniority across three bonds issued by the same company.
examples.zh: 案例让我们比较同一家公司发行的三只债券各自的「清偿优先顺位」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how the prospectus described the seniority of each note in the offering.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了募集文件如何描述各只票据的「清偿优先顺位」。

words.enDefinition: A payment made through a chain in which the payment instruction and settlement proceed along the same route.

examples.en: The serial payment example followed the instruction and settlement through the same series of institutions.
examples.zh: 「逐级传递的付款」示例沿同一系列机构追踪了指令与结算。

examples.en: The tutor drew a serial payment on the board before explaining the separate cover arrangement.
examples.zh: 老师先在板上画了「逐级传递的付款」，再解释另行调拨结算资金的安排。

collocations: compare a serial payment with a cover payment

words.enDefinition: An organisation that manages or carries out settlement on behalf of participants in a payment arrangement.

examples.en: The report named the settlement agent that handled the final balances for the participating institutions.
examples.zh: 报告写明了负责处理参与机构最终余额的「结算代理机构」。

examples.en: We checked which role belonged to the settlement agent in the diagram of the payment system.
examples.zh: 我们在支付系统图里核对了哪个角色是「结算代理机构」。

collocations: a record from the settlement agent

words.enDefinition: The currency in which the parties or institutions settle the obligation at the specified stage.

examples.en: The example separated the settlement currency from the currency shown on the original course invoice.
examples.zh: 例子把「结算币种」与原始课程账单上的币种分开列示。

examples.en: We read the settlement currency next to the amount exchanged between the two financial institutions.
examples.zh: 我们在两家金融机构之间结算的金额旁看到了「结算币种」。

words.enDefinition: the interval between executing a trade and completing its settlement

examples.en: The classroom example used a settlement cycle of one business day after trade execution.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的「证券结算周期」是从成交到结算间隔一个工作日。
