examples.en: Our tutor drew a timeline to show where the settlement cycle began and ended.
examples.zh: 导师画了一条时间线，说明「证券结算周期」从哪里开始到哪里结束。

words.enDefinition: A failure of one or more parties or systems to complete an agreed settlement.

examples.en: The model described a settlement failure when one of the two currencies did not arrive.
examples.zh: 模型描述了一次「未能完成结算」的情况，两种币种中有一种的款项没到。

examples.en: We checked which obligation remained outstanding after the exercise reported a settlement failure on Friday.
examples.zh: 练习报告周五「未能完成结算」之后，我们核对了哪项付款义务仍未履行。

collocations: a report of a settlement failure

words.enDefinition: the stage at which settlement becomes irrevocable and unconditional under the applicable system rules

examples.en: The reading described settlement finality as a concept defined by the rules of the payment system.
examples.zh: 阅读材料把「结算最终性」描述为由支付系统规则所界定的概念。

examples.en: We discussed settlement finality after comparing three messages received at different points in the example.
examples.zh: 比对了示例中在不同时点收到的三条报文后，我们讨论了「结算最终性」。

collocations: identify the point of settlement finality

words.enDefinition: The funds and other readily usable resources available to meet settlement obligations as they fall due.

examples.en: The central bank's example showed why settlement liquidity matters when several payments fall due together.
examples.zh: 央行的例子说明，多笔付款同时到期时为什么需要「结算所需的流动资金」。

examples.en: We discussed settlement liquidity separately from the total value of payments waiting in the queue.
examples.zh: 我们把「结算所需的流动资金」与队列中待处理的付款总额分开讨论。

words.enDefinition: A field indicating the method the financial institutions use to settle the payment.

examples.en: The worksheet displayed the settlement method field next to the list of institutions in the example.
examples.zh: 练习表在示例的机构名单旁放了「结算方式字段」。

examples.en: We checked the settlement method field before comparing the documents used at each payment step.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「结算方式字段」，再对比各付款环节使用的文件。

collocations: compare the settlement method field across records

words.zhGloss: 加拿大重度永久残障贷款减免
words.enDefinition: a Canadian benefit that can cancel eligible student debt when severe permanent disability criteria are met
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大重度永久残障贷款减免

examples.en: The adviser mentioned the Severe Permanent Disability Benefit while showing where to find the Canadian guidance.
examples.zh: 顾问指出去哪里找加拿大官方说明时，提到了「加拿大重度永久残障贷款减免」。

examples.en: The workbook described the Severe Permanent Disability Benefit in a different section from repayment assistance.
examples.zh: 练习册把「加拿大重度永久残障贷款减免」放在与还款援助不同的章节。

collocations: apply for the Severe Permanent Disability Benefit
information about the Severe Permanent Disability Benefit

words.enDefinition: a group of shares in a fund with specific terms

examples.en: Each share class in the example held the same investments but charged different ongoing fees.
examples.zh: 示例中的每个「基金份额类别」都持有相同的底层投资，但持续费用不同。

examples.en: We checked which share class the performance table referred to before copying its figures.
examples.zh: 记录数据前，我们先核对业绩表说的是哪个「基金份额类别」。

words.enDefinition: moving a holding from one class to another within the same fund

examples.en: The prospectus supplement explained when a share class conversion would take place in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 课堂案例的招募说明书补充文件解释了何时会进行「份额类别转换」。

examples.en: We asked how the share class conversion changed the names shown on the sample statement.
examples.zh: 我们问，「份额类别转换」后样本对账单上显示的名称会怎样改变。

collocations: terms for a share class conversion

words.enDefinition: the currency in which a class's values are quoted

examples.en: The report used the share class currency to show the price of one unit.
examples.zh: 报告使用「份额类别计价货币」表示一份基金单位的价格。

examples.en: We checked the share class currency before comparing two columns of unit prices in the factsheet.
examples.zh: 比较概况表中两栏单位价格前，我们核对了「份额类别计价货币」。

collocations: quote prices in the share class currency
a change in the share class currency

words.enDefinition: the date a specific class of a fund began operating

examples.en: We checked the share class inception date after seeing that the chart began much later.
examples.zh: 看到图表起始时间晚得多后，我们核对了「份额类别设立日期」。

examples.en: The share class inception date showed why that class lacked a ten-year record in the table.
examples.zh: 「份额类别设立日期」解释了为什么该类别在表中没有十年业绩记录。

collocations: check the share class inception date
report a share class inception date
return since the share class inception date

words.enDefinition: the number of new shares received for each original share

examples.en: The share exchange ratio in the case gave one new share for every four held.
examples.zh: 案例中的「换股比例」是每持有四股旧股换一股新股。

examples.en: We checked the share exchange ratio before filling in the new holding on the sample statement.
examples.zh: 我们先核对了「换股比例」，再填写样本对账单中的新持仓。

collocations: agree on a share exchange ratio
shares due under the share exchange ratio

words.enDefinition: a fee directly charged for maintaining a fund shareholder's account

examples.en: The sample's shareholder account fee depended on the account balance under the stated fee schedule.
examples.zh: 根据列出的收费规则，样本中的「基金账户费用」取决于账户余额。

examples.en: We found the shareholder account fee in the column for amounts charged directly to holders.
examples.zh: 我们在持有人直接支付金额的那一栏找到了「基金账户费用」。

words.enDefinition: formal agreement by shareholders under the applicable voting rules

examples.en: The fictional merger proposal required shareholder approval before the companies could proceed in the case.
examples.zh: 在案例中，这项虚构合并提案要取得「股东批准」，两家公司才能继续推进。

examples.en: Our report explained how many votes the sample needed to obtain shareholder approval.
examples.zh: 报告解释了样本中要获得「股东批准」需要多少票。

words.zhGloss: 持有人直接承担的费用
words.enDefinition: fees charged directly to investors in a fund
acceptedZhAnswers: 持有人直接承担的费用

examples.en: The sample prospectus listed shareholder fees for certain transactions in a separate part of the table.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书在表格的另一区域列出了特定交易产生的「持有人直接承担的费用」。

examples.en: Our exercise separated shareholder fees from the charges that came out of the fund's own assets.
examples.zh: 我们的练习把「持有人直接承担的费用」与从基金资产中扣除的费用分开列出。

collocations: shareholder fees paid directly by investors

words.zhGloss: 股东借给项目公司的贷款
words.enDefinition: A loan made by a shareholder to the company it owns
acceptedZhAnswers: 股东借给项目公司的贷款

examples.en: The worksheet put a shareholder loan below the bank facility in the funding table.
examples.zh: 练习表在资金表的银行授信下方列了一笔「股东借给项目公司的贷款」。

examples.en: Our class compared a shareholder loan with an ordinary share contribution from the sponsor.
examples.zh: 全班把「股东借给项目公司的贷款」和发起人的普通股出资作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the shareholder whose name appears in the issuer's records

examples.en: The sample showed the nominee as the shareholder of record for the shares it held.
examples.zh: 样本显示，代名人是其代持股份对应的「登记在册的股东」。

examples.en: A shareholder of record received the proxy card directly from the company in our example.
examples.zh: 在我们的示例中，「登记在册的股东」直接收到公司寄来的投票委托卡。

collocations: a shareholder of record on that date

words.enDefinition: a proposal submitted by a shareholder for consideration at a meeting

examples.en: The proxy documents included a shareholder proposal asking the company to publish a new report.
examples.zh: 股东委托投票文件包含一项「股东提案」，要求公司发布一份新报告。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to find the shareholder proposal that had come from outside management.
examples.zh: 导师让我们找出并非由管理层提出的那项「股东提案」。

words.enDefinition: excess return over a risk-free rate divided by return volatility

examples.en: The exercise calculated the Sharpe ratio using the same risk-free rate for both hypothetical portfolios.
examples.zh: 练习用同一个无风险利率计算两只假设投资组合的「夏普比率」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why a higher return did not necessarily produce a higher Sharpe ratio.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么较高的回报率未必会带来较高的「夏普比率」。

words.enDefinition: a US registration allowing eligible securities to be offered later under applicable conditions

examples.en: The sample company's shelf registration covered securities that it might offer at a later date.
examples.zh: 样本公司的「储架发行登记」涵盖将来可能发售的证券。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the shelf registration alone showed that any shares had already been sold.
examples.zh: 导师问，仅凭「储架发行登记」能否看出已经出售了股份。

collocations: securities covered by a shelf registration

words.enDefinition: Australian interest on extra tax arising from an amended assessment

examples.en: The revised assessment showed a shortfall interest charge beside the additional tax.
examples.zh: 修订后的税额核定通知在补缴税额旁列出了「澳洲补税差额利息」。

examples.en: Our sample worksheet separated the shortfall interest charge from the corrected income tax.
examples.zh: 练习表样本把「澳洲补税差额利息」与更正后的所得税分开列出。

collocations: a shortfall interest charge on an amended assessment

words.enDefinition: Major connections that bear on a person's Canadian tax residence

examples.en: Our example listed potential significant residential ties in a chart beside the person's itinerary.
examples.zh: 示例在个人行程旁边用表格列出了可能的「重要居住联系」。

examples.en: The workshop introduced significant residential ties using a fictional move between two countries.
examples.zh: 工作坊用在两个国家之间搬迁的虚构情境介绍了「重要居住联系」。

words.enDefinition: An HMRC process for calculating some individual tax bills directly

examples.en: The guide introduced Simple Assessment before showing a sample HMRC calculation letter.
examples.zh: 指南先介绍了「英国简易税额核定」，再展示英国税务机关的税额计算信样本。

examples.en: We matched Simple Assessment with one of the notices in the training pack.
examples.zh: 我们把「英国简易税额核定」和培训资料包里的一份通知对上了。

words.enDefinition: performance measured from the start of a fund or class

examples.en: The since-inception return in our example covered only the newer share class's first two years.
examples.zh: 我们示例中的「自设立以来回报率」仅涵盖较新的份额类别开始运作后的前两年。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the fund's since-inception return was reported as annualised or cumulative.
examples.zh: 导师问，基金的「自设立以来回报率」用的是年化口径还是累计口径。

words.zhGloss: 澳洲即时薪税报送系统
words.enDefinition: Australia's system for sending payroll information to the tax office
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲即时薪税报送系统

examples.en: The workshop connected Single Touch Payroll with the way employers report wages in Australia.
examples.zh: 工作坊介绍了「澳洲即时薪税报送系统」与澳大利亚雇主报送工资信息的关系。

examples.en: Nina saw Single Touch Payroll mentioned in her campus employer's onboarding guide.
examples.zh: 妮娜看到校内雇主的入职指南提到「澳洲即时薪税报送系统」。

collocations: information reported through Single Touch Payroll

words.enDefinition: redemption of some bonds on a schedule using funds set aside as required by the bond terms

examples.en: The example used sinking fund redemption to repay part of the issue before final maturity.
examples.zh: 示例用「偿债基金分期赎回」在最终到期前偿还了发行债券的一部分。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed a sinking fund redemption amount in two of the years before maturity.
examples.zh: 练习表在到期前的两个年份列出了「偿债基金分期赎回」的金额。

words.enDefinition: Cost of returning land or a site to a required condition

examples.en: The site restoration cost was separate from the amount budgeted for dismantling equipment.
examples.zh: 「场地恢复成本」和用于拆除设备的预算金额是分开列的。

examples.en: The example placed the site restoration cost in the final year of the model.
examples.zh: 范例把「场地恢复成本」放在模型的最后一年。

words.enDefinition: a period following the end of studies when regular payments are not yet due on a Canadian government student loan

examples.en: The example timeline showed a six-month non-repayment period between the end of study and regular repayment.
examples.zh: 示例时间线上，就读结束和开始定期还款之间有一个「六个月无须还款期」。

examples.en: The adviser explained where the six-month non-repayment period appeared in the borrower's account summary.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了「六个月无须还款期」会显示在借款人账户摘要的什么位置。

collocations: end of the six-month non-repayment period

words.enDefinition: An investment spending limit set internally by the organisation

examples.en: The board's voluntary spending cap illustrated soft capital rationing in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 董事会自设的支出上限说明了课堂案例中的「内部资本限额」。

examples.en: The model treated the budget ceiling as soft capital rationing because management could revise it.
examples.zh: 管理层可以修改预算上限，所以模型把它归类为「内部资本限额」。

collocations: an example of soft capital rationing
distinguish soft capital rationing from external constraints

words.enDefinition: A financing table showing where capital comes from and goes

examples.en: Our sources and uses table listed each funding source beside the proposed project costs.
examples.zh: 我们的「资金来源与用途表」把各项资金来源与拟议项目成本并列。

examples.en: The class used the sources and uses table to check that construction costs were covered.
examples.zh: 全班用「资金来源与用途表」核对施工成本是否都有资金覆盖。

collocations: prepare a sources and uses table
balance a sources and uses table
review a sources and uses table

words.zhGloss: 助学评估的特殊财务情况
words.enDefinition: in US federal student aid, financial circumstances that may warrant reviewing aid calculation data or costs
acceptedZhAnswers: 助学评估的特殊财务情况

examples.en: The adviser discussed special circumstances such as a substantial change in family income during the year.
examples.zh: 顾问讨论了「助学评估的特殊财务情况」，例如家庭收入在年内发生较大变化。

examples.en: The aid office's notice listed examples of special circumstances that might affect the cost estimate.
examples.zh: 助学办公室的通知举了几种可能影响费用估算的「助学评估的特殊财务情况」。

collocations: report special circumstances to the aid office

words.enDefinition: a dividend paid outside a company's regular dividend schedule

examples.en: In the case, the company announced a special dividend after selling one of its businesses.
examples.zh: 在案例中，公司出售一项业务后宣布派发「特别股息」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to distinguish the special dividend from the company's usual quarterly payments.
examples.zh: 导师让我们区分「特别股息」和公司的常规季度派息。

words.enDefinition: a shareholder meeting called outside the regular annual meeting

examples.en: The fictional company called a special meeting of shareholders to discuss a proposed transaction.
examples.zh: 虚构公司召开了「临时股东大会」，讨论一项拟议交易。

examples.en: The agenda for the special meeting of shareholders listed only one matter for a vote.
examples.zh: 「临时股东大会」的议程只列出一项表决事项。

collocations: call a special meeting of shareholders
notice of a special meeting of shareholders
attend a special meeting of shareholders

words.enDefinition: A separate entity created for a defined transaction or project

examples.en: The case placed the project's assets in a special purpose vehicle before financing.
examples.zh: 案例在融资前把项目资产放在一个「特殊目的实体」名下。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the special purpose vehicle between the sponsors and lenders.
examples.zh: 导师在发起人与贷款机构之间画出了「特殊目的实体」。

collocations: set up a special purpose vehicle
finance through a special purpose vehicle

words.enDefinition: A US consumer report compiled for a specific kind of decision

examples.en: The class read a specialty consumer report that listed fictional tenants' past rental payments.
examples.zh: 课堂上读了一份「专类消费者报告」，列着虚构租客过去的租金付款记录。

examples.en: The example specialty consumer report covered bank account closures instead of borrowing history.
examples.zh: 示例中的「专类消费者报告」记录了银行账户关闭的情况，主题是银行账户历史。

collocations: a specialty consumer report on rental history
information in a specialty consumer report

words.enDefinition: a distribution of shares in a separated business to existing holders

examples.en: The case's spin-off distribution gave the parent company's shareholders shares in the newly separate company.
examples.zh: 案例中的「分拆公司股份分配」使母公司股东取得新独立公司的股份。

examples.en: The statement showed the spin-off distribution as a new holding rather than as a cash payment.
examples.zh: 对账单将「分拆公司股份分配」列为新持仓，没有列成现金支付。

collocations: receive shares in a spin-off distribution
the ratio for a spin-off distribution

words.enDefinition: a historical price restated to account for a stock split

examples.en: The class used the split-adjusted price to compare the stock's quotes before and after the split.
examples.zh: 同学们用「拆分调整后的股价」比较股票拆分前后的报价。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether the split-adjusted price appeared in the same column as the original quote.
examples.zh: 导师核对「拆分调整后的股价」是否和原报价列在同一栏。

words.zhGloss: 不同机构给出的分歧评级
words.enDefinition: a situation in which different agencies assign different credit ratings to the same issuer or issue
acceptedZhAnswers: 不同机构给出的分歧评级

examples.en: The split rating appeared because one agency placed the debt above the investment-grade cutoff and one below.
examples.zh: 一家机构把债务评在投资级门槛以上，另一家评在以下，形成「不同机构给出的分歧评级」。

examples.en: The tutor asked how the split rating would be displayed in the fund's sample holdings report.
examples.zh: 导师问，基金持仓样本报告会怎样显示「不同机构给出的分歧评级」。

collocations: a bond with a split rating

words.enDefinition: the stated relationship between old and new share counts in a split

examples.en: The split ratio in the sample replaced each old share with three new shares.
examples.zh: 样本中的「股票拆分比例」是每一股旧股拆为三股新股。

examples.en: We used the split ratio to explain the change in the mock account's share count.
examples.zh: 我们用「股票拆分比例」解释模拟账户的持股数量变化。

collocations: calculate shares using the split ratio

words.enDefinition: UK tax treatment dividing a year into resident and overseas parts

examples.en: The lecture used split-year treatment to explain the two periods in the case.
examples.zh: 课上通过「英国分段计税处理」来解释案例中的两个期间。

examples.en: The split-year treatment example described a fictional move halfway through the tax year.
examples.zh: 「英国分段计税处理」的示例描写了在纳税年度中途搬家的情形。

words.enDefinition: Ownership capital provided to a project by its sponsors

examples.en: The model showed sponsor equity covering part of the initial construction costs.
examples.zh: 模型显示，「发起人股本出资」承担了部分初始施工费用。

examples.en: Our funding table listed sponsor equity alongside the bank loan in separate rows.
examples.zh: 我们的资金表把「发起人股本出资」与银行贷款分行列出。

words.enDefinition: a decrease in the difference between a security's yield and the yield used as its benchmark

examples.en: The example linked spread tightening to a lower yield on the note relative to its benchmark.
examples.zh: 例子把「利差收窄」和该票据相对基准的收益率下降联系起来。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether spread tightening had occurred after the two yields moved closer together.
examples.zh: 两项收益率变得更接近后，导师问有没有发生「利差收窄」。

words.enDefinition: an increase in the difference between a security's yield and the yield used as its benchmark

examples.en: The risk report showed spread widening even though the benchmark government yield had hardly changed.
examples.zh: 虽然作为基准的国债收益率几乎没变，风险报告还是显示了「利差扩大」。

examples.en: Our class compared the effect of spread widening on two bonds with different durations.
examples.zh: 课堂比较了「利差扩大」对两只久期不同的债券有何影响。

words.enDefinition: a rating outlook indicating that the rating is unlikely to change within the relevant horizon

examples.en: The rating agency's case report kept a stable outlook on the fictional company's long-term debt.
examples.zh: 案例中的评级机构报告维持了虚构公司长期债务的「稳定评级展望」。

examples.en: We discussed why a stable outlook was listed even though the issue could still lose value.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么即使债券仍可能贬值，文件里也列出「稳定评级展望」。

words.zhGloss: 英国新入职薪税信息清单
words.enDefinition: An HMRC form for collecting a new employee's payroll tax information
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国新入职薪税信息清单

examples.en: The mock starter checklist included a question about another job held this year.
examples.zh: 模拟「英国新入职薪税信息清单」问了今年是否还做过另一份工作。

examples.en: The adviser explained the heading on the starter checklist during the job workshop.
examples.zh: 在求职工作坊上，顾问说明了「英国新入职薪税信息清单」的标题。

words.enDefinition: Earnings entered by the applicant before independent verification has taken place

examples.en: The stated income on our mock form included shifts from two separate jobs.
examples.zh: 模拟表格上「自行填报的收入」来自两份工作的班次。

examples.en: We compared the borrower's stated income with the amounts in the sample records.
examples.zh: 我们把借款人「自行填报的收入」和示例记录里的金额作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a supplementary US filing with further details about a fund

examples.en: We used the statement of additional information to read about the sample fund's board members.
examples.zh: 我们通过「补充信息说明书」了解样本基金的董事会成员。

examples.en: The sample prospectus pointed to the statement of additional information for details about proxy voting.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书指向「补充信息说明书」，说明可在那里查到代理投票的细节。

collocations: read the statement of additional information
details in the statement of additional information
update a statement of additional information

words.enDefinition: A consumer's explanation added to a US file about unresolved disputed information

examples.en: The sample file included a statement of dispute after the review left the entry unchanged.
examples.zh: 复查没有改那条记录，档案样本于是附了一份「异议声明」。

examples.en: We drafted a statement of dispute explaining why the fictional borrower still disagreed.
examples.zh: 我们拟了一份「异议声明」，解释虚构借款人为什么仍不同意。

words.enDefinition: A series of payment status updates showing how the recorded position changed over time.

examples.en: The status history showed when the bank first reported that settlement was still in progress.
examples.zh: 「付款状态历史记录」显示了银行何时首次报告结算仍在进行。

examples.en: We used the status history to tell which update came before the confirmation of credit.
examples.zh: 我们用「付款状态历史记录」判断，哪条更新出现在入账确认之前。

collocations: compare entries in the status history

words.enDefinition: The party or institution identified as reporting the current payment status.

examples.en: The diagram named an intermediary institution as the status originator for the latest tracking update.
examples.zh: 图中指出，最近一次追踪更新中「发出状态报告的一方」是一家中介机构。

examples.en: We checked the status originator before deciding which institution had reported the payment's latest position.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「发出状态报告的一方」，再判断是哪家机构上报了付款的最新进度。

collocations: a report from the status originator

words.enDefinition: Data giving the reason for a particular payment status, sometimes with both a code and an explanation.

examples.en: The status reason information explained why the sample payment had not moved to the next institution.
examples.zh: 「状态原因信息」解释了示例付款为什么没有进入下一家机构。

examples.en: The report displayed status reason information below the line showing whether the instruction was accepted.
examples.zh: 报文在显示指令是否获受理的那一行下面列出了「状态原因信息」。

collocations: check the status reason information field
review status reason information alongside the transaction status

words.enDefinition: A recorded date and time associated with a payment status or a status change.

examples.en: The status timestamp helped us put the two sample tracking updates in the correct order.
examples.zh: 「状态时间戳」帮助我们把两条示例追踪更新按正确的顺序排列。

examples.en: We compared the status timestamp with the later confirmation shown in the university's sample record.
examples.zh: 我们把「状态时间戳」与大学示例记录中随后出现的确认信息作了比较。

collocations: read the status timestamp on the tracking record

words.enDefinition: A report providing access to credit records under UK rules

examples.en: The British handout showed a statutory credit report with a section for linked addresses.
examples.zh: 英国讲义展示了一份「法定信用报告」，里面有一栏登记关联地址。

examples.en: The case study compared a statutory credit report with a commercial monitoring service's dashboard.
examples.zh: 案例比较了一份「法定信用报告」和某商业信用监测服务的界面。

words.enDefinition: the full-length US prospectus containing a fund's detailed disclosures

examples.en: The statutory prospectus explained the fund's dealing arrangements in more detail than the shorter document.
examples.zh: 「法定完整招募说明书」比简式文件更详细地解释了基金申赎安排。

examples.en: Our tutor used the statutory prospectus to show where the financial highlights appeared in the filing.
examples.zh: 导师用「法定完整招募说明书」指出了申报文件中的财务摘要位置。

words.zhGloss: 英国法定税务居留测试
words.enDefinition: The UK rules determining whether someone is resident for tax purposes
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国法定税务居留测试

examples.en: The adviser summarised the Statutory Residence Test before looking at the fictional calendar.
examples.zh: 顾问先概述了「英国法定税务居留测试」，再看虚构的日历。

examples.en: Our reading introduced the Statutory Residence Test in a chapter about midyear moves.
examples.zh: 阅读材料在关于年中搬迁的章节里介绍了「英国法定税务居留测试」。

words.enDefinition: a debt security whose coupon rate rises on stated dates or when a specified condition occurs

examples.en: The step-up note in the example paid a higher rate after three years under its terms.
examples.zh: 例中的「票息递升票据」按条款约定，在三年后按更高利率付息。

examples.en: Our worksheet listed the dates when the coupon on the step-up note would change.
examples.zh: 练习表列出了「票息递升票据」票息会在哪些日期变动。

collocations: coupon schedule of a step-up note

words.enDefinition: An Australian record of employment income reported through Single Touch Payroll

examples.en: The STP income statement showed both wages and the amounts withheld during the year.
examples.zh: 「澳洲STP收入报表」列出了该年度的工资和预扣金额。

examples.en: Ella compared the STP income statement with records from two campus jobs in the exercise.
examples.zh: 埃拉在练习里把「澳洲STP收入报表」与两份校内工作的记录作了对照。

collocations: wages on an STP income statement

words.zhGloss: 美国拆分本金或利息的国债
words.enDefinition: US Treasury zero-coupon securities created by separating payments on eligible notes, bonds or Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国拆分本金或利息的国债

examples.en: The lecturer showed how STRIPS could represent separate payments from one original Treasury security.
examples.zh: 讲师演示了「美国拆分本金或利息的国债」怎样对应同一只原始国债的各笔付款。

examples.en: Our table listed several STRIPS with different maturity dates but no regular coupon payments.
examples.zh: 我们的表列了几只「美国拆分本金或利息的国债」，到期日不同，都无定期票息。

words.enDefinition: An address whose parts are recorded in their own fields, such as the town and country.

examples.en: The structured postal address in our worksheet placed the town and country in separate fields.
examples.zh: 练习表中的「结构化邮寄地址」把城市和国家放在不同字段中。

examples.en: We read a structured postal address in the sample and compared it with the free-text version.
examples.zh: 我们读了示例中的「结构化邮寄地址」，然后和自由文本格式作了比较。

collocations: an example with a structured postal address

words.enDefinition: Reconciliation details carried in defined data fields, such as a reference identifying an invoice.

examples.en: The university matched an invoice to the sample payment using structured remittance information in the record.
examples.zh: 大学使用记录中的「结构化汇款附言信息」，把账单与示例付款匹配起来。

examples.en: We compared the structured remittance information in two examples that referred to different course invoices.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个示例中的「结构化汇款附言信息」，它们分别关联不同的课程账单。

collocations: match a record using structured remittance information

words.enDefinition: an initial or final coupon period whose length differs from a regular period in the schedule

examples.en: The sample bond started with a stub coupon period shorter than its ordinary payment intervals.
examples.zh: 示例债券一开始有一个「不规则票息期」，比常规付款间隔短。

examples.en: The tutor showed how the stub coupon period affected the amount of the first interest payment.
examples.zh: 导师演示了「不规则票息期」会怎样影响第一笔利息付款金额。

collocations: calculate interest for a stub coupon period
bond with a stub coupon period

words.enDefinition: a new review of the information used to calculate a student's aid eligibility or amount

examples.en: The adviser reviewed the outcome of the student aid reassessment after the study dates changed.
examples.zh: 就读日期变化后，顾问查看了「学生资助重新评估」的结果。

examples.en: The notice showed a new amount after the student aid reassessment had been completed that week.
examples.zh: 当周完成「学生资助重新评估」后，通知显示了一个新金额。

words.enDefinition: a New Zealand payment that helps eligible students with living expenses and is generally not repaid

examples.en: The New Zealand guide described a Student Allowance in a different section from borrowed living costs.
examples.zh: 新西兰指南把「新西兰学生生活津贴」与借贷支付的生活费分在不同章节。

examples.en: The adviser explained how the Student Allowance appeared in the sample weekly payment notice.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「新西兰学生生活津贴」如何列在每周付款通知样本里。

words.enDefinition: the Scottish public agency that assesses student funding applications and administers support including tuition assistance and bursaries

examples.en: The college guide mentioned the Student Awards Agency Scotland beside its section on bursaries.
examples.zh: 学院指南在助学金章节旁提到了「苏格兰学生资助署」。

examples.en: We compared a form from the Student Awards Agency Scotland with a sample form from England.
examples.zh: 我们把「苏格兰学生资助署」的一份表格与英格兰的一份样表作了比较。

collocations: apply to the Student Awards Agency Scotland
contact the Student Awards Agency Scotland

words.enDefinition: the part of the tuition cost that an Australian student in a Commonwealth supported place is charged

examples.en: The Australian offer displayed the student contribution amount beside the name of each unit of study.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的录取通知在每个修读单元名称旁显示「学生自付学费金额」。

examples.en: We checked the student contribution amount before comparing the two example undergraduate courses that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午比较示例中的两个本科课程前，我们先核对了「学生自付学费金额」。

words.enDefinition: the service that assesses and administers student finance applications for students applying under English funding arrangements

examples.en: I asked Student Finance England where the revised entitlement notice would appear in the account.
examples.zh: 我向「英格兰学生资助服务」询问，更新后的资助通知会显示在账户的什么位置。

examples.en: The campus adviser explained which questions should go to Student Finance England rather than the university.
examples.zh: 校园顾问解释了哪些问题该问「英格兰学生资助服务」，不能只问学校。

words.zhGloss: 北爱尔兰学生资助服务
words.enDefinition: the service handling student finance applications under Northern Ireland's funding arrangements
acceptedZhAnswers: 北爱尔兰学生资助服务

examples.en: The prospectus directed applicants with funding questions to Student Finance Northern Ireland for further information.
examples.zh: 招生简章请有资助疑问的申请人向「北爱尔兰学生资助服务」了解更多信息。

examples.en: I read an example from Student Finance Northern Ireland about receiving separate tuition and maintenance support.
examples.zh: 我读了「北爱尔兰学生资助服务」的一个例子，里面的学费和生活费资助是分开提供的。

collocations: apply through Student Finance Northern Ireland

words.enDefinition: a UK student finance notice setting out the support awarded and payment details, as used by Student Finance England

examples.en: The Student Finance Notification of Entitlement listed the amounts due at the start of each term.
examples.zh: 「学生资助核定通知」列出了各学期开始时应发的金额。

examples.en: We read a sample Student Finance Notification of Entitlement during the adviser training session that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午的顾问培训中，我们读了一份「学生资助核定通知」的样本。

collocations: receive a Student Finance Notification of Entitlement
check the Student Finance Notification of Entitlement
show your Student Finance Notification of Entitlement

words.enDefinition: the service that administers student finance applications made under Welsh funding arrangements

examples.en: We used a sample letter from Student Finance Wales to practise reading the funding summary.
examples.zh: 我们用「威尔士学生资助服务」的样本信练习阅读资助摘要。

examples.en: The adviser showed us where Student Finance Wales displayed the amount of living-cost support awarded.
examples.zh: 顾问给我们指了「威尔士学生资助服务」在哪里显示核定的生活费资助金额。

words.enDefinition: a yearly summary that may show the loan balance, interest and payments for the period

examples.en: The student loan annual statement displayed the previous balance beside the balance at year end.
examples.zh: 「学生贷款年度对账单」把先前的余额和年末余额并排列出。

examples.en: The adviser showed how interest and repayments appeared on a sample student loan annual statement.
examples.zh: 顾问示范了利息与还款怎样显示在「学生贷款年度对账单」样本上。

collocations: view a student loan annual statement
read the student loan annual statement
request a student loan annual statement

words.enDefinition: amounts taken from a worker's pay to repay a student loan under a payroll system

examples.en: The employee checked the student loan deductions on the practice payslip from the UK workshop.
examples.zh: 那名员工核对了英国工作坊工资单样本上的「学生贷款代扣还款额」。

examples.en: The payroll guide displayed student loan deductions in a different row from income tax.
examples.zh: 工资核算指南把「学生贷款代扣还款额」与所得税分行显示。

words.enDefinition: money borrowed through the New Zealand Student Loan scheme to help with living costs during study

examples.en: The sample showed Student Loan living costs as borrowed money alongside a separate line for grants.
examples.zh: 样本把「学生贷款生活费部分」列为借款，另列一行助学金。

examples.en: The adviser distinguished Student Loan living costs from the amount borrowed to pay compulsory fees.
examples.zh: 顾问把「学生贷款生活费部分」与借来支付必缴费用的金额区分开。

words.enDefinition: the public organisation that administers student finance and student loan repayments in the UK

examples.en: The borrower asked the Student Loans Company to explain a line on the annual statement.
examples.zh: 借款人请「英国学生贷款公司」解释年度对账单上的一行。

examples.en: Our guide identified the Student Loans Company as the organisation responsible for the repayment account.
examples.zh: 指南指出，「英国学生贷款公司」负责管理还款账户。

collocations: letter from the Student Loans Company

words.enDefinition: an Australian higher education charge that helps fund eligible student services and amenities

examples.en: The sample invoice listed a student services and amenities fee on a line below tuition.
examples.zh: 发票样本在学费下面单列了一笔「学生服务与设施费」。

examples.en: The adviser explained what the student services and amenities fee supported at that Australian university.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了那所澳大利亚大学的「学生服务与设施费」支持哪些服务。

collocations: pay the student services and amenities fee
charge a student services and amenities fee
student services and amenities fee due date

words.enDefinition: the New Zealand government service administering student loans, allowances and related student support

examples.en: The university adviser directed us to StudyLink for an official overview of New Zealand funding.
examples.zh: 大学顾问让我们去「新西兰学生资助服务」看官方的资助概览。

examples.en: Our workshop used a sample notice from StudyLink to show how payment information was organised.
examples.zh: 工作坊用「新西兰学生资助服务」的通知样本说明付款信息怎样组织。

words.enDefinition: a distinct investment pool within a larger umbrella fund

examples.en: The sub-fund in the case had its own objective even though the umbrella name was shared.
examples.zh: 案例中的「子基金」虽然使用共同的伞形基金名称，但有自己的投资目标。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which sub-fund the return chart described before we compared the reported numbers.
examples.zh: 比较报告中的数据前，导师让我们确认回报图表说的是哪只「子基金」。

words.enDefinition: a bond whose holders rank behind specified senior creditors when payments or claims are prioritised

examples.en: We read the terms of the subordinated bond to see which obligations ranked ahead of it.
examples.zh: 我们读了「次级债券」的条款，看哪些债务的清偿顺位排在它前面。

examples.en: The model included a subordinated bond that would receive payment after the senior claims were met.
examples.zh: 模型里有一只「次级债券」，要等优先债权获清偿后才取得付款。

collocations: a subordinated bond ranks below senior debt

words.enDefinition: a right to purchase offered shares on specified terms

examples.en: In the case, each subscription right could be used to buy a stated number of shares.
examples.zh: 案例中的每项「股份认购权」可用于购买规定数量的股份。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked when a subscription right would expire under the sample offering terms.
examples.zh: 练习表问，按照样本发行条款，「股份认购权」何时到期。

collocations: the expiration of a subscription right

words.enDefinition: A US tax residency test based on days physically present

examples.en: The adviser explained the substantial presence test using a calendar for a fictional visitor.
examples.zh: 顾问用一位虚构访客的日历解释了「美国实际居留测试」。

examples.en: Our notes defined the substantial presence test before introducing the example travel dates.
examples.zh: 笔记先定义「美国实际居留测试」，再给出示例出行日期。

words.enDefinition: Rules about the evidence needed to support a reported tax claim

examples.en: The training notes covered substantiation requirements using a receipt from a fictional purchase.
examples.zh: 培训笔记用一笔虚构购物的收据讲解了「税务申报佐证要求」。

examples.en: The ATO guide discussed substantiation requirements in a section on work expenses.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚税务局指南在工作开支一节讨论了「税务申报佐证要求」。

words.enDefinition: A UK residency test combining days present with specified connections

examples.en: The case study introduced the sufficient ties test after listing the person's time abroad.
examples.zh: 案例在列出当事人出国的时间后，介绍了「英国足够联系测试」。

examples.en: We found the sufficient ties test heading in the statutory residence guidance.
examples.zh: 我们在法定居留说明文件中找到了「英国足够联系测试」的章节标题。

words.enDefinition: a short US document setting out key information about a fund

examples.en: In our class pack, the summary prospectus stated the fund's objective and listed its main risks.
examples.zh: 在课程材料中，「简式招募说明书」写明了基金目标并列出了主要风险。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to find the cost table in the sample fund's summary prospectus.
examples.zh: 导师让我们在样本基金的「简式招募说明书」里找到费用表。

words.enDefinition: shares carrying more votes per share than another class

examples.en: The founder's super-voting shares carried ten votes per share in our fictional company case.
examples.zh: 在我们的虚构公司案例中，创始人的「超级表决权股份」每股有十票。

examples.en: We identified the super-voting shares before comparing the ownership percentages and votes of both classes.
examples.zh: 我们先识别了「超级表决权股份」，再比较两类股份的持股比例和票数。

words.zhGloss: Swift GPI 全球支付追踪服务
words.enDefinition: A Swift service that gives participating institutions visibility into the progress of cross-border payments and related details.
acceptedZhAnswers: Swift GPI 全球支付追踪服务

examples.en: The lecture explained how Swift GPI can show updates from participating banks along a payment route.
examples.zh: 讲座说明「Swift GPI 全球支付追踪服务」怎样显示支付链路中参与银行的状态更新。

examples.en: We compared a basic payment record with an example of Swift GPI tracking provided in class.
examples.zh: 我们把一份基本付款记录与课堂提供的「Swift GPI 全球支付追踪服务」示例作了比较。

words.enDefinition: adjusting a fund's dealing price to reduce dilution from investor flows

examples.en: The class discussed swing pricing after reading a case with unusually large fund redemptions.
examples.zh: 同学们读到一个基金赎回量异常大的案例后，讨论了「摆动定价」。

examples.en: Under the hypothetical swing pricing example, the dealing price reflected some trading costs from net outflows.
examples.zh: 在假设的「摆动定价」示例中，申赎价格反映了净赎回带来的部分交易成本。

collocations: disclose the use of swing pricing

words.zhGloss: 使评估结论改变的临界值
words.enDefinition: An input level at which a preferred option or conclusion changes
acceptedZhAnswers: 使评估结论改变的临界值

examples.en: The switching value showed how low demand would have to fall to change the ranking.
examples.zh: 「使评估结论改变的临界值」显示，需求得降到多低才会改变排序。

examples.en: We found the switching value by varying the cost in our classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们改变课堂模型里的成本，找出了「使评估结论改变的临界值」。

words.enDefinition: settlement one business day after the trade date

examples.en: The sample US confirmation showed T+1 on a trade executed on a Monday.
examples.zh: 这笔美国样本交易于周一成交，确认单标明「次工作日结算」。

examples.en: The timeline showed T+1 on Tuesday because the trade occurred on a regular Monday.
examples.zh: 这笔交易在正常交易日周一完成，时间线上把周二标为「次工作日结算」。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大个人报税调整申请表
words.enDefinition: A Canadian form for requesting changes to a filed individual return
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大个人报税调整申请表

examples.en: The fictional taxpayer's document pack had T1-ADJ bookmarked under return changes.
examples.zh: 虚构纳税人的资料包在申报更改一栏给「加拿大个人报税调整申请表」加了书签。

examples.en: We read T1-ADJ in the exercise about correcting a past filing.
examples.zh: 我们在有关更正历史申报的练习里读了「加拿大个人报税调整申请表」。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大个人所得税及福利表
words.enDefinition: The main Canadian income tax and benefit return for individuals
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大个人所得税及福利表

examples.en: The guide introduced the T1 return before showing the extra schedules.
examples.zh: 指南先介绍了「加拿大个人所得税及福利表」，再展示其他附表。

examples.en: We located the address field on the mock T1 return in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上找到了模拟「加拿大个人所得税及福利表」的地址栏。

collocations: the income section of the T1 return

words.zhGloss: 加拿大境外财产申报表
words.enDefinition: A Canadian information return covering certain specified foreign property holdings
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大境外财产申报表

examples.en: The workshop discussed T1135 in a special section about foreign assets.
examples.zh: 工作坊在专讲境外资产的一节讨论了「加拿大境外财产申报表」。

examples.en: Our notes placed T1135 with asset reports rather than annual earnings slips.
examples.zh: 我们的笔记把「加拿大境外财产申报表」与资产报告归在一起，没有列在年度收入税务单据中。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大个体经营业务活动表
words.enDefinition: A Canadian form reporting income and expenses from certain individual businesses
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大个体经营业务活动表

examples.en: The form T2125 appeared in a case about a student translation business.
examples.zh: 一个学生翻译业务案例里出现了「加拿大个体经营业务活动表」。

examples.en: We checked where advertising costs appeared on the mock T2125.
examples.zh: 我们核对了模拟的「加拿大个体经营业务活动表」中广告支出的位置。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大信托收入分配税务单
words.enDefinition: A Canadian slip reporting income allocated by a trust to beneficiaries
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大信托收入分配税务单

examples.en: The class read a T3 slip in an example about a fund distribution.
examples.zh: 全班在一则基金分配案例中读了一份「加拿大信托收入分配税务单」。

examples.en: We looked for the distribution category in the T3 slip from the sample pack.
examples.zh: 我们在样例包里的「加拿大信托收入分配税务单」上查找分配类别。

words.enDefinition: The Canadian T4A field for specified scholarship and similar payments

examples.en: The example bursary appeared in T4A box 105 on the school's income slip.
examples.zh: 例子里的助学金显示在学校税务单据的「加拿大T4A奖助收入栏」。

examples.en: We matched the amount in T4A box 105 to the fictional award letter.
examples.zh: 我们把「加拿大T4A奖助收入栏」的金额与虚构的获奖通知对上了。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大非居民劳务付款单
words.enDefinition: A Canadian slip for certain service payments to nonresident providers
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大非居民劳务付款单

examples.en: The sample T4A-NR slip recorded a service payment from a fictional Canadian client.
examples.zh: 「加拿大非居民劳务付款单」样本记录了虚构加拿大客户的一笔劳务付款。

examples.en: The case study grouped the T4A-NR slip with records about services in Canada.
examples.zh: 案例把「加拿大非居民劳务付款单」和关于在加拿大提供劳务的记录归到一起。

collocations: payments shown on a T4A-NR slip

words.zhGloss: 加拿大养老金等收入信息单
words.enDefinition: A Canadian information slip reporting pensions and certain other payments
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大养老金等收入信息单

examples.en: The university listed the research award on a T4A slip in this example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，大学把研究奖助金列在「加拿大养老金等收入信息单」上。

examples.en: We compared the payer names on two sample documents including a T4A slip.
examples.zh: 我们对照了两份样本上的付款方名称，其中一份是「加拿大养老金等收入信息单」。

collocations: a payment shown on a T4A slip

words.zhGloss: 加拿大就业保险福利税务单
words.enDefinition: A Canadian slip showing employment insurance and certain other benefit payments
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大就业保险福利税务单

examples.en: The example T4E slip listed benefits separately from the employer's annual statement.
examples.zh: 示例「加拿大就业保险福利税务单」列的是福利，与雇主年度报表分开。

examples.en: Our adviser pointed out the reporting year at the top of the T4E slip.
examples.zh: 顾问指出了「加拿大就业保险福利税务单」顶部的申报年度。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大投资收入税务单
words.enDefinition: A Canadian information slip reporting certain interest and other investment income
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大投资收入税务单

examples.en: The fictional bank reported interest on a T5 slip for the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习里，虚构银行通过「加拿大投资收入税务单」报告了利息。

examples.en: We searched the sample T5 slip for the name of the paying institution.
examples.zh: 我们在「加拿大投资收入税务单」样本中找到了支付款项的机构名称。

collocations: interest reported on a T5 slip

words.enDefinition: to count and organise votes to determine the result

examples.en: The sample meeting procedure assigned an independent inspector to tabulate the votes for each proposal.
examples.zh: 样本会议程序指定一名独立验票人「统计各项票数」。

examples.en: Our class used a simple table to tabulate the votes before comparing the two totals.
examples.zh: 我们班用一张简单表格「统计各项票数」，然后比较两个总数。

collocations: appoint someone to tabulate the votes

words.enDefinition: A provision requiring minimum payment even if contracted supply goes unused

examples.en: The take-or-pay clause kept a minimum payment in the lower demand case.
examples.zh: 在需求较低的情景下，「照付不议条款」仍保证最低付款。

examples.en: Our workbook showed the receipts linked to the take-or-pay clause separately.
examples.zh: 我们的练习册把与「照付不议条款」关联的收款单列出来。

words.zhGloss: 美国税务账户活动摘录
words.enDefinition: An IRS summary of tax account activity, including later adjustments
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国税务账户活动摘录

examples.en: The tax account transcript showed a later adjustment to the fictional taxpayer's account.
examples.zh: 「美国税务账户活动摘录」列出了虚构纳税人账户后来的调整。

examples.en: We found the date of an example payment in the tax account transcript.
examples.zh: 我们在「美国税务账户活动摘录」里找到了示例付款日期。

collocations: a payment on a tax account transcript
dates on a tax account transcript

words.enDefinition: The initial tax-free income band for eligible Australian taxpayers

examples.en: The payroll lesson introduced the tax-free threshold before discussing the sample deduction.
examples.zh: 薪资课先介绍了「澳洲免税起征点」，再讨论示例扣税金额。

examples.en: We found a question about the tax-free threshold on the training form.
examples.zh: 我们在培训表格上找到一道关于「澳洲免税起征点」的问题。

collocations: a declaration referring to the tax-free threshold

words.enDefinition: A person's main place of business or work for tax purposes

examples.en: Our US tax notes illustrated tax home with a contractor's main work location.
examples.zh: 美国报税笔记以承包人的主要工作地点为例说明了「主要工作所在地」。

examples.en: The example's tax home remained the city where most work was performed.
examples.zh: 例子中，「主要工作所在地」仍是完成大部分工作的那座城市。

collocations: a temporary move away from one's tax home

words.zhGloss: 薪税数据已确认可报税
words.enDefinition: An Australian status indicating the employer has finalised reported payroll data
acceptedZhAnswers: 薪税数据已确认可报税

examples.en: The income statement showed tax ready after the employer confirmed its payroll information.
examples.zh: 雇主确认薪税信息后，收入报表显示「薪税数据已确认可报税」。

examples.en: Ming found the label tax ready above the totals on the demo page.
examples.zh: 小明在演示页面合计金额上方看到了「薪税数据已确认可报税」的标记。

collocations: an income statement marked tax ready
check whether it is tax ready

words.enDefinition: An IRS record showing most items from a return as originally filed

examples.en: We checked the tax return transcript to see what the original filing had shown.
examples.zh: 我们查了「美国原申报表摘录」，看原始申报列了哪些内容。

examples.en: The tax return transcript omitted a later change made in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 「美国原申报表摘录」里没有虚构案例后来作出的一项更改。

collocations: address on the tax return transcript

words.enDefinition: A payer or intermediary responsible for withholding tax from specified payments

examples.en: The university appeared as the tax withholding agent on the example scholarship paperwork.
examples.zh: 在奖学金文件的示例里，大学是「税款预扣义务人」。

examples.en: I matched the tax withholding agent to the institution listed in the sample statement.
examples.zh: 我把「税款预扣义务人」和报表样本里列出的机构对上了。

collocations: a notice from the tax withholding agent
act as a tax withholding agent

words.enDefinition: An asset's remaining value after tax depreciation or allowances are deducted

examples.en: The case compared tax written-down value with the amount received for the old machine.
examples.zh: 案例对照了「税务折余价值」和旧机器的卖出金额。

examples.en: Our notes listed tax written-down value separately from the figure in the accounting records.
examples.zh: 笔记把「税务折余价值」与会计账簿里的数值分开列出。

collocations: compare tax written-down value with sale price

words.enDefinition: An HMRC summary of amounts due and paid for a tax year

examples.en: The tax year overview showed a payment made after the return was filed.
examples.zh: 「英国纳税年度汇总」列出了一笔在提交申报表后缴的钱。

examples.en: In class, we compared the tax year overview with the tax calculation document.
examples.zh: 我们在课上把「英国纳税年度汇总」和税额计算单作了对照。

collocations: the balance on a tax year overview

words.zhGloss: 加拿大个人抵免申报表
words.enDefinition: A Canadian form collecting personal credit details for payroll tax deductions
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大个人抵免申报表

examples.en: Our workshop found the TD1 form in its sample hiring paperwork.
examples.zh: 工作坊在招聘文书样本中找到了「加拿大个人抵免申报表」。

examples.en: The example TD1 form appeared before the section on annual earnings slips.
examples.zh: 「加拿大个人抵免申报表」的示例列在年度收入税务单章节之前。

collocations: the personal amounts on a TD1 form

words.enDefinition: a US federal grant for eligible teacher education students that has a teaching service obligation

examples.en: The TEACH Grant section of the handbook explained that the grant came with a service obligation.
examples.zh: 手册的「美国教师教育资助」一节说明，这项助学金带有任教服务义务。

examples.en: We compared the TEACH Grant with a scholarship offered by the university's school of education.
examples.zh: 我们把「美国教师教育资助」和大学教育学院提供的奖学金作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Checks of whether a message has the required format and structure to be processed.

examples.en: The sample record showed technical validation had passed before the payment moved to a separate review stage.
examples.zh: 示例记录显示，付款进入另一项审核前，已通过「报文技术校验」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained that technical validation covered the message structure in the example rather than its outcome.
examples.zh: 老师解释，例子中的「报文技术校验」检查的是其报文结构。

words.zhGloss: 澳洲临时居民税务处理
words.enDefinition: Australian tax rules applying to people classified as temporary residents
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲临时居民税务处理

examples.en: The seminar used temporary resident tax treatment to frame a case about earnings from overseas.
examples.zh: 研讨课以「澳洲临时居民税务处理」为背景，讨论了一则境外收入案例。

examples.en: We read about temporary resident tax treatment in the guide to Australian income categories.
examples.zh: 我们在澳大利亚收入类别指南中读到了「澳洲临时居民税务处理」。

collocations: an example of temporary resident tax treatment

words.enDefinition: an invitation to holders to sell securities on stated terms

examples.en: The fictional company announced a tender offer with a stated price and a limited acceptance period.
examples.zh: 虚构公司宣布了一项规定价格和有限接受期的「证券收购要约」。

examples.en: Our exercise compared who made the tender offer with who owned the shares at the time.
examples.zh: 练习对比了提出「证券收购要约」的一方和当时持有股份的一方。

collocations: the closing date of a tender offer

words.enDefinition: Cash inflows and outflows arising at the end of a project

examples.en: The terminal cash flow included final equipment sales and the cost of restoring the site.
examples.zh: 「期末现金流」包括最后的设备出售收入和场地恢复费用。

examples.en: I moved the expected refund into terminal cash flow on the sample worksheet.
examples.zh: 我把预计退款移到练习表样本的「期末现金流」一栏。

words.enDefinition: Payment due when an agreement ends early under specified circumstances

examples.en: The scenario calculated termination compensation because the concession ended before its scheduled date.
examples.zh: 由于特许经营提前结束，情景分析计算了「合同终止补偿」。

examples.en: The draft agreement stated who would pay termination compensation in the example.
examples.zh: 协议草案写明了示例中由谁支付「合同终止补偿」。

words.enDefinition: separate portions of a payment scheduled by academic term rather than paid all at once

examples.en: The notice showed three termly instalments with different dates over the course of the year.
examples.zh: 通知列出了本年度日期各不相同的三笔「每学期分期款」。

examples.en: I copied the dates of the termly instalments into the budgeting worksheet for my course.
examples.zh: 我把「每学期分期款」的日期抄到了课程用的预算表里。

words.enDefinition: the short code used to identify a security in market quotes

examples.en: The sample exchange notice displayed the ticker symbol beside the fictional company's name and listing date.
examples.zh: 样本交易所通知在虚构公司的名称和上市日期旁显示「股票交易代码」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why a ticker symbol might have a suffix indicating a different share class.
examples.zh: 导师解释，为什么「股票交易代码」可能带有表示不同股份类别的后缀。

words.zhGloss: 美国《高教法》第四章资助
words.enDefinition: US federal student aid provided under Title IV of the Higher Education Act
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国《高教法》第四章资助

examples.en: The university's financial aid handbook explained which awards in the example counted as Title IV aid.
examples.zh: 大学的助学手册解释了例子里哪些资助属于「美国《高教法》第四章资助」。

examples.en: The adviser reviewed the Title IV aid entries when explaining my two scholarship notices.
examples.zh: 顾问解释我的两份奖学金通知时，查看了其中的「美国《高教法》第四章资助」条目。

words.enDefinition: A US loan secured by the borrower's vehicle and its title

examples.en: The tutor introduced a title loan using a fictional car the borrower already owned.
examples.zh: 导师以借款人已经拥有的虚构车辆为例，介绍了「车辆产权担保贷款」。

examples.en: The title loan example used a borrowed amount smaller than the car value.
examples.zh: 「车辆产权担保贷款」的示例中，借款额低于车辆价值。

words.enDefinition: the investments with the largest weights in a portfolio

examples.en: The fund fact sheet showed the top holdings from the last day of the quarter.
examples.zh: 基金概况表列出了截至季度最后一天的「主要持仓」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how many of the top holdings appeared in both sample reports.
examples.zh: 导师问，有多少项「主要持仓」同时出现在两份样本报告中。

words.enDefinition: A bar chart ranking inputs by their impact on model results

examples.en: The tornado chart showed demand as the largest source of variation in value.
examples.zh: 「敏感性龙卷风图」显示，需求是价值变化幅度最大的因素。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what the widest bar in the tornado chart represented.
examples.zh: 导师问「敏感性龙卷风图」里最长的条代表什么。

words.enDefinition: the percentage change in investment value including income, typically with fund distributions treated as reinvested

examples.en: The exercise used price changes and reinvested distributions to calculate the sample fund's total return.
examples.zh: 练习用价格变动和分配再投资计算样本基金的「总回报率」。

examples.en: Our tutor used total return to compare two hypothetical funds with different distribution policies.
examples.zh: 导师用「总回报率」比较两只分配政策不同的假设基金。

words.enDefinition: the difference between fund and tracked index returns for a period

examples.en: We measured tracking difference by subtracting the index return from the sample fund's return for that year.
examples.zh: 我们用样本基金该年的回报率减去指数回报率，衡量「跟踪差异」。

examples.en: The report showed a larger tracking difference for the second fund over the same quarter.
examples.zh: 报告显示，在同一季度，第二只基金的「跟踪差异」更大。

words.enDefinition: the standard deviation of differences between portfolio and benchmark returns

examples.en: The exercise calculated tracking error from monthly differences between portfolio and benchmark returns across three years.
examples.zh: 练习根据三年间投资组合与基准的月度回报率差值计算「跟踪误差」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why low tracking error could coexist with a consistent performance gap.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「跟踪误差」较低，业绩差距却能一直存在。

collocations: a portfolio with low tracking error

words.expression: trade at a discount to NAV
words.lemma: trade at a discount to nav
words.zhGloss: 以低于净值的价格交易
words.enDefinition: to trade below a fund's net asset value per share
acceptedZhAnswers: 以低于净值的价格交易
acceptedEnVariants: trade at a discount to NAV

examples.en: The lecturer used the sample prices to show what it means to trade at a discount to NAV.
examples.zh: 讲师用样本价格说明「以低于净值的价格交易」是什么意思。

examples.en: Our first calculation showed that the ETF could trade at a discount to NAV that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们的第一项计算显示，这只 ETF 那天下午可能「以低于净值的价格交易」。

collocations: continue to trade at a discount to NAV
trade at a discount to NAV at the close
occasionally trade at a discount to NAV

words.expression: trade at a premium to NAV
words.lemma: trade at a premium to nav
words.zhGloss: 以高于净值的价格交易
words.enDefinition: to trade above a fund's net asset value per share
acceptedZhAnswers: 以高于净值的价格交易
acceptedEnVariants: trade at a premium to NAV

examples.en: Our tutor showed how ETF shares can trade at a premium to NAV on the exchange.
examples.zh: 导师演示了 ETF 份额如何在交易所「以高于净值的价格交易」。

examples.en: The worksheet assumed shares would trade at a premium to NAV on the first sample day.
examples.zh: 练习表假定份额在样本的第一天「以高于净值的价格交易」。

collocations: trade at a premium to NAV at the close
continue to trade at a premium to NAV
briefly trade at a premium to NAV

words.enDefinition: a broker's record confirming the details of an executed trade

examples.en: The sample trade confirmation showed the price, date, and quantity for a single stock trade.
examples.zh: 样本「证券成交确认单」列出一笔股票交易的价格、日期和数量。

examples.en: We checked the trade confirmation against the entry shown in the monthly brokerage statement.
examples.zh: 我们把「证券成交确认单」与月度券商对账单上的记录作了核对。

words.enDefinition: the date on which a securities trade is executed

examples.en: The trade date on the sample confirmation differed from the date the shares were delivered.
examples.zh: 样本确认单上的「成交日」与股份实际交付的日期不同。

examples.en: We checked the trade date before placing the transaction in the correct row of the timeline.
examples.zh: 我们先核对了「成交日」，再把这笔交易放到时间线的正确一行。

collocations: one business day after the trade date

words.enDefinition: A credit report entry describing one particular account and its history

examples.en: The tradeline showed when the fictional borrower's account first appeared on the report.
examples.zh: 这条「信用账户记录项」显示了虚构借款人的账户何时首次出现在报告上。

examples.en: We compared a tradeline for a store card with an entry for a loan.
examples.zh: 我们比较了一条商店信用卡的「信用账户记录项」和一条贷款记录。

collocations: add a tradeline to the report

words.enDefinition: describes a bond trading at a price higher than its face value

examples.en: The example showed a bond trading above par when its fixed coupon exceeded the comparable market yield.
examples.zh: 示例债券固定票息率高于可比市场收益率时，「交易价高于面值」。

examples.en: We noted which bond was trading above par before comparing the prices and payment schedules.
examples.zh: 我们先标出哪只债券「交易价高于面值」，再比较价格和付款安排。

words.enDefinition: describes a bond trading at a price lower than its face value

examples.en: We identified the note trading below par by comparing its quoted price with its face value.
examples.zh: 我们把报价和面值一比，找出了哪只票据「交易价低于面值」。

examples.en: A note trading below par can reflect concern about the issuer's ability to repay.
examples.zh: 票据「交易价低于面值」，可能反映市场担忧发行人的偿债能力。

words.enDefinition: a temporary pause in trading a security

examples.en: The example exchange bulletin announced a trading halt pending an announcement from the fictional company.
examples.zh: 示例交易所公告宣布「临时停牌」，等待虚构公司发布消息。

examples.en: Our tutor differentiated a trading halt from the company's permanent removal from the sample exchange.
examples.zh: 导师区分了「临时停牌」和公司从样本交易所永久退市。

collocations: resume trading after a trading halt

words.enDefinition: A reference assigned by the first instructing institution to identify the transaction across the interbank chain.

examples.en: The transaction identification stayed the same in the record shown for both banks in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习展示的两家银行记录里，「银行间交易标识」保持一致。

examples.en: We compared the transaction identification with the message references for the two separate records.
examples.zh: 我们把「银行间交易标识」与两份记录各自使用的报文参考号作了比较。

collocations: match records using the transaction identification

words.enDefinition: a fee for maintaining shareholder records and processing fund transactions

examples.en: The sample fund's transfer agent fee covered work on account records and share transactions.
examples.zh: 样本基金的「过户代理费」涵盖了账户记录和份额交易的处理工作。

examples.en: Our group added the transfer agent fee to the other costs shown in the operating table.
examples.zh: 我们小组把「过户代理费」加进运作费用表里的其他费用。

words.enDefinition: A disclosure label for taxes collected by the transfer provider in connection with the remittance.

examples.en: The remittance example showed Transfer Taxes on its own line beside the fees the provider collected.
examples.zh: 跨境汇款示例把「汇款税费」单独列在服务商所收费用旁。

examples.en: The trainer pointed to Transfer Taxes when explaining why those amounts were labelled separately from provider fees.
examples.zh: 培训员讲到这些款项为什么和服务商收费分开列示时，指了指「汇款税费」一栏。

collocations: check the amount under Transfer Taxes

words.enDefinition: a short-term US Treasury security that ordinarily has no periodic interest payments

examples.en: The lecturer used a Treasury bill to illustrate the difference between issue price and face value.
examples.zh: 讲师用一只「美国短期国库券」说明发行价格与面值的区别。

examples.en: We looked up the maturity of the Treasury bill listed in the practice auction announcement.
examples.zh: 我们查看了练习用拍卖公告所列「美国短期国库券」什么时候到期。

words.enDefinition: US Treasury securities whose principal is adjusted using a consumer price index

examples.en: Our worksheet used Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities to show how an index adjustment affects principal.
examples.zh: 练习表用「美国通胀保值国债」说明指数调整会怎样影响本金。

examples.en: The guide discussed Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities separately from conventional fixed-principal Treasury notes and bonds.
examples.zh: 指南把「美国通胀保值国债」和财政部发行的固定本金票据、债券分开介绍。

words.enDefinition: US Treasury debt instruments that can be bought and sold in the secondary market

examples.en: Our class used Treasury marketable securities to illustrate how an auction differs from secondary trading.
examples.zh: 课堂用「可交易美国国债」说明拍卖与二级市场交易的区别。

examples.en: The guide separated Treasury marketable securities from the savings bonds it described later on.
examples.zh: 指南把「可交易美国国债」与后文介绍的储蓄国债分开说明。

words.enDefinition: a US Treasury security issued with a term of two to ten years and fixed coupon payments

examples.en: The auction notice described a five-year Treasury note and gave both auction and issue dates.
examples.zh: 拍卖通知介绍了一只五年期「美国中期国债」，并列出拍卖与发行日期。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the cash flows of a Treasury note and a short-term Treasury bill.
examples.zh: 导师比较了「美国中期国债」与短期国库券的现金流。

words.enDefinition: shares a company has reacquired and continues to hold

examples.en: The sample company reported treasury shares separately from outstanding shares in its equity table.
examples.zh: 样本公司在股权表中把「库存股」和发行在外股份分开报告。

examples.en: We checked whether repurchased shares were retired or held as treasury shares in the case.
examples.zh: 我们核对了案例中回购的股份是注销还是作为「库存股」持有。

words.enDefinition: An exemption from tax provided under an applicable international treaty

examples.en: The memo mentioned a treaty exemption for the scholarship in its hypothetical example.
examples.zh: 备忘录在假设案例中提到了该笔奖学金适用的「税收协定免税待遇」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained which income the sample treaty exemption referred to in the notes.
examples.zh: 导师解释了笔记里示例「税收协定免税待遇」针对哪项收入。

words.zhGloss: 协定中的双重居民判定规则
words.enDefinition: A treaty rule resolving dual claims to a person's tax residence
acceptedZhAnswers: 协定中的双重居民判定规则

examples.en: The lecture described a treaty tie-breaker after two countries claimed tax residence.
examples.zh: 课上说明了两国均认定一人是税务居民时的「协定双重居民判定规则」。

examples.en: The treaty tie-breaker in the example appeared under the residency article heading.
examples.zh: 示例「协定中的双重居民判定规则」列在税务居民身份条款的标题下。

words.enDefinition: The US law governing disclosures of terms and costs for consumer credit

examples.en: Our class read a sample form that cited the Truth in Lending Act in its heading.
examples.zh: 全班阅读了一份标题中引用「美国《贷款诚实法》」的表单样本。

examples.en: The lecture used the Truth in Lending Act to introduce consumer credit disclosures in the US.
examples.zh: 课上通过「美国《贷款诚实法》」介绍了美国的消费信贷披露。

collocations: disclosures under the Truth in Lending Act
requirements of the Truth in Lending Act
a form referencing the Truth in Lending Act

words.zhGloss: 美国贷款条款与费用披露
words.enDefinition: A US statement showing key costs and terms of consumer borrowing
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国贷款条款与费用披露

examples.en: The Truth-in-Lending disclosure listed the financing cost separately from the amount provided.
examples.zh: 「美国贷款条款与费用披露」将融资费用与实际提供的信贷金额分开列出。

examples.en: We read a Truth-in-Lending disclosure before comparing the two fictional car loans.
examples.zh: 我们先读了一份「美国贷款条款与费用披露」，再比较两笔虚构的车贷。

collocations: compare costs in a Truth-in-Lending disclosure

words.zhGloss: 加拿大未用学费金额结转
words.enDefinition: Unused Canadian tuition amount carried into a future tax year
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大未用学费金额结转

examples.en: The mock assessment listed a tuition amount carryforward below the current year figures.
examples.zh: 模拟税额核定记录把「加拿大未用学费金额结转」列在本年度数据下方。

examples.en: In the example, the tuition amount carryforward came from an earlier unused tuition amount.
examples.zh: 在例子中，「加拿大未用学费金额结转」来自往年未使用的学费金额。

words.enDefinition: Assignment of eligible Canadian tuition amounts to a qualifying person

examples.en: The worksheet illustrated a tuition amount transfer using two fictional family members.
examples.zh: 练习表用两名虚构家庭成员的例子说明了「加拿大学费金额转让」。

examples.en: The tuition amount transfer appeared separately from the amount kept for future years.
examples.zh: 例表把「加拿大学费金额转让」和留给以后年度使用的金额分开显示。

words.enDefinition: The final party to whom the money is owed, even if an intermediary receives it first.

examples.en: The ultimate creditor was the supplier owed the fee that a central office collected on its behalf.
examples.zh: 「最终应收款方」是这家供应商，由中央办公室代它收取这笔费用。

examples.en: The worksheet listed the ultimate creditor separately from the account holder receiving the first payment.
examples.zh: 练习表把「最终应收款方」和先收到付款的账户持有人分开列出了。

collocations: an entry for the ultimate creditor

words.enDefinition: The person or organisation ultimately owing the payment, even if another party pays on its behalf.

examples.en: In the classroom example, the ultimate debtor was the department that owed the original invoice.
examples.zh: 课堂例子中，「最终付款义务方」是原账单上负有付款义务的院系。

examples.en: The tutor pointed out the ultimate debtor after explaining who had submitted the payment request.
examples.zh: 老师先讲是谁提交了付款请求，再指出谁是「最终付款义务方」。

collocations: an entry for the ultimate debtor

words.enDefinition: one fund structure containing several distinct sub-funds

examples.en: The exercise described an umbrella fund containing separate portfolios for domestic and international holdings.
examples.zh: 练习介绍了一只「伞形基金」，其中本国持仓和国际持仓分属不同组合。

examples.en: We found the name of the umbrella fund above the list of available sub-funds.
examples.zh: 我们在可用子基金清单上方找到了「伞形基金」的名称。

collocations: a sub-fund within an umbrella fund

words.zhGloss: 无法把款项入账或核销
words.enDefinition: Unable to post a payment to the correct account or match it to the intended item in a recipient's records.
acceptedZhAnswers: 无法把款项入账或核销

examples.en: The case described a recipient unable to apply a payment to the right invoice in its records.
examples.zh: 案例描述了收款方「无法把款项按正确账单核销」的情况。

examples.en: The training example explained why the bank was unable to apply a payment to the customer's account.
examples.zh: 培训示例解释了银行为什么「无法把款项入到客户账户」。

collocations: a message saying unable to apply a payment
check why a bank was unable to apply a payment
reported as unable to apply a payment

words.enDefinition: A decision note saying the lender could not confirm reported earnings

examples.en: The phrase "Unable to verify income" appeared next to the fictional employer's name in the review.
examples.zh: 审核记录里，虚构雇主的名字旁写着「无法核实收入」。

examples.en: We matched "Unable to verify income" with the missing information on the sample wage statement.
examples.zh: 我们把「无法核实收入」和工资单样本上缺的信息对上了。

collocations: mark an application unable to verify income
a notice saying unable to verify income

words.enDefinition: an investment position smaller than the relevant comparison weight

examples.en: Our worksheet showed an underweight position when the fund's sector weight was below the benchmark weight.
examples.zh: 当基金行业权重低于基准权重时，练习表显示一个「低配头寸」。

examples.en: The commentary explained why the sample portfolio maintained an underweight position in the sector that quarter.
examples.zh: 评述解释了为什么样本组合在该季度一直对该行业持有「低配头寸」。

collocations: an underweight position relative to the benchmark

words.enDefinition: a contract setting out the arrangement between an issuer and its underwriters

examples.en: The sample underwriting agreement described how many shares each participating firm agreed to purchase.
examples.zh: 样本「承销协议」说明了各参与机构同意购买的股份数量。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the underwriting agreement had a different date from the preliminary prospectus.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「承销协议」的日期与初步招募说明书不同。

words.enDefinition: A requirement that must be met before credit approval is finalised

examples.en: The sample listed proof of address as an underwriting condition to be met.
examples.zh: 样本把提供地址证明列为需要满足的一项「信贷审批附加条件」。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked the reader to identify the remaining underwriting condition.
examples.zh: 练习题要求读者找出剩下的「信贷审批附加条件」。

words.enDefinition: compensation measured by the gap between the offering price and the underwriters' purchase price

examples.en: The sample showed the underwriting discount beside the offering price and the amount paid to the company.
examples.zh: 样本在发行价和付给公司的金额旁列出了「承销折让」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how the underwriting discount affected proceeds in the mock offering calculation.
examples.zh: 导师问，模拟发行计算中「承销折让」如何影响募集所得。

words.enDefinition: a group of firms sharing responsibility for underwriting an offering

examples.en: The underwriting syndicate in our case contained three firms with different commitments to buy shares.
examples.zh: 案例中的「承销团」由三家认购承诺不同的机构组成。

examples.en: We drew a diagram showing how the underwriting syndicate divided work for the mock offering.
examples.zh: 我们画图展示了「承销团」如何分担模拟发行的工作。

words.enDefinition: An account omitted from information an applicant gave to a lender

examples.en: The reviewer asked about an undisclosed account shown only on the sample credit report.
examples.zh: 审核员询问了那个只出现在信用报告样本上的「未披露账户」。

examples.en: An undisclosed account appeared in the exercise when the lender compared two documents.
examples.zh: 在练习中，贷款机构比较两份文件时发现了一个「未披露账户」。

words.zhGloss: 已承诺而未提用的额度
words.enDefinition: Credit promised by a lender that the borrower has not used
acceptedZhAnswers: 已承诺而未提用的额度

examples.en: The undrawn commitment shrank when the project borrowed more under its facility.
examples.zh: 项目从授信额度中又借了一部分后，「已承诺而未提用的额度」减少了。

examples.en: We compared the undrawn commitment with construction payments still due in the model.
examples.zh: 我们把「已承诺而未提用的额度」与模型尚需支付的建设款作了对照。

collocations: a fee on the undrawn commitment

words.enDefinition: Interest included in a calculation for a period that has not elapsed

examples.en: The article used unearned interest for the portion tied to future payment periods.
examples.zh: 文章用「尚未赚取的利息」来指对应未来还款期间的那部分利息。

examples.en: Our tutor separated unearned interest from interest already earned in the example.
examples.zh: 导师把示例中「尚未赚取的利息」和已经赚取的利息分开了。

words.enDefinition: an Australian education identifier used to link a student's training or higher education records

examples.en: The Australian form requested a Unique Student Identifier to match the student's official education records.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的表格要求提供「澳洲学生唯一识别号」，用来对应学生的正式教育记录。

examples.en: The adviser pointed out that the Unique Student Identifier differed from the university's own number.
examples.zh: 顾问指出，「澳洲学生唯一识别号」与大学自己分配的编号不同。

collocations: a record linked to a Unique Student Identifier

words.enDefinition: authorised shares that have not yet been issued

examples.en: The sample company reserved some unissued shares for use in an approved employee plan.
examples.zh: 样本公司预留了一些「未发行股份」，供已获批准的员工计划使用。

examples.en: The case asked whether enough unissued shares remained for the proposed offering of common stock.
examples.zh: 案例问，剩余的「未发行股份」够不够用于拟议的普通股发行。

words.enDefinition: an individual subject or component of an Australian course for which enrolment and fees can be recorded

examples.en: The finance notice listed a different charge for each unit of study in the semester.
examples.zh: 资助通知列出了这学期每个「修读单元」不同的收费。

examples.en: The adviser explained why two students might pay different amounts for the same unit of study.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么两名学生修读同一「修读单元」，付的金额可能不同。

collocations: enrol in a unit of study
withdraw from a unit of study
fee for a unit of study

words.zhGloss: 不含融资的项目现金流
words.enDefinition: cash flow from a project before the effects of its particular financing choices, such as debt proceeds, principal repayments and interest
acceptedZhAnswers: 不含融资的项目现金流

examples.en: The model showed unlevered project cash flow before adding any borrowing costs to the analysis.
examples.zh: 模型先列「不含融资的项目现金流」，之后才分析借款成本。

examples.en: We compared unlevered project cash flow across two projects with different proposed borrowing terms.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个拟议贷款条款不同的项目各自的「不含融资的项目现金流」。

words.enDefinition: A credit report inquiry that the named consumer cannot identify

examples.en: An unrecognized inquiry appeared in the sample despite the applicant recalling only one lender.
examples.zh: 申请人只记得一家贷款机构，样本里却有一条「陌生的信用查询记录」。

examples.en: In class, we wrote a question about an unrecognized inquiry on a fictional report.
examples.zh: 我们在课上针对虚构报告里的「陌生信用查询记录」写了一个问题。

words.enDefinition: Costs incurred for employment that the employer does not repay

examples.en: The sample file put unreimbursed employment expenses in a section separate from employer repayments.
examples.zh: 样例资料把「未报销的工作开支」和雇主报销分开记录。

examples.en: We matched the unreimbursed employment expenses in the worksheet to the relevant receipts.
examples.zh: 我们把练习表里的「未报销的工作开支」和相关收据一一对应。

words.enDefinition: An account whose details have not been sent to a reporting agency

examples.en: The fictional applicant's unreported account appeared on a statement but not the credit report.
examples.zh: 虚构申请人的「未纳入征信的账户」出现在账单上，却没有出现在信用报告里。

examples.en: The worksheet asked why an unreported account could still matter to a lender.
examples.zh: 练习题问，为什么「未纳入征信的账户」对贷款机构仍可能有意义。

words.enDefinition: The exchange rate before its decimal places are shortened by rounding for display or calculation.

examples.en: Our worksheet used the unrounded exchange rate so the fee calculation retained its original precision.
examples.zh: 练习表用「未舍入的汇率」计算费用，保留了原有精度。

examples.en: The displayed figure had fewer decimal places than the unrounded exchange rate used in the example.
examples.zh: 展示的数字比示例采用的「未舍入的汇率」少几位小数。

collocations: calculate with the unrounded exchange rate

words.zhGloss: 未生成评分的信用档案
words.enDefinition: An existing credit record for which a score was not generated
acceptedZhAnswers: 未生成评分的信用档案

examples.en: The unscored credit record in our example had entries that were too old for scoring.
examples.zh: 示例里「未生成评分的信用档案」中，记录太久远，没法评分。

examples.en: We compared an unscored credit record with a case where no credit record existed.
examples.zh: 我们把「未生成评分的信用档案」与根本没有信用档案的案例作了比较。

collocations: an application with an unscored credit record

words.enDefinition: a bond that relies on the issuer's promise to pay without a claim on specified pledged assets

examples.en: The class compared the unsecured bond with a note backed by specific machinery in the case.
examples.zh: 课堂把「无担保物债券」与案例中由指定机器担保的一只票据作了比较。

examples.en: The unsecured bond had a guarantor, but its terms did not pledge any specific assets.
examples.zh: 这只「无担保物债券」有保证人，但条款未设定任何特定资产作为担保。

words.enDefinition: An address stored as free text instead of separate fields for its components.

examples.en: The archive used an unstructured postal address in an older example of an international payment.
examples.zh: 档案里较旧的跨境付款示例采用了「非结构化邮寄地址」。

examples.en: The tutor showed how an unstructured postal address looked in the previous version of the form.
examples.zh: 老师展示了旧版表格里的「非结构化邮寄地址」是什么样的。

collocations: an older example of an unstructured postal address

words.zhGloss: 非结构化汇款附言信息
words.enDefinition: Payment-related information recorded in free text rather than in separate fields for each element.
acceptedZhAnswers: 非结构化汇款附言信息

examples.en: The older example carried unstructured remittance information in one block below the main payment details.
examples.zh: 较旧的示例把「非结构化汇款附言信息」放在主要付款明细下方的一整块文字里。

examples.en: The analyst read the unstructured remittance information before matching the sample transfer to the right invoice.
examples.zh: 分析员先看了「非结构化汇款附言信息」，再把示例汇款与正确的账单配对。

collocations: compare unstructured remittance information with specific fields

words.zhGloss: 可能影响受抚养身份的特殊情况
words.enDefinition: in US federal student aid, circumstances that may justify changing a student's dependency status
acceptedZhAnswers: 可能影响受抚养身份的特殊情况

examples.en: The handbook discussed unusual circumstances in a separate section about decisions on student dependency status.
examples.zh: 手册在资助依赖身份判定的独立章节讨论了「可能影响受抚养身份的特殊情况」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how unusual circumstances differed from a change in a student's documented financial costs.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「可能影响受抚养身份的特殊情况」与已登记的学生费用变动有何区别。

words.enDefinition: Reported details whose accuracy cannot be confirmed with the available evidence

examples.en: The example showed unverifiable information being removed after a review of the source records.
examples.zh: 示例显示，查阅来源记录后，「无法核实的信息」被删除了。

examples.en: The class discussed the difference between conflicting details and unverifiable information in a report.
examples.zh: 全班讨论了报告中相互矛盾的细节与「无法核实的信息」之间的区别。

words.enDefinition: portfolio return relative to benchmark return during positive benchmark periods

examples.en: We used only quarters when the benchmark rose to calculate the sample's upside capture ratio.
examples.zh: 我们只用基准上涨的季度来计算样本的「上涨捕获率」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the upside capture ratio and the overall relative return could differ.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「上涨捕获率」和总体相对回报率可能不一样。

words.enDefinition: Income classified as arising in the United States for tax purposes

examples.en: The handout showed US-source income separately from funds earned outside the country.
examples.zh: 讲义把「美国来源收入」与在境外取得的收入分开列出。

examples.en: Our exercise grouped possible US-source income by type before comparing the documents.
examples.zh: 我们的练习在对照文件前，先将可能的「美国来源收入」按类型归类。

words.enDefinition: the stated purposes for which raised funds will be used

examples.en: The use of proceeds section listed new equipment and the cost of opening a second facility.
examples.zh: 「募集资金用途」一节列出了新设备和开设第二处设施的费用。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the sample issuer changed its use of proceeds after amending the filing.
examples.zh: 导师问，样本发行人在修改申报文件后是否改变了「募集资金用途」。

collocations: describe the planned use of proceeds

words.enDefinition: the time at which a fund's investments are valued for dealing

examples.en: The sample UK prospectus stated the valuation point for calculating each day's unit prices.
examples.zh: 英国样本招募说明书写明了计算每日单位价格所用的「基金估值时点」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the order preceded the valuation point shown in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师问，订单是在练习所列的「基金估值时点」之前还是之后提交的。

words.zhGloss: 美国未申报记录证明信
words.enDefinition: An IRS letter saying it has no record of a processed return
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国未申报记录证明信

examples.en: The sample verification of non-filing letter confirmed the absence of a processed return for that year.
examples.zh: 「美国未申报记录证明信」样本确认，没有那一年的已处理申报记录。

examples.en: The fictional aid office listed a verification of non-filing letter among its example documents.
examples.zh: 虚构的资助办公室把「美国未申报记录证明信」列在文件示例中。

collocations: request a verification of non-filing letter
review a verification of non-filing letter
a date on a verification of non-filing letter

words.enDefinition: a US federal aid classification specifying which FAFSA items a selected applicant must verify

examples.en: The verification tracking group indicated which parts of the sample application needed additional documents.
examples.zh: 「资助核验分组」表明，申请样本的哪些部分需要补充文件。

examples.en: I learned to locate the verification tracking group in the practice version of the school's record.
examples.zh: 我学会了在学校的练习版记录中找到「资助核验分组」。

words.enDefinition: Employment details that have been checked against an independent source

examples.en: The mock case showed verified employment status before the lender considered the applicant's earnings.
examples.zh: 模拟案例先列出「已核实的就业状态」，再展示贷款机构如何评估申请人的收入。

examples.en: The review sheet kept verified employment status beside the evidence supplied by the employer.
examples.zh: 审核表把「已核实的就业状态」放在雇主提供的证明旁。

words.enDefinition: Earnings whose amount and source a lender has confirmed from evidence

examples.en: The mock application used verified income from payslips and a separate employer letter.
examples.zh: 模拟申请使用了工资单和雇主证明上的「已核实收入」。

examples.en: We highlighted verified income in the case study before reading the lender's decision.
examples.zh: 阅读贷款机构的决定前，我们在案例中标出了「已核实的收入」。

collocations: calculate payments based on verified income

words.zhGloss: 澳洲职业教育与培训学生贷款
words.enDefinition: an Australian government loan for eligible students taking approved vocational education and training courses
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲职业教育与培训学生贷款

examples.en: The sample enrolment pack explained when a VET Student Loan could cover course tuition.
examples.zh: 注册材料样本解释了在什么情况下「澳洲职业教育与培训学生贷款」可支付课程学费。
