examples.en: Our adviser distinguished the VET Student Loan from loans for particular university degree programmes.
examples.zh: 顾问把「澳洲职业教育与培训学生贷款」与特定大学学位课程的贷款区分开来。

collocations: apply for a VET Student Loan

words.zhGloss: 自愿偿还 HELP 贷款款项
words.enDefinition: a payment a borrower chooses to make towards an Australian HELP debt in addition to any required repayment
acceptedZhAnswers: 自愿偿还 HELP 贷款款项

examples.en: The sample account showed a voluntary HELP repayment entered before the end of the year.
examples.zh: 示例账户显示，年底前录入了一笔「自愿偿还 HELP 贷款款项」。

examples.en: The adviser distinguished a voluntary HELP repayment from the amount recorded on the tax assessment.
examples.zh: 顾问区分了「自愿偿还 HELP 贷款款项」和税务评估上记的还款金额。

collocations: the date of a voluntary HELP repayment

words.zhGloss: 他行在我方开立的账户
words.enDefinition: An account that one bank holds with another, described from the perspective of the bank providing the account.
acceptedZhAnswers: 他行在我方开立的账户

examples.en: The bank providing the account described it as a vostro account in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂例子中，提供账户的银行称其为「他行在我方开立的账户」。

examples.en: The diagram showed a vostro account on the side of the bank holding the other bank's funds.
examples.zh: 图中把「他行在我方开立的账户」画在保管他行资金的一侧。

collocations: record a balance in a vostro account

words.enDefinition: to have a representative cast a shareholder's vote

examples.en: The exercise showed how a shareholder could vote by proxy while travelling outside the country.
examples.zh: 练习展示了股东出国旅行期间怎样「委托他人表决」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared shareholders who planned to vote by proxy with those attending in person.
examples.zh: 导师比较了计划「委托他人表决」的股东和亲自到场的股东。

collocations: vote by proxy at a meeting
be entitled to vote by proxy

words.enDefinition: a form for a beneficial owner to direct an intermediary's vote

examples.en: The sample broker sent a voting instruction form to customers whose shares it held.
examples.zh: 样本券商向由其代持股份的客户发送了「表决指示表」。

examples.en: We compared the voting instruction form with the proxy card sent to a registered shareholder.
examples.zh: 我们把「表决指示表」与发给登记股东的投票委托卡作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the influence an owner has through the votes attached to holdings

examples.en: Our table used voting power to compare two shareholders with similar numbers of shares.
examples.zh: 我们通过表格中的「表决权份额」比较持股数量相近的两个股东。

examples.en: The founders retained most voting power after the sale of shares with fewer votes per share.
examples.zh: 出售每股票数较少的股份后，创始人仍保有大部分「表决权份额」。

collocations: a majority of the voting power

words.enDefinition: the date used to determine who qualifies to vote

examples.en: The fictional company listed a voting record date several weeks before its annual meeting.
examples.zh: 虚构公司把「表决权登记日」定在年度股东大会前几周。

examples.en: Our exercise compared the voting record date with the final deadline for returning instructions.
examples.zh: 练习对比了「表决权登记日」和提交表决指示的最终期限。

collocations: eligibility on the voting record date

words.enDefinition: the reported outcome and counts of a vote

examples.en: The voting results showed separate totals for votes in favour of and against the proposal.
examples.zh: 「表决结果」分别列出了赞成和反对提案的票数。

examples.en: We checked the voting results against the threshold described in the sample proxy materials.
examples.zh: 我们把「表决结果」与样本股东委托投票材料所述门槛进行了核对。

words.enDefinition: shares carrying votes on specified matters before shareholders

examples.en: The example listed voting shares separately when calculating support for the proposed board change.
examples.zh: 示例计算拟议董事会变动的支持度时，单独列出了「有表决权股份」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how many voting shares supported the change under the case's rules.
examples.zh: 导师问，根据案例中的规则，有多少「有表决权股份」支持这项变更。

collocations: a majority of the voting shares

words.zhGloss: 美国工资与收入税务摘录
words.enDefinition: An IRS transcript of income documents filed by third parties
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国工资与收入税务摘录

examples.en: The mock wage and income transcript summarised documents submitted by an employer and a bank.
examples.zh: 模拟的「美国工资与收入税务摘录」汇总了雇主和银行提交的文件。

examples.en: Kara compared the wage and income transcript with the tax forms her example taxpayer received.
examples.zh: 卡拉对照了「美国工资与收入税务摘录」和示例纳税人收到的税务表单。

collocations: request a wage and income transcript
entries on a wage and income transcript
review a wage and income transcript

words.zhGloss: 加权平均发行在外股数
words.enDefinition: outstanding shares averaged by the time they were outstanding during a period
acceptedZhAnswers: 加权平均发行在外股数

examples.en: The worksheet used weighted average shares outstanding because the company issued more shares halfway through the year.
examples.zh: 因为公司年中增发了股份，练习表采用「加权平均发行在外股数」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why weighted average shares outstanding differed from the count at year end.
examples.zh: 导师问，「加权平均发行在外股数」为什么与年末股数不同。

words.enDefinition: Comparison of estimated outcomes if a project proceeds or does not

examples.en: Our with-and-without analysis compared the proposed equipment with keeping the current machines.
examples.zh: 我们的「有无项目比较分析」对照了采购拟议设备和保留现有机器两种情形。

examples.en: The instructor used a with-and-without analysis to separate new receipts from existing sales.
examples.zh: 老师通过「有无项目比较分析」把新增收入和现有销售收入分开了。

words.enDefinition: to decline to authorise a proxy to vote for a candidate

examples.en: The fictional proxy card let shareholders withhold voting authority for an individual director nominee.
examples.zh: 虚构的股东投票委托卡允许股东对单名董事候选人「不给予委托投票权」。

examples.en: We checked where holders could withhold voting authority in the sample director election materials.
examples.zh: 我们核对了在样本董事选举材料里，持有人可以在何处选择「不给予委托投票权」。

collocations: withhold voting authority for a nominee
an option to withhold voting authority

words.zhGloss: 澳洲预扣税情况更改声明
words.enDefinition: An Australian form for updating information used to calculate payroll withholding
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲预扣税情况更改声明

examples.en: The withholding declaration was part of a case study about updating payroll information.
examples.zh: 「澳洲预扣税情况更改声明」出现在一则更新薪资信息的案例里。

examples.en: The adviser showed a blank withholding declaration beside the original payroll paperwork.
examples.zh: 顾问把空白的「澳洲预扣税情况更改声明」和原始薪税文书放在一起展示。

collocations: a change on a withholding declaration

words.zhGloss: 与工作相关的自我进修费用
words.enDefinition: Australian tax terminology for education costs related to current work
acceptedZhAnswers: 与工作相关的自我进修费用

examples.en: The guide included work-related self-education expenses in a case about a job skills course.
examples.zh: 指南在有关职业技能课程的案例里列出「与工作相关的自我进修费用」。

examples.en: Our example separated work-related self-education expenses from the travel expenses shown later.
examples.zh: 示例把「与工作相关的自我进修费用」与后面列出的差旅开支分开记录。

collocations: work-related self-education expenses in a return

words.enDefinition: The share of a mixed expense attributable to using something for work

examples.en: The worksheet showed the work-use portion of a fictional employee's internet bill.
examples.zh: 练习表显示了虚构雇员网络账单中「用于工作的费用份额」。

examples.en: We distinguished the work-use portion from the personal share in the sample calculation.
examples.zh: 我们区分了计算样本中的「用于工作的费用份额」和个人用途份额。

words.enDefinition: Cash freed when a project no longer needs previously committed funds

examples.en: The working capital release occurred when inventory was sold and customer balances were collected.
examples.zh: 存货售出、应收款收回后，发生了「营运资金释放」。

examples.en: The closing date mattered because the worksheet placed a working capital release there.
examples.zh: 结项日期很重要，因为练习表把「营运资金释放」列在那一天。

collocations: a working capital release at closure

words.enDefinition: An Australian tax category for an eligible working holiday maker's net earnings

examples.en: We found working holiday maker net income as a separate field in the Australian example return.
examples.zh: 我们在澳大利亚申报表样本里找到了单列的「澳洲打工度假净收入」。

examples.en: The instructor labelled working holiday maker net income on a blank form during the orientation workshop.
examples.zh: 迎新工作坊上，讲师在空白表格上标出了「澳洲打工度假净收入」。

collocations: declare working holiday maker net income
calculate working holiday maker net income
the field for working holiday maker net income

words.zhGloss: 学生贷款剩余余额免还日期
words.enDefinition: the date on which remaining student loan debt is scheduled to be cancelled if applicable conditions are met
acceptedZhAnswers: 学生贷款剩余余额免还日期

examples.en: The adviser noted the write-off date while comparing the two example UK student loan plans.
examples.zh: 顾问在比较两个英国学生贷款示例方案时，留意了「学生贷款剩余余额免还日期」。

examples.en: The sample account showed the write-off date separately from the dates of recent monthly repayments.
examples.zh: 示例账户把「学生贷款剩余余额免还日期」与最近各月的还款日期分开显示。

words.zhGloss: 佩尔助学金年度追加安排
words.enDefinition: a US provision allowing eligible students to receive additional Pell Grant funds within the same award year
acceptedZhAnswers: 佩尔助学金年度追加安排

examples.en: The university adviser mentioned Year-Round Pell while explaining aid for an additional term of study.
examples.zh: 大学顾问解释额外一个学期的资助时，提到了「佩尔助学金年度追加安排」。

examples.en: The example with Year-Round Pell included an additional payment after the regular academic terms ended.
examples.zh: 「佩尔助学金年度追加安排」的例子在常规学期结束后还列有一次额外发放。

collocations: receive additional aid through Year-Round Pell

words.enDefinition: a decrease in the difference between longer- and shorter-term yields over the segment being compared

examples.en: The worksheet illustrated yield curve flattening when the shorter yield rose closer to the longer yield.
examples.zh: 短端收益率上升、向长端靠拢时，练习表展示了「收益率曲线趋平」。

examples.en: The lecturer asked what yield curve flattening meant for the gap between the two selected maturities.
examples.zh: 讲师问，「收益率曲线趋平」对所选两个期限的收益率差距意味着什么。

words.enDefinition: an increase in the difference between longer- and shorter-term yields over the segment being compared

examples.en: The chart illustrated yield curve steepening after longer yields rose while shorter yields barely changed.
examples.zh: 长端收益率上升、短端几乎没变化，图表展示了「收益率曲线变陡」。

examples.en: We checked which maturities the analyst used to describe yield curve steepening in the example.
examples.zh: 我们查看了分析人员用哪些期限来描述示例中的「收益率曲线变陡」。

collocations: yield curve steepening at the long end

words.enDefinition: the annualised return implied by a bond's price and payments if it is called on a specified date

examples.en: We calculated yield to call using the first eligible call date in the sample bond's terms.
examples.zh: 我们采用样本债券条款里的首次可赎回日期，计算了「赎回收益率」。

examples.en: The yield to call shown in the table assumed the issuer redeemed the note early.
examples.zh: 表中的「赎回收益率」假设发行人提前赎回票据。

collocations: compare yield to call with yield to maturity
yield to call at the first call date

words.enDefinition: the lowest of the yield to maturity and the yields for issuer call scenarios included in the calculation, assuming promised payments are made

examples.en: The table listed yield to worst beside the yields calculated for maturity and the call dates.
examples.zh: 表里把「最不利情形收益率」和按到期日、各可赎回日期计算的收益率并排列出。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why the yield to worst was lower than the yield to maturity.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么「最不利情形收益率」低于该债券的到期收益率。

collocations: compare yield to worst across bonds

words.enDefinition: a bond with no periodic coupon payments, usually issued below its redemption value

examples.en: We priced a zero-coupon bond by finding the present value of its single maturity payment.
examples.zh: 我们计算「零息债券」唯一一笔到期付款的现值，以得出债券价格。

examples.en: The zero-coupon bond appeared in the table without any interest payments before its maturity.
examples.zh: 表中的「零息债券」在到期之前没有列出任何利息付款。

words.enDefinition: a constant spread added to a benchmark spot curve so discounted bond payments match the market price

examples.en: Our worksheet solved for the zero-volatility spread using the benchmark spot rates and the stated payments.
examples.zh: 练习表用基准即期利率与约定付款额求出了「零波动率利差」。

examples.en: The tutor explained how the zero-volatility spread differed from a spread accounting for an embedded option.
examples.zh: 导师解释了「零波动率利差」与考虑内嵌期权的利差有何不同。

collocations: zero-volatility spread over the spot curve
